jobs.title: Quality Systems Lead
jobs.description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're hiring a Quality Systems Lead to own how Encord measures the quality of the human data we deliver to frontier AI labs, physical AI companies and enterprise AI teams — the standard itself, the systems that evaluate against it, and the audit function that produces the ground truth behind both. Data quality is what our customers buy. As we scale across data types — image and video, document, medical, LLM evaluation, robot teleoperation, egocentric capture — quality coverage cannot scale linearly with headcount. So this role has two halves that make each other work. You will build automated evaluation: model-assisted and LLM-based screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output. And you will build and run a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists in India, whose judgements become the labelled ground truth that trains and calibrates that automated layer. As coverage automates, the audit team moves up to the cases models can't judge and to generating gold sets for each new data type we take on. It is an unusual combination — engineering and consistent QC operations in one person — and it is the combination the job needs. You will also have an advantage your counterparts elsewhere in the industry don't: Encord owns the platform this work runs on, so the measurement you build can become native capability in the product rather than internal tooling.

 

What you'll do

  • Build automated dataset quality evaluation and root-cause detection — model-assisted and LLM-as-judge screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output

  • Hire, train, calibrate and manage a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists based in our India operation, held to inter-rater agreement and catch rate rather than volume audited

  • Turn audit output into labelled ground truth that trains and validates the automated layer, and manage the ratio of automated to manual coverage deliberately over time

  • Own the quality standard for every data type we deliver — written rubrics with worked edge cases, golden sets, and acceptance criteria agreed with the customer, alongside the Special Projects lead, before the first batch ships

  • Build scoring systems that rank annotator and reviewer performance and feed routing, staffing and offboarding decisions

  • Set the pass thresholds that certification gates on, so nobody works a project queue without having demonstrated they meet the standard

  • Report quality KPIs to leadership, and into the reporting our Special Projects leads take to customers: accuracy against client spec, inter-annotator agreement, rework rate, cost of rework, and coverage

  • Work with Project Management on remediation — you produce the measurement and the diagnosis, production owns fixing the project, and the standard stays independent of the people being measured

  • Own the unit economics of quality: cost per audited unit, and the coverage you buy per pound spent

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to bring quality measurement into Encord platform as native capability

Who we're looking for

  • You build and you operate. You'll write the evaluation pipeline, and you'll also run the weekly calibration session with ten auditors in another country

Heb jij het hart op de juiste plek en wil je zelfstandig werken met impact? Dan ben jij de thuisverpleegkundige die we zoeken!

Als (zelfstandig) thuisverpleegkundige bied je kwalitatieve en persoonlijke zorg aan cliënten in hun vertrouwde omgeving. Je werkt autonoom, maar steeds in nauwe samenwerking met andere zorgverleners.

Bij ons doe je écht mee:

  • je voert verpleegkundige handelingen uit zoals wondzorg, inspuitingen en medicatietoediening;
  • je schat de zorgbehoefte van cliënten in (klinisch, psychisch en sociaal);
  • je stelt zorgplannen op en volgt deze op;
  • je observeert de gezondheidstoestand van cliënten en stuurt bij waar nodig;
  • je registreert zorg en houdt patiëntendossiers correct bij;
  • je overlegt met huisartsen en andere zorgprofessionals;
  • je begeleidt cliënten en mantelzorgers en stimuleert zelfredzaamheid.

Je wordt voornamelijk ingezet in de regio Berchem afhankelijk van jouw mobiliteit.

Je werkt zelfstandig, maar bent altijd verbonden met een betrokken team en organisatie die jou ondersteunt.

Klinkt dat als jouw manier van werken? Join ons netwerk!

Ben jij een (zelfstandige) verpleegkundige met een hart voor zorg? Dan pas je perfect bij ons.

  • Je beschikt over een diploma verpleegkunde en een RIZIV-nummer;
  • Je bent bereid je te conventioneren;
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, maar hecht ook belang aan samenwerking;
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk, nauwkeurig en betrouwbaar;
  • Je communiceert vlot met cliënten, mantelzorgers en zorgpartners;
  • Je bouwt sterke relaties op met huisartsen en andere zorgverleners;
  • Je denkt mee in het belang van de patiënt en stimuleert zelfzorg;
  • Je kan je vinden in een mensgerichte zorgvisie zoals Positive Care;
  • Nederlands spreken en begrijpen? Helemaal in orde.

jobs.title: Warehouse worker - 2-shift system - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Loading and unloading trucks
  • Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
  • Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You are a good fit if you:

  • Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
  • Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
  • Can work in a 2-shift system
  • Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
  • Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

  • Already live in Belgium
  • Have a valid Belgian address
  • Have legal permission to work in Belgium

Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

jobs.title: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.title: Zorgkundige - WZC Seniorplaza
jobs.description:
Bij Seniorplaza draag je als zorgkundige bij aan een huiselijke sfeer en zorg op maat. Je bent een vertrouwd gezicht voor bewoners en maakt het verschil in kleine momenten van aandacht. Je werkt nauw samen met verpleegkundigen en collega’s om kwaliteitsvolle, persoonsgerichte zorg te bieden.

Jouw dagelijkse bezigheden bestaan uit:

  • je voert gedelegeerde verzorgende en verpleegkundige handelingen uit;
  • je staat in voor dagelijkse verzorging en hygiëne;
  • je biedt comfortzorg en preventieve zorg;
  • je observeert en rapporteert veranderingen;
  • je ondersteunt bij maaltijden, medicatie en dagelijkse activiteiten;
  • je draagt bij aan orde en netheid op de afdeling.

Als zorgkundige draag je bij aan dagelijkse verzorging, hygiëne, comfortzorg en preventieve zorg, met aandacht voor orde en netheid op de afdeling. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor een huiselijke sfeer en zorg op maat, elke dag opnieuw. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten betrokkenheid, nauwkeurigheid en teamgerichtheid centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je kwaliteitsvol werkt, veranderingen observeert en samen met verpleegkundigen de zorg afstemt.

Verder vragen wij:

  • diploma en visum zorgkundige;
  • ervaring: niet vereist;
  • correct uitvoeren van gedelegeerde handelingen + observeren/rapporteren;
  • goede kennis Nederlands;
  • flexibel en stressbestendig.

jobs.title: Regioverantwoordelijke Provincie Antwerpen flex / huisbezoeker
jobs.description:
Als regioverantwoordelijke flex zorg je mee voor de continuïteit van de werking binnen thuiszorg in de provincie Antwerpen. Je springt in waar het druk is of waar een collega tijdelijk afwezig is, en je ondersteunt teams vanuit ons kantoor in Willebroek. Je combineert organisatie en people management met een mensgerichte aanpak: je motiveert medewerkers, bewaakt planningen en onderhoudt contacten met cliënten en doorverwijzers. Dankzij jouw overzicht blijft de dienstverlening betrouwbaar en goed afgestemd op de klant.

Jouw dagelijkse taken zijn:

  • je zorgt mee voor de continuïteit van onze werking gezinszorg/poetsdienst waar een collega tijdelijk afwezig is of waar het extra druk is;
  • je maakt planningen op en volgt verlof, bezetting en inzetbaarheid op voor een team van 30-35 medewerkers;
  • je voert huisbezoeken uit en bewaakt de kwaliteit en afstemming van de dienstverlening;
  • je voert gesprekken met medewerkers rond functioneren, welbevinden en ontwikkeling;
  • je motiveert, enthousiasmeert en stuurt bij waar nodig, met aandacht voor teamdynamiek;
  • je speelt in op noden en wensen van cliënten vanuit het volledige aanbod van Korian Home Care;
  • je onderhoudt contacten met medewerkers, cliënten en doorverwijzers;
  • je volgt opleiding en inwerktrajecten vanuit de kantoren in Willebroek.

Als regioverantwoordelijke flex draag je bij aan de continuïteit van de gezinszorg of poetsdienst binnen jouw regio. Je maakt planningen op, ondersteunt medewerkers, voert huisbezoeken uit en bewaakt de kwaliteit van dienstverlening. Je motiveert teams en onderhoudt contacten met cliënten en doorverwijzers. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor een betrouwbare en mensgerichte dienstverlening. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten organisatorisch sterk, communicatief en mensgericht binnen jouw functie centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je teams aanstuurt en dienstverlening op elkaar afstemt.

Verder vragen wij:

  • je beschikt over minimaal een bachelor diploma (bij voorkeur zorg gerelateerd);
  • je kan zelfstandig werken en initiatief nemen;
  • je bent flexibel en betrokken;
  • je kan zeer goed plannen en denkt oplossingsgericht;
  • je beschikt over een rijbewijs en eigen wagen;
  • je kan vlot communiceren in het Nederlands (mondeling en schriftelijk).

jobs.title: Poetshulp - regio Mechelen
jobs.description:
Als poetshulp in regio Mechelen ondersteun je cliënten die door gezondheidsredenen het huishouden niet meer volledig zelf kunnen doen. Jij helpt hen om in een nette, veilige en aangename thuisomgeving te blijven wonen. Je werkt zelfstandig bij mensen thuis en zorgt met jouw hulp voor comfort, rust en meer levenskwaliteit in het dagelijks leven. Jouw nieuwe taken:

  • je maakt de woning schoon (stofzuigen, dweilen, afstoffen en algemeen onderhoud);
  • je reinigt keuken en sanitair en zorgt voor hygiëne en orde;
  • je maakt bedden op en ververst lakens volgens afspraak;
  • je helpt bij opruimen en het ordelijk houden van leefruimtes;
  • je verlucht kamers en draagt bij aan een frisse woonomgeving;
  • je doet afwas en bergt de vaat op indien dit binnen het takenpakket valt;
  • je werkt discreet en respectvol, met aandacht voor de gewoontes van de cliënt.

Als poetshulp in regio Mechelen draag je bij aan comfort en zelfstandigheid van cliënten in hun eigen woning. Je helpt met huishoudelijke taken zodat mensen veilig en aangenaam thuis kunnen blijven wonen. Samen met je cliënten zorg jij voor netheid, rust en een verzorgde thuisomgeving. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten zelfstandig, betrouwbaar en sociaal voelend binnen jouw functie centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je alleen werkt bij mensen thuis en je rekening houdt met hun gewoontes en privacy. Verder vragen wij:

  • geen specifieke studievereisten;
  • je kan zelfstandig werken en neemt initiatief;
  • je bent flexibel en sociaal ingesteld;
  • je bent in het bezit van een wagen;
  • goede kennis van het Nederlands.

Senior Project Analyst – Business Performance (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are looking for a commercially minded and analytical Senior Project Analyst (m/f/d) to support business performance by identifying opportunities for improvement across our projects. You will analyze processes, investigate root causes of project challenges, identify bottlenecks, and work closely with cross-functional teams to implement practical, data-driven solutions.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems, working with data, and driving continuous improvement.

Your Roadmap to Make an Impact

Process Analysis

  • Lead analysis of business processes and workflows to identify inefficiencies and optimization opportunities.

  • Partner with stakeholders and subject matter experts to assess current processes, challenges, and improvement potential.

  • Map and document processes, translating findings into actionable recommendations.

Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead root cause analysis to address underlying operational and business challenges.

  • Identify, quantify, and prioritize key bottlenecks and performance gaps.

  • Develop and drive improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, productivity, and business performance.

  • Monitor outcomes and ensure improvements deliver measurable impact.

Data & Performance

  • Analyze data and KPIs to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Develop reports, dashboards, and insights to support strategic decision-making.

  • Measure and communicate the impact of process and performance improvements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Commercial, Sales, Procurement, Finance, Operations, and other functions on strategic improvement initiatives.

  • Lead cross-functional projects to improve operational effectiveness and scalability.

  • Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders and drive alignment on priorities


  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related field

  • 3 - 4 years of experience in Project/ commercial/business analysis, or a similar analytical role

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Experience with process mapping and root cause analysis

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations

  • Fluency in English and German is required

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

  • Dynamic and fast-paced team: Be among the first to shape a deep-tech defense company redefining the future of security with an international team where your impact is immediate

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Sales Development (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen dich!

Wir suchen einen Werkstudenten Sales Development (m/w/d), der uns dabei unterstützt, noch mehr Unternehmen für bessere Kundenkommunikation zu begeistern.

Jeden Tag helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Kundenkommunikation einfacher, effizienter und besser zu gestalten. Damit noch mehr Unternehmen von unseren Lösungen profitieren können, möchten wir unseren Kundenstamm gezielt erweitern und neue Kontakte aufbauen.

Du hast Freude daran, dich in Unternehmen einzulesen, die richtigen Ansprechpartner zu identifizieren und den ersten Kontakt herzustellen? Du bist neugierig, kommunizierst gerne und lässt dich von einem Nein nicht aus der Ruhe bringen? Dann passt du zu uns.

Vorerfahrungen im Vertrieb sind dabei kein Muss. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du Interesse an Menschen, Unternehmen und guter Kommunikation mitbringst. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Wir arbeiten hybrid, mit klaren Zuständigkeiten und engem Austausch im Team. Nach deiner Einarbeitung kannst du überwiegend remote arbeiten. Für Trainings, Feedbackgespräche, Teamtage oder andere wichtige Termine freuen wir uns, wenn du nach Absprache an einem unserer Standorte dabei bist.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du recherchierst Unternehmen, die zu unseren Zielkunden passen.
  • Du identifizierst relevante Ansprechpartner und pflegst Informationen in unserem CRM.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Ansprache potenzieller Kunden per E-Mail, Telefon und LinkedIn.
  • Du führst erste Gespräche mit Interessenten und prüfst gemeinsam mit dem Team, ob ein passender Bedarf besteht.
  • Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine für unser Vertriebsteam.
  • Du dokumentierst Aktivitäten und Erkenntnisse sauber in unseren Systemen.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Ansprachesequenzen weiter und testest, welche Ansätze gut funktionieren.
  • Du gibst Rückmeldungen aus Gesprächen und Recherchen an Vertrieb und Marketing weiter. 


Deine Rolle bei uns

  • Du bist kein Praktikant im Hintergrund, sondern Teil unseres Vertriebsteams.
  • Du lernst, wie moderne Neukundengewinnung im B2B-Umfeld funktioniert, übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung und arbeitest eng mit unseren Vertriebskollegen zusammen.
  • Wenn du langfristig im Vertrieb arbeiten möchtest, kannst du dich bei uns perspektivisch in Richtung Sales Development Representative oder Account Executive weiterentwickeln.


Dein Profil

Must-haves

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule oder Universität eingeschrieben.
  • Du kommunizierst gerne mit anderen Menschen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenverantwortlich.
  • Du bist neugierig und arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein.
  • Du hast keine Scheu davor, aktiv auf Menschen zuzugehen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Nice-to-haves
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Kundenkontakt, Service, Vertrieb, Recruiting oder einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit.
  • Interesse an Vertrieb, Software, Digitalisierung oder Kundenservice.
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit LinkedIn, CRM-Systemen oder anderen digitalen Tools.
  • Interesse daran, langfristig Erfahrungen im B2B-Vertrieb zu sammeln.

jobs.description:

Wir, die MIFCOM GmbH, bieten die besten Jobs in der Gaming-Branche. Als einer der führenden Hersteller persönlich konfigurierbarer PCs und Notebooks für Gamer und anspruchsvolle Nutzer sind wir immer auf der Suche nach neuen Talenten, mit einem Faible für Technik, die gemeinsam mit uns ihren nächsten Karriereschritt machen wollen.

Mit über 180 engagierten Mitarbeitern fertigen wir an 2 Standorten PCs, Workstations und Server nach Kundenwunsch. Egal ob Business-Laptop oder High-End Gaming PC, wir setzen alles daran die Vorstellungen unserer Kunden umzusetzen – „Geht nicht, gibt’s nicht!“

Dabei sind ein Höchstmaß an Flexibilität, bedingungslose Kundenorientierung und eine ausgesprochene Hands-On Mentalität die Grundpfeiler unserer täglichen Arbeit. Vielfach von der Fachpresse ausgezeichnet und mit besten Kundenbewertungen sind wir der führende PC-Systembuilder in Deutschland.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Produktmanagement-Teams suchen wir aktuell einen Produktmanager – PC-Hardware (m/w/d). In dieser Rolle bringst Du ein breites Verständnis für PC-Konfigurationen und Komponentenökosysteme mit und entwickelst diesen Bereich innerhalb unseres Produktmanagements aktiv weiter. Du bist der Spezialist für das Zusammenspiel der Teile immer mit dem Blick auf die Performance des Gesamtsystems.


Deine Aufgaben:

Als Produktmanager – PC-Hardware (m/w/d) verantwortest Du Sortiment, Prozesse und Lieferantenbeziehungen in Deinen Warengruppen und bringst gleichzeitig Dein Systemverständnis ein, um unser Konfigurationsangebot kontinuierlich zu verbessern. 
Der Schwerpunkt liegt im Produktmanagement – ergänzt um einkaufsnahe Aufgaben wie Verhandlungen und Konditionsgestaltung.

Deine täglichen To-Dos umfassen vor allem die folgenden Tätigkeiten:

  • Du übernimmst die Sortimentsstrategie für PC-Komponenten – von der Produktauswahl und technischen Validierung über Kompatibilitätsprüfungen bis hin zur Weiterentwicklung des Gesamtportfolios
  • Du bringst ein ganzheitliches Verständnis für PC-Konfigurationen mit; Du denkst nicht in einzelnen Bauteilen, sondern erkennst, wie Komponenten im System zusammenwirken und nutzt dieses Wissen, um unser Konfigurationsangebot gezielt weiterzuentwickeln
  • Du übernimmst das Vendor Management für Deine Warengruppen und bist interner Hauptansprechpartner für Hersteller und Distributoren in allen technischen und kommerziellen Fragestellungen
  • Du führst Lieferantenverhandlungen zu Einkaufskonditionen, Rahmenverträgen, Rabattstaffeln und Sonderaktionen und optimierst so kontinuierlich unsere Marge und Verfügbarkeit
  • Du bewertest neue Produkte technisch fundiert hinsichtlich Kompatibilität, Leistung und Verarbeitungsqualität 
  • Du behältst Markt-, Trend- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen im Blick und leitest daraus Sortiments- und Preisentscheidungen ab
  • Du pflegst und verwaltest die Artikel Deiner Warengruppen inklusive technischer Detaildaten in unserem Warenwirtschaftssystem und Onlineshop
  • Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktmanagement-Prozesse aktiv voran – von Forecasting und Reporting bis zur abteilungsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Produktion und Service
  • Du stehst im engen Austausch mit anderen Teams aus den Bereichen Einkauf, Produktion und Service, um Sortiments- und Verfügbarkeitsthemen frühzeitig zu klären


Dein Profil:

Bei MIFCOM hören wir nie auf zu lernen und uns weiterzuentwickeln. Wir glauben daran, dass eine perfekte Mischung aus technischem Fachwissen, kaufmännischem Verständnis und Soft-Skills einen guten Kandidaten auszeichnet. Unser Anforderungsprofil ist eine erste Richtlinie, aber wir sind immer auf der Suche nach Persönlichkeiten, die ihre eigene Perspektive und den Willen, etwas zu bewegen, mitbringen.

Als unser idealer Kandidat bringst Du folgende Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen mit:

  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit kaufmännischem oder technischem Schwerpunkt (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Informatik) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Category Management oder Einkauf mit, idealerweise im Bereich PC-Hardware, Consumer Electronics oder Gaming
  • Du hast ein breites technisches Verständnis für PC-Konfigurationen und Komponentenökosysteme – Du verstehst, wie Teile zusammenspielen, und erkennst, wo Optimierungspotenzial liegt
  • Du hast Erfahrung in Lieferantenverhandlungen und verhandelst sicher und zielorientiert, ohne dabei die technische Perspektive aus den Augen zu verlieren
  • Du denkst prozessorientiert, bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung von Abläufen ein und treibst deren Umsetzung eigenständig voran
  • Du begeisterst Dich auch privat für PC-Hardware, Software und Gaming und bist ständig up-to-date, was Trends und neue Produkte angeht
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise zählen zu Deinen Stärken
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse


Warum MIFCOM?

Performance steht bei allem, was wir tun, im Mittelpunkt. Unsere Produkte erfüllen die höchsten Anforderungen unserer Kunden; der Name MIFCOM steht für Zuverlässigkeit, Präzision und ein Maximum an Leistung.

Bei uns erwartet Dich ein spannendes und dynamisches Umfeld mit einer Vielfalt an verschiedenen Aufgaben und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, sowie ein umfassendes Benefits Paket, das Dir unter anderem folgendes bietet:

  • Ein spannender, anspruchsvoller und abwechslungsreicher Job in einem engagierten Team mit einer "Du"-Kultur und familiärer Atmosphäre
  • Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit attraktiver Vergütung, sowie flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und all das beim führenden PC-Systemintegrator
  • Eine Home-Office-Möglichkeit und individuelle Gestaltung des Arbeitsplatzes sowie technischer Ausstattung (PC, Monitore, Peripherie, etc.)
  • Viel Freiraum und Möglichkeiten, Deine Ideen einzubringen und umzusetzen
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungen, je nach persönlichen Interessen & Schwerpunkten samt zahlreichen Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen
  • Arbeit mit neuester Computerhardware und neuesten Technologien - mache Dein Hobby zum Beruf
  • Kostenfreier Kaffee & Getränke sowie fußläufig gut erreichbare Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Foodtrucks und Restaurants
  • Nach der Probezeit: z.B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad, attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen, uvm.
  • Sonstige Benefits, wie z.B. 30 Tage Urlaub, Fitness-Abo (EGYM Wellpass), Corporate Benefits, etc.
  • Eine große Dachterrasse für ein gemütliches Miteinander, Firmenevents, regelmäßige Grillpartys, Tischtennis, uvm.
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
Du hast es bis hierher geschafft, was nur eines bedeuten kann – Du bist zu 100% bereit, den nächsten Schritt zu machen, um Teil unseres fantastischen Teams zu werden.

Wir bei MIFCOM leben unsere Core Values jeden Tag. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und das spiegelt sich auch in unserem Handeln, Mindset und dem Umgang mit Kollegen und Kunden wider.

Wir sind stolz darauf, was wir bisher erreicht haben und freuen uns auf Dich als neuestes Mitglied unseres fantastischen Teams.

What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title?

Not through marketing spin. Not through vague "purpose-driven" messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact.

That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us.


Why Tanso?

  • Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change.
  • Challenge & Grow Through Ownership. Take ownership immediately, build expertise through hands-on experience, and leverage every available resource to achieve outsized impact.

  • Embrace Responsibility & Drive Impact. Turn fragmented emissions data into actionable insights. Your work has immediate, visible impact - clearer decision-making and genuine momentum toward change.
  • AI First-Mindset. We embrace cutting-edge technology to solve sustainability challenges. Push the boundaries of innovation and stay ahead of what's possible.
  • Commitment to Performance & Excellence. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. Push yourself and others to excel, celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and raise the bar.


Your role

To take real ownership of what you build and take own end-to-end feature responsibility, we are looking for a Software Engineer (f/m/x). 

As a Software Engineer (m/f/x)  you will work on meaningful customer-facing problems within one of our platform modules and collaborate closely with product, design, customer success, and other engineers.

At Tanso, engineers are responsible understanding the problem, challenging assumptions, shaping the solution, making technical trade-offs, shipping to production, and iterating based on what we learn. We care less about following a predefined playbook and more about making good decisions, moving with purpose, and building software that creates tangible value for our customers.


Key responsibilities

  • Own customer-facing features from problem definition through implementation, rollout, and iteration.
  • Turn ambiguous requirements and user needs into pragmatic, maintainable solutions. Challenge assumptions and help decide what is worth building
  • Collaborate closely with product designers and customer success to understand user needs and shape effective solutions.
  • Contribute to the quality of our codebase, engineering practices, and developer experience.


Your profile

  • You have 2+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software in Typescript.
  • Strong full-stack and product thinking, understanding systems end-to-end.
  • First experience with backend development, ideally with PostgreSQL and Azure.
  • Clear, precise communicator in English. 
  • Self-driven problem solver with strong ownership and execution mindset.
Nice to have
  • German language skills. 


What we offer

  • A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth. 
  • Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed. 
  • A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security. 
  • Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development. 
  • Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options. 
  • Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences. 


Our team

We're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves.

Hier bekommst du gezieltes Onboarding von uns:

jobs.title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What we are building

At ecoplanet, we're redefining energy for tomorrow. Our mission: turn energy management into the competitive edge every European business relies on to win its market. We're building the operating system for the energy transition — cutting energy costs, improving efficiency, and streamlining operations. Backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and more, and built by a team full of top-tier talent.


Why This Role Matters

You will build and run the data backbone the whole product sits on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to get that data in clean, on time, and in a shape that dashboards, insights and forecasts can rely on.

You will join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Meter data integration. Connect industrial hardware and utility data streams into real-time dashboards. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is bringing data into a consistent structure across all sites
  • Anomalies and insights. This is where data science comes in. Find the things in the data a customer would want to know about — a meter drifting, a machine left running overnight, consumption that does not fit the pattern — and turn them into something they can act on
  • Tech stack and growth. Support the engineering team building scalable data pipeline


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 3–5 years in a data engineering role or something close to it, building pipelines other people depend on

  • Hands-on data science experience. You do not need a research background. You do need to have built and evaluated models yourself: enough to tell a real anomaly from noise, to judge when a finding is solid enough to put in front of a paying customer, and to know what a pipeline owes a model running in production

  • Solid with Python and SQL and cloud data infrastructure. You have designed and run pipelines, APIs and workflows in production

  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings

  • You think end to end before you go deep. When you hit a hard problem, the first instinct we want is “can a change somewhere else in the chain make this easy?” rather than heading straight into solving the hard version. A company our size cannot afford clever answers to problems that did not need solving

  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus

Nice to have:

  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware

  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines

  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like TypeScript or Kotlin

  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Close collaboration with our Product team
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership + Deutschlandticket sponsorship
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system


The Application

We don't do long forms. We don't do generic cover letters. Send us your CV and surprise us.

jobs.title: Praktisk lageransvarlig til Klosterhedens Vildt A/S
jobs.description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for vores lager, når vi tager skridtet fra papir til tablet?

Klosterhedens Vildt er en af Danmarks førende leverandører af vildtkød. Vi sælger til private og virksomheder i hele landet, og størstedelen af vores omsætning kommer fra vores egen webshop. Væksten stiller nye krav til lageret — og derfor søger vi en lageransvarlig.

Vi går inden for få uger i luften med elektronisk pluk og pak med tablets og faste lokationer. Vores egenudviklede IT-platform er opdateret og klar. Nu mangler vi den person, der skal få det til at fungere i praksis hver eneste dag.

Lad os slå fast med det samme: det her er ikke et kontorjob. Du er på lageret hver dag, du har hænderne i varerne, og når ordrerne står i kø, pakker du med. Tablet og system er værktøjer — ikke arbejdspladsen.

DET BLIVER DIT ANSVAR

• Den daglige drift af lageret: varemodtagelse, plukning, pakning og forsendelse

• At køre det nye pluk-og-pak-setup ind — lokationsstyring og arbejdsgange på tablets

• At holde styr på lagerbeholdning og lokationer, så data i systemet og virkeligheden på hylden stemmer overens

• Pakkeopgaver på lige fod med resten af holdet, når der er travlt

• Tæt samspil med produktionen, så varerne kommer på hylden til tiden og i rette stand

• Optælling, kvalitetskontrol og overholdelse af fødevare- og temperaturkrav

• Sparring med ledelsen om, hvad der virker, og hvad der skal justeres i platformen

VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU

• Er struktureret og systematisk — du kan lide, når tingene har en fast plads og en fast rutine

• Har erfaring fra lager, gerne med plukopgaver og lagerstyringssystemer

• Er tryg ved at arbejde digitalt og ikke bange for at lære et nyt system at kende

• Kan holde overblik og tempo i sæsonens travle perioder

• Ikke er bange for at tage fat — du er med på gulvet, ikke bag et skrivebord

Truckkort er en fordel, men ikke et krav — det kan du tage, når du er startet. Erfaring fra fødevare-, køle- eller frostlager er også et plus. Det vigtigste er, at du er ordentlig, mødestabil og har lyst til at tage ejerskab.

VI TILBYDER

• En nøglerolle i en virksomhed i vækst, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling

• Et konkret og synligt projekt: du er med til at sætte de arbejdsgange, vi kommer til at bruge i mange år

• En uformel arbejdsplads med et lille, praktisk team og direkte adgang til ledelsen

• Løn efter kvalifikationer

PRAKTISK

Arbejdssted: Holmgaardvej 49, 7660 Bækmarksbro

Ansættelsestype: Deltid eller fuldtid — vi tilpasser timetallet efter den rette kandidat

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt

SÅDAN SØGER DU

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@khv.dk med "Lageransvarlig" i emnefeltet. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette — så send gerne hurtigt.

Se hele stillingen på klosterhedensvildt.dk/job

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til Peter Astrup på 71 80 60 00.

jobs.title: Sushikock

Svenska och engelska är meriterande, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är att du kan leverera mat av hög kvalitet med snygg presentation och fungerar bra i ett team.

We are looking for someone with experience in sushi who is independent, organized and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Experience in Thai cuisine is a plus.

Swedish and English are a plus, but not a requirement. Most importantly, you can consistently deliver high-quality food with great presentation and work well as part of a team.

jobs.title: Storingstechnieker productie
jobs.description:
Bij Yontec maken we het verschil. Je bent bij ons meer dan een technieker. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze klanten altijd kunnen rekenen op een optimale werking van hun machines.

Via ons werk je op een langdurige opdracht bij een industriële klant (grotendeels productiebedrijven).

  • Hier voer je het preventief en curatief onderhoud uit van het machinepark
  • Los je technische storingen op
  • Help je mee bij de opbouw van nieuwe machines en de ombouw van het machinepark
  • Voor je herstellingen uit

Wil jij deel uitmaken van deze hechte en ervaren groep?

"Word dan storingstechnieker bij Yontec!”

Ben jij de collega die we zoeken?

  • Een storingstechnieker in hart en nieren: Je hebt een aantal jaar ervaring (industriële techniek) en een passie voor techniek.
  • Een probleemoplosser: Je bent analytisch sterk en vindt creatieve oplossingen voor complexe problemen.
  • Een teamspeler: Je werkt graag samen met collega's en deelt je kennis graag.
  • Flexibel ingesteld: Je bent bereid om in verschillende ploegen te werken en je aan te passen aan veranderende omstandigheden.

jobs.description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.


We’re looking for a UX copywriter to join our copy team and help bring the Zilch brand to life across every digital customer touchpoint.

Your primary focus will be partnering with Product Design to create clear and intuitive experiences across our app and website. Working closely with product designers, product managers and engineers, you'll contribute to creating customer journeys from discovery through to launch.

You'll also collaborate with teams across the business, including Marketing, Customer Support and Operations, providing specialist copy support wherever it's needed – from SEO content and help articles to customer communications and product launches.

This isn't just about writing functional copy. It's about creating experiences customers understand, trust and enjoy. You'll know when to keep things simple, when to inject personality and how to bring the Zilch tone of voice to life in even the smallest moments.

We're looking for a creative and tactical thinker who understands that great UX copy does more than guide users from A to B. It solves problems, removes friction and creates experiences that feel simple, human and unmistakably Zilch.

Day to day responsibilities.

  • Partner with Product Design to create clear, engaging copy across the app and website, from new features to end-to-end customer journeys.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers and engineers throughout the product development process, from discovery through to launch.

  • Write and optimise customer-facing content across digital touchpoints, including help articles, FAQs, SEO content and operational communications.

  • Balance customer needs, business goals and regulatory requirements to create content that's clear, helpful and compliant.

  • Use customer insight, data and testing to improve the content and customer journeys.

  • Champion accessibility, consistency and best practice in UX writing and content design.

  • Support wider business priorities with copy for product launches, campaigns and new initiatives when needed.

What we’re looking for...

  • You're a brilliant writer with experience creating content for digital products. Whether you've called yourself a UX Writer, Content Designer or Copywriter, you know how to use words to solve problems.

  • You can switch effectively between product thinking and brand thinking. One minute you're refining onboarding copy, the next you're shaping a product launch or crafting a headline that makes someone smile.

  • You know that the best digital experiences don't happen by accident. You're curious, ask the right questions and enjoy getting to the root of a problem before putting pen to paper.

  • You care about craft. Every word has a purpose, every interaction has intent and you're never afraid to rewrite something until it feels just right.

  • You understand our tone of voice and apply it consistently across customer communications, recognising how a brand comes to life through product. You know how to create experiences that feel consistent, human and unmistakably Zilch.

  • You're a natural collaborator who enjoys bouncing ideas around with designers, product managers, marketers and developers. You know the best work happens when different disciplines come together.

  • You're comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve, and you enjoy the variety that comes with it.

jobs.description:
What is the job?

Ready to take the next step in your leadership career and make a real impact within a rapidly growing, patient-focused organisation?

We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Team Leader or Manager to join us as a Pharmacy Team Lead. This is an exciting opportunity to bring your leadership experience into a fast-paced healthcare environment, supporting, motivating and developing a high-performing team across both weekday and weekend shifts.

You do not need previous pharmacy experience or a pharmacy qualification for this role. What we are looking for is someone with strong people leadership experience who knows how to run a successful shift, manage competing priorities, support their team and maintain high standards in a busy operational environment.

As Pharmacy Team Lead, you will be right at the heart of our day-to-day pharmacy operations. This is a hands-on role where no two days will be the same. You will help coordinate shifts, manage changing priorities, resolve operational challenges and provide clear, confident guidance to colleagues.

You will act as a visible and approachable point of leadership on shift, ensuring workloads are managed effectively, standards are consistently maintained and any issues are identified and addressed quickly. You will also support the development of your colleagues through regular feedback, coaching and encouragement, helping them build their confidence, strengthen their skills and take pride in the service they provide.

Working closely with the Pharmacy Manager and wider Pharmacy Operations team, you will help drive continuous improvement across the pharmacy. Whether it’s finding better ways of working, improving efficiency, strengthening communication or supporting the implementation of new processes, you will have the opportunity to contribute ideas and make a genuine difference to how we operate.

This role would be perfect for someone who thrives in a busy environment, enjoys bringing people together and is ready to take greater ownership and responsibility. You will need to be organised, proactive and calm under pressure, with the confidence to make decisions, support colleagues and maintain excellent standards.

You don’t need to be a pharmacy expert — you need to be a great leader. We will support you in developing your understanding of our pharmacy environment, processes and requirements.

If you are an experienced Team Leader, Supervisor or Manager who is passionate about people, enjoys a fast-paced environment and is excited by the opportunity to build your knowledge within healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.

What will you be doing?

  • Providing visible, hands-on leadership to the team during your shifts, helping to create a positive, supportive and collaborative working environment

  • Coordinating daily priorities, allocating tasks and managing workloads to ensure operations run safely, efficiently and smoothly

  • Acting as an approachable first point of contact for colleagues, providing guidance, support and encouragement throughout the working day

  • Managing performance and addressing day-to-day people challenges in a fair, supportive and constructive way

  • Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen safety and enhance the overall patient experience

  • Supporting the introduction of new processes, systems and operational improvements across the pharmacy

  • Leading by example and creating a culture where people feel supported, accountable and motivated to perform at their best

  • Helping the team deliver a safe, accurate, efficient and exceptional service to every patient

What do you need?

  • Previous experience leading, supervising or managing a team in a busy environment

  • Experience managing day-to-day operations, workloads, priorities and staffing requirements

  • Strong people management skills, with the ability to motivate, coach and develop colleagues

  • The confidence to make decisions, resolve challenges and take ownership of issues through to completion

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and keep operations running smoothly during busy periods

  • Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to build positive working relationships across different teams

  • A supportive and approachable leadership style, with a genuine interest in helping others succeed

We are particularly interested in people who have worked as a Team Leader, Assistant Manager, Supervisor, Operations Manager, Store Manager, Contact Centre Team Leader, Warehouse Team Leader or in another people-management position where they have been responsible for leading a team and keeping day-to-day operations running effectively.

jobs.title: Creator Success Representative
jobs.description:
Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

As Fanvue scales, we need to protect and grow revenue across our mid-to-long-tail creator base without relying on 1:1 CSM ratios. The Pooled CSM model is how we do that: one person owning a large book of creators through data-driven playbooks, automated workflows, and targeted interventions.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Pooled Creator Success Manager to own retention and revenue outcomes across a portfolio of 500+ creators in a 1:many, tech-touch model.

This is not a traditional CSM seat. You will not have a handful of named accounts and weekly check-ins. Instead, you will build and run scalable playbooks, monitor risk and contraction signals across a large cohort, and intervene where the data tells you to. Think CS operations meets account management.

You will report to Thea and work closely with the wider Creator Success team.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Own a pooled book of 500+ creators with full accountability for gross revenue retention

  • Build, maintain, and iterate playbooks that drive retention, reduce contraction, and surface expansion opportunities at scale

  • Monitor creator health signals (engagement drops, earnings decline, support ticket spikes) and run targeted interventions before churn materialises

  • Run a weekly cadence: risk alerts, contraction monitoring, playbook execution reviews

  • Design and automate lifecycle touchpoints (onboarding sequences, re-engagement campaigns, feature adoption nudges) through CS platform workflows

  • Support the broader CS team by providing pooled coverage as more creators move out of dedicated 1:1 management

  • Provide reactive support to creators in the pooled segment when risks, problems, or support needs arise

  • Partner with Product, Support, Moderation, and Growth to close feedback loops and improve creator outcomes

  • Track and report on cohort-level retention, contraction, and engagement metrics

👀 Who You Are

  • Experienced in Customer Success, Account Management, or CS Operations, ideally in a tech-touch or SMB/scale segment

  • Hands-on experience with a CS platform (health scoring, playbook automation, lifecycle workflows)

  • Comfortable building playbooks, automations, and health scores from scratch, not just running someone else's

  • Data-literate: you can pull insights from dashboards, spot trends in cohort data, and translate them into actions

  • Strong written communicator who can craft clear, concise creator-facing messaging at scale

  • Comfortable managing a large book through systems and signals rather than personal relationships

  • Self-directed and structured, you set your own cadence and hold yourself accountable

  • Familiar with the creator economy, subscription platforms, or marketplace models (a plus, not a must)

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You like building systems more than managing relationships one by one

  • You get energy from finding patterns in data and acting on them before anyone asks

  • You want ownership of a segment, not just a task list

  • You are motivated by retention metrics and commercial outcomes

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You prefer deep 1:1 relationships over scaled models

  • You need someone else to build your workflows and tell you what to automate

  • You are uncomfortable with ambiguity or building processes from zero

  • You wait for problems to surface rather than hunting for them

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The problems you solve here are real and immediate

  • AI-native engineering: we are not bolting AI on. It is core to our product and how we build

  • Series A momentum: triple-digit growth means the problems you solve today define the platform for years

  • Fully remote with unlimited PTO, flexible working hours, a London office and WeWork access when you want it

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Travel and office budgets for team off-sites or kitting out your home setup

  • Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we're actively building out

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

jobs.title: Detaljberedare inom skärning och bränning
jobs.description:
Vi söker en Detaljberedare inom skärning och bränning för ett konsultuppdrag inom marin industri. Rollen innebär arbete i både nybyggnads- och modifieringsprojekt av ubåtar och ytfartyg, med nära samarbete mellan konstruktion, teknisk beredning och produktion.

Om uppdraget

Som Detaljberedare ansvarar du för att ta fram produktionsunderlag och beredningar för skärning och bränning. Du arbetar med att omsätta konstruktionsunderlag till effektiva och genomförbara produktionslösningar anpassade efter produktionsanläggningens utrustning och processer.

En central del av arbetet är att skapa DXF-filer, nestningar och produktionsunderlag för skärning. Du planerar beredningen med fokus på ett effektivt produktionsgenomförande och lämnar därefter över det färdiga underlaget till produktionen.

När tillverkningen startar fungerar du även som stöd till produktionen och bidrar till att hantera frågor och eventuella justeringar som uppkommer i samband med produktionsstart.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

    Skapa och hantera DXF-filer för produktion.
    Skapa nestningar och produktionsunderlag för skärning och bränning.
    Bereda och planera arbetet utifrån produktionsanläggningens utrustning och processer.
    Säkerställa att beredningsunderlag är anpassade för ett effektivt produktionsgenomförande.
    Överlämna färdiga beredningar till produktionen.
    Stödja produktionspersonalen vid uppstart av tillverkningen.
    Genomföra löpande avstämningar med produktionen.
    Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med tekniska beredare, produktionstekniker och konstruktörer.
    Medverka i utveckling och integration av nya tekniska lösningar i produktionen.

Vi söker dig som har en teknisk bakgrund och erfarenhet av beredning inom tillverkande industri, gärna med inriktning mot skärning, bränning eller liknande produktionsprocesser.

Relevant erfarenhet omfattar exempelvis:

    Detaljberedning eller produktionsberedning.
    Framtagning och hantering av DXF-filer.
    Nestning och framtagning av skärunderlag.
    Skär- och brännprocesser inom industriell produktion.
    Framtagning och kvalitetssäkring av produktionsunderlag.
    Produktionsnära arbete inom tillverkande industri.
    Samarbete mellan konstruktion, produktion och produktionsteknik.
    Erfarenhet från varvsindustri, marin verksamhet, tung industri eller annan komplex tillverkande verksamhet är relevant för uppdraget.

Personliga egenskaper

Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och passar dig som arbetar strukturerat och har lätt för att samarbeta med olika tekniska funktioner. Du behöver kunna hantera både självständigt beredningsarbete och löpande dialog med produktionen kring praktiska produktionsfrågor.

Mejla CV och en kort presentation till info@ndpconsult.se. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande.

jobs.title: Medicinskt ansvarig för rehabilitering (MAR) med fokus på utveckling
jobs.description:
Vill du ha inflytande och vara delaktig i utvecklingsarbetet på din arbetsplats? Då är du välkommen till Tranemo kommun. Här verkar vi för stark känsla av samhörighet och uppmuntran till inflytande och delaktighet. Vi erbjuder gott ledarskap och bra arbetsvillkor. Vi levererar tjänster med god service och hög kvalitet och söker efter engagerade medarbetare som vill vara med och bygga framtidens Tranemo.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vill du spela en nyckelroll i utvecklingen av kommunens hälso- och sjukvård? Nu söker vi dig som vill kombinera det strategiska MAR uppdraget med ett utvecklingsorienterat arbete inom Tranemo kommuns hälso- och sjukvård.



Du blir en del av Omsorgssektionen, en verksamhet med cirka 700 medarbetare (varav 200 timvikarier) fördelade på Myndighet/Hälso- och sjukvård, Äldreomsorg och Funktionsnedsättning. Du kommer att ingå i Omsorgssektionens ledningsgrupp.



Som MAR ansvarar du för att kommunens rehabilitering, habilitering och hjälpmedelsverksamhet bedrivs säkert, ändamålsenligt och i enlighet med lagstiftningen. Du säkerställer en trygg och professionell vård genom utveckling och uppföljning av rutiner, journalgranskning, rådgivning samt utreder avvikelser för eventuellt anmälan enligt lex Maria. Tillsammans med MAS genomför du verksamhetsuppföljningar och arbetar aktivt med att stärka kvalitet och patientsäkerheten.



Du omvärldsbevakar forskning, lagstiftning, nya rön och har en central roll i utvecklingen av God och nära vård. Som rådgivare inom rehabilitering, habilitering och hjälpmedel skapar du goda förutsättningar för både patienter och medarbetare. Du representerar Tranemo kommun i samverkansforum med andra kommuner.



Du ansvarar för att driva och stödja utvecklingen av digitala arbetssätt och välfärdsteknik inom kommunens hälso- och sjukvård med fokus på rehabiliteringsområdet, i syfte att stärka kvalitet, patientsäkerhet, effektivitet och den enskildes självständighet. Vilket medför utredningsuppdrag, projektledning och att stötta chefer och medarbetare i förändrings- och förbättringsprocesser.

KVALIFIKATIONER
    • Vi söker dig som är legitimerad fysioterapeut eller arbetsterapeut med mycket god kännedom om relevant lagstiftning och förmåga att omsätta den i praktiken.
    • Du har flera års erfarenhet från yrket, gärna inom kommunal hälso- och sjukvård, och är van att följa forskning, nya rön och regelverk.
    • Du har goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift, god IT-vana och innehar B- körkort.
    • Som person är du analytisk, strukturerad och ansvarstagande.
    • Du kommunicerar tydligt, har en pedagogisk förmåga och lätt för samarbete. Detta gör att du trivs i en roll där du driver utveckling framåt med både integritet och engagemang.



    • Erfarenhet av patientsäkerhetsarbete, teamarbete, välfärdstekniska lösningar och utvecklings- eller förändringsarbete är meriterande.
    • Erfarenhet av uppdrag som MAR eller övergripande utredare är meriterande.  

Hos oss får du möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad både för patienter och för utvecklingen av kommunens hälso- och sjukvård. Du blir en del av en organisation som satsar på kvalitet, innovation och långsiktig hållbarhet, där din kompetens och ditt omdöme verkligen värdesätts. Här arbetar vi nära varandra, med korta beslutsvägar och ett klimat som uppmuntrar initiativ, samarbete och nytänkande.  



Stor vikt kommer läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2027-01-01  .

jobs.title: Junior Quality Control Assistant
jobs.description:
Är du noggrann, strukturerad och riktigt vass på Excel och digitala arbetssätt? Vill du arbeta med kvalitet i en reglerad verksamhet där detaljer, dokumentation och spårbarhet är avgörande?

Vi söker nu en Junior Quality Control Assistant till en kvalitetsavdelning inom livsmedelsindustrin. Rollen passar dig som är i början av din karriär och vill utvecklas inom Quality Control, GMP och kvalitetssäkring. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – viktigast är att du har huvudet på skaft, är snabblärd och tycker om att skapa ordning i en komplex miljö.

Om rollen

Du arbetar nära QC, QA, produktion och laboratoriepersonal för att säkerställa att tillverkade batcher uppfyller fastställda specifikationer och kvalitetskrav innan de frisläpps.

Arbetet har ett tydligt fokus på granskning, dokumentation och administration. Du behöver därför vara bekväm med att hantera stora mängder information och kontrollera att varje detalj är korrekt.

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:

- Granska batchprotokoll och tillhörande kvalitetsdokumentation

- Kontrollera att samtliga analys- och kontrollresultat är godkända

- Medverka vid slutkontroll och frisläppning av batcher

- Utfärda Certificate of Analysis (CoA) och Certificate of Compliance (CoC)

- Säkerställa att dokumentationen är komplett, korrekt och spårbar

- Skanna, digitalisera och arkivera batchprotokoll

- Ta fram etikettmastrar och skriva ut batchunderlag till produktionen

- Stoppa frisläppning och rapportera vidare om något avviker

- Vid behov genomföra och dokumentera enklare kvalitetskontroller

- Bidra till att verksamheten följer GMP, ISO 22000, HACCP och interna kvalitetsrutiner

Vi söker dig som

- Är mycket noggrann, strukturerad och kvalitetsmedveten

- Har god datorvana och är trygg i Excel och andra digitala system

- Har lätt för att förstå och följa instruktioner, processer och regelverk

- Kan hantera flera informationsflöden utan att tappa detaljer

- Kommunicerar väl på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt

- Är ansvarstagande, nyfiken och vågar reagera när något inte stämmer

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från en reglerad verksamhet, exempelvis livsmedel, läkemedel, medicinteknik, laboratorieverksamhet eller tillverkande industri. Kunskap om GMP, ISO 9001, ISO 22000, HACCP, kemisk analys eller kemikaliehantering är också meriterande.

Du kan exempelvis vara nyutexaminerad inom kemi, biomedicin, livsmedel, processteknik eller kvalitet – alternativt ha skaffat dig motsvarande kunskaper genom praktisk erfarenhet.

För att lyckas i rollen

Du behöver inte vara en senior QC-specialist. Däremot behöver du vara en person som ser detaljer, arbetar metodiskt och förstår vikten av att dokumentationen blir helt rätt. Du trivs i en händelserik miljö, lär dig snabbt och tar ansvar för att driva dina uppgifter hela vägen i mål.

Mejla CV och en kort presentation till info@ndpconsult.se. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande.

jobs.title: Sushi and á la carte chef - with accommodation
jobs.description:
Olavs Kroa in Porsgrunn is looking for an experienced Sushi & À La Carte Chef to join our team. We offer a full-time permanent position, competitive salary, and accommodation for the right candidate.

Hva vi ser etter

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Sushi & À La Carte Chef who is passionate about food and quality.


The ideal candidate:


  • Has proven experience preparing sushi and à la carte dishes.

  • Can work independently and efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen.

  • Is reliable, responsible, and has a positive attitude.

  • Pays close attention to food quality, presentation, and hygiene.

  • Speaks English. Knowledge of a Scandinavian language is an advantage but not required.

Arbeidsoppgaver

As our Sushi & À La Carte Chef, you will be responsible for:


  • Preparing high-quality sushi and à la carte dishes.

  • Ensuring food quality, presentation, and consistency.

  • Maintaining a clean and organized kitchen.

  • Following food safety and hygiene regulations.

  • Managing food preparation and daily kitchen operations.

  • Working efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Contributing to a positive and professional team atmosphere.

Vi tilbyr

We offer a full-time permanent position in a busy and well-established restaurant in Porsgrunn, Norway.


  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

  • Accommodation can be provided for the right candidate.

  • A friendly, supportive, and professional working environment.

  • Stable employment with opportunities for long-term cooperation.

  • Immediate start or by agreement.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Olavs Kroa is a well-established restaurant located in Porsgrunn, Norway. We serve both local guests and visitors, offering a varied menu with a strong focus on quality and fresh ingredients. We are looking for a skilled Sushi & À La Carte Chef who would like to become part of our friendly and professional team.

jobs.title: Svømmeinstruktør / Svømmetrener - Aktiv deltidsjobb i vannet - Trondheim
jobs.description:
Har du interesse for svømming og liker å jobbe med mennesker? Ønsker du en meningsfull jobb hvor du bidrar til å lære barn, ungdom og voksne en livsviktig ferdighet? Svømmepartner AS søker engasjerte og motiverte svømmeinstruktører og svømmetrenere til våre kurs og aktiviteter.

Hva vi ser etter

Hvem passer stillingen for?

Noen som vil ha en deltidsstilling ved siden av studier eller annen jobb, eller ønsker å utvikle seg som instruktør og trener. I denne stillingen er det fult mulig å jobbe en gang i uka.

Stillingen passer både for deg som har lang erfaring fra svømming, og for deg som er trygg i vann, ønsker å utvikle deg som instruktør og har et genuint ønske om å lære bort.

Vi legger stor vekt på personlig egnethet, engasjement og evnen til å skape trygghet og mestring i vann.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Send oss en søknad og fortell litt om deg selv, din erfaring og hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe hos Svømmepartner AS.

Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Arbeidsoppgaver

Vi ser etter deg som:

• Er glad i å jobbe med barn, ungdom og voksne.

• Er svømmedyktig og kan bestå livredningstest.

• Er ansvarsbevisst, positiv og samarbeidsvillig.

• Er 18 år eller eldre. - Vi er også åpne for å ansette seriøse og motiverte søkere fra 16 år dersom de har erfaring fra svømming.


Det er en fordel dersom du har:

• Erfaring fra svømming, enten som utøver eller trener.

• Erfaring som svømmeinstruktør eller svømmetrener.

• Erfaring med undervisning eller arbeid med barn.

Dette er ønskelig, men ikke et krav. Har du ikke instruktørerfaring, men er motivert for å lære og undervise, oppfordrer vi deg likevel til å søke.


Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr:

• Opplæring og oppfølging.

• Stillingene vi har er fra 6% - 25% (etter hvor mye søker kan arbeide).

• Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer.

• En variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag.

• Muligheten til å gjøre en forskjell ved å lære andre en viktig livsferdighet.

• Fleksible arbeidstider, hovedsakelig ettermiddag, kveld og helg.



Om arbeidsgiveren:

Svømmepartner AS tilbyr svømmeopplæring for barn, ungdom og voksne. Selskapet har et bredt kurstilbud, hovedsaklig i samarbeid med andre aktører. Virksomheten er til stede på en rekke lokasjoner i Trondheim.

jobs.title: Fast forskerstilling innen informasjonsteori i Bergen
jobs.description:
Simula UiB is a research institute in Cryptography and Information Theory based in Bergen, Norway. We are seeking a Research Scientist or Senior Research Scientist for a permanent position in the Department of Information Theory, specialising in either machine learning or quantum information science

Hva vi ser etter

Candidate Profile

We are seeking candidates with a PhD in information theory, computer science, applied mathematics or a related discipline, with expertise in machine learning and/or quantum information science.

Research track record: The successful candidate should be able to conduct both independent and collaborative, high-impact research and have experience in statistical learning theory, privacy-preserving machine learning, or quantum information theory, demonstrated through publications in leading international venues. Expertise in related areas, such as coding theory or information-theoretic privacy and security more broadly, will be an advantage.

Supervision and scientific leadership: We are particularly interested in applicants with supervisory experience, including supervising PhD students and junior researchers. Experience contributing to research leadership, including shaping collaborative research activities or developing new research directions, will be highly valued. While the position carries no formal teaching obligations, opportunities may arise through collaborations with partner universities to contribute to teaching or supervision of master's and undergraduate students.

Project and grant management: The successful candidate should have experience in managing research projects. Experience in securing competitive research funding is highly desirable.

Other: We are looking for a motivated and collaborative researcher who will contribute positively to the research environment at Simula UiB. Excellent communication skills and fluency in spoken and written English are required.

Arbeidsoppgaver

We are currently hiring a permanent (senior) research scientist to conduct research in either machine learning (ML), including statistical learning theory and distributed and privacy-preserving computation, or quantum information science, including quantum information theory, quantum error-correction, quantum computing and communications, and quantum algorithms. As an integral part of the research, the successful candidate is expected to supervise and mentor early-career researchers (PhD students and postdoctoral researchers) and contribute positively to the collaborative research environment at Simula UiB and our international research profile. The appointee will play an active role in developing externally funded research activities at Simula UiB, including preparing and coordinating research proposals at both the national and European levels, particularly through programmes such as the Research Council of Norway (RCN) and Horizon Europe, including the European Research Council (ERC).

Simula UiB is part of the Simula group (www.simula.no), a leading research institute in Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in Norway. The Simula group values diversity and promotes an inclusive and international working environment, with around 180 members of staff from 37 countries. We aim to provide a family-friendly workplace and are an equal opportunity employer, especially encouraging women to apply. More information about the culture at Simula: www.simula.no/about/simula-culture.

Vi tilbyr

The Department of Information Theory at Simula UiB conducts research on two main areas: statistical learning theory and quantum information theory. It currently comprises 9 members, including permanent staff, postdoctoral researchers and PhD students, and is led by Dr Eirik Rosnes. Simula UiB also hosts the Centre for Quantum Communication Networks and Applications (QCNA), one of Norway's four national centres for quantum technology research. Launched in May 2026, QCNA has eight academic and industry partners, and includes distributed quantum applications as a core research theme. The Department of Information Theory is also part of Centre for Sustainable, Risk-averse and Ethical AI (SURE-AI), one of Norway's six national centres for AI research. As a member of the Department of Information Theory, the successful candidate will have opportunities to contribute to activities within both the QCNA and SURE-AI centres.

Simula UiB offers:

  • An ambitious and internationally oriented research environment with excellent opportunities to conduct high-quality research in information theory/machine learning/quantum information science.

  • A highly collaborative and intellectually vibrant department, with close interaction among permanent researchers, postdocs and PhD students, as well as with national and international partners.

  • An informal, inclusive and international working environment.

  • Support for travel and opportunities to build international networks.

  • Modern office facilities, located at Marineholmen in the city centre of Bergen.

  • A competitive salary commensurate with qualifications and experience.

  • Administrative research support, such as a quality assurance process for grant proposals and budgeting assistance.

  • Professional development and researcher training opportunities (see Simula Academy).

  • Numerous employee benefits, including access to a company cabin, sponsored social events, an equipment budget, and a comprehensive travel/health insurance policy.

  • Relocation assistance, including accommodation, visas and complimentary Norwegian language courses.

  • Healthy wellness and work-life balance arrangements.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Simula UiB AS is a research institute owned by Simula Research Laboratory AS and the University of Bergen (UiB). It collaborates closely with leading universities in Norway and abroad, both in research and in the education of master's and PhD students. One of its goals is to strengthen Norway's cyber security expertise through research and education in cryptography and information theory.

Simula UiB provides an ambitious and internationally oriented research environment, with a strong focus on high-quality fundamental and applied research, international collaboration, and long-term scientific impact. In the recent EVALMIT research evaluation conducted by the Norwegian Research Council, Simula UiB was rated "internationally outstanding in terms of research output and very good to excellent in terms of collaboration with industry and public sector partners."
