jobs.title: Vil du bli en viktig del av hverdagen min?
jobs.employer: MEDVIND ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
Jeg er en gutt på 14 år som ser etter en trygg, positiv og engasjert BPA-assistent som kan bli en del av teamet mitt. Rollen som BPA-assistent er variert, og ingen dager er helt like. Jeg trenger deg som kan være en trygg støtte i hverdagen og bidra til at dagene mine blir gode og meningsfulle. Hvem er du? Jeg ser etter deg som trives sammen med ungdom og er god på å danne relasjoner. Du er trygg, tålmodig og omsorgsfull, og du må kunne by på deg selv. Det er viktig for meg at du er pålitelig, omtenksom og har et ønske om å bidra til at både små og store øyeblikk i hverdagen blir gode. Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å ha erfaring som BPA-assistent fra før. Det viktigste er at du er en person som ønsker å bli kjent med meg og som kan være en trygg og positiv støtte i hverdagen min.   Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Være med på aktiviteter hjemme og ute
  • Bistå med personlig hygiene og daglige rutiner
  • Være en støttespiller i sosiale sammenhenger
  • Gi trygghet og struktur i hverdagen
Du må ha førerkort klasse B, siden assistentene mine henter meg på skolen ved skoleslutt. Jeg har min egen bil. Du må også ha plettfri vandel. Arbeidstid Stillingen er deltid/tilkalling, med gode muligheter for jobb både i hverdager og i ferier. Arbeidstid avtales nærmere med familien. Vi tilbyr
  • En meningsfull jobb der du virkelig gjør en forskjell
  • God opplæring og støtte
  • Et inkluderende og hyggelig arbeidsmiljø
  • Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser
For rette kandidat er det klart for oppstart og opplæring snarest. Jeg og foreldrene mine vil vurdere søknader fortløpende, så ikke nøl med å sende inn din. Nå vet du litt om meg, og jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg – kanskje blir du en del av teamet mitt!  
Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Norge søker en nasjonal ekspert til Hybridsenteret i Helsingfors
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Hybridsenteret utfører policyarbeid som støtter medlemslandene i å forstå og håndtere utfordringene som hybride trusler skaper. Arbeidet innebærer blant annet å utarbeide selvstendige analyser, bestille og administrere analytiske prosjekter blant annet fra akademia, og presentere Hybridsenterets arbeid på konferanser og webinarer.

Den norske stillingen vil være særlig rettet mot hybride trusler i nordområdene og vil spille en viktig rolle i forbindelse med Hybridsenterets arbeid på dette feltet.

Sikkerhetspolitisk avdeling i Utenriksdepartementet vil ha arbeidsgiveransvaret og koordinere den faglige oppfølgingen av den nasjonale eksperten.


Ansvarsområder og oppgaver

Som sekondert nasjonal ekspert til Hybridsenteret vil du ha følgende ansvar og oppgaver:

  • Utarbeide analyser og kunnskapsgrunnlag om hybride trusler i Arktis
  • Videreutvikle kompetansen på hybride trusler i Arktis i samarbeid med leder, basert på spesifiserte behov for nøkkelkompetanse og utviklingen i regionen
  • Presentere forskning i regi av Hybridsenteret på internasjonale konferanser, webinarer og policybrifinger
  • Bygge nettverk med representanter for medlemslandene, akademiske fagmiljøer og andre relevante aktører

Kvalifikasjoner

For å være kvalifisert må du

  • ha utdanning på minimum mastergradsnivå innen internasjonale relasjoner, statsvitenskap, økonomi, etterretning, studieretninger med fokus på nordområdene eller annet relevant område
  • ha minimum tre års arbeidserfaring fra relevante fagområder
  • ha meget gode skriftlige og muntlige kommunikasjonsevner på engelsk
  • være norsk statsborger
  • kunne sikkerhetsklareres for NATO SECRET

Det er ønskelig at du har

  • bakgrunn fra sikkerhetspolitiske spørsmål, inkludert hybride trusler
  • Internasjonal arbeidserfaring

Vi tilbyr

I denne stillingen vil du få muligheten til å

  • bidra i arbeidet med aktuelle sikkerhetspolitiske utfordringer i Arktis
  • bli en del av et ledende internasjonalt fagmiljø på hybride trusler
  • utvikle faglige og personlige nettverk
  • få verdifull arbeidserfaring fra en internasjonal organisasjon

Stillingen er en midlertidig ansettelse i inntil tre år på vilkår som følger retningslinjene for nasjonale eksperter til EU, etter avtale med Utenriksdepartementet.


Om deg

For å lykkes i stillingen er det viktig at du

  • arbeider selvstendig og strukturert
  • bygger sterke relasjoner og nettverk på tvers av fagmiljøer og landegrenser
  • er god på formidling av komplekse problemstillinger
  • har gode samarbeidsevner og er fleksibel
  • har høy personlig integritet og høy etisk standard

Vi vil legge vekt på personlig egnethet.


Behandling av personopplysninger ved søknader til Hybridsenteret

Når du søker på sekonderingen til Hybridsenteret gjennom Norec, må vi sende opplysninger om deg videre til de rekrutterende departementene (Forsvarsdepartementet, Justis- og beredskapsdepartementet og Utenriksdepartementet) og til HR-representanter ved Hybridsenteret. Søknaden, CV-en og vedleggene må derfor være på engelsk.

Ved å søke på stillingene samtykker du til at vi kan dele personopplysningene dine, inkludert CV og vitnemål, med disse partene i rekrutteringsprosessen. Filene blir kryptert og passordbeskyttet før de sendes fra Norec, for å ivareta sikkerheten til personopplysningene dine.

Har du spørsmål til hvordan vi behandler personopplysningene dine, kan du kontakte oss på fn_stillinger@norec.no
 

Du kan be om å bli unntatt fra den offentlige søkerlisten. I så fall må du begrunne ønsket. Vi kontakter deg dersom ønsket ditt ikke blir innvilget.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hybridsenteret i Helsingfors er en autonom, nettverksbasert internasjonal organisasjon som arbeider for å styrke sikkerheten i medlemslandene ved å motvirke hybride trusler. Senteret ble etablert i 2017 og er åpent for alle medlemsland i EU og NATO. I dag har senteret 35 medlemsland. 

Hybridsenteret legger til rette for og binder sammen arbeidet i medlemslandene samt i EU og NATO, og legger til rette for samarbeid om hybride trusler blant annet gjennom felles øvelser. Disse inkluderer scenarioer der hybride trusler benyttes under terskelen for væpnet konflikt, og som ledd i krigføring. 

I tillegg til å tilby ekspertise, opplæring og nettverk, utvikler Hybridsenteret strategier og bidrar med implementering av disse. Senteret støtter også nettverk som går på tvers av stater og sektorer i medlemslandene.

Norge har vært medlem av Hybridsenteret siden høsten 2017. 

Mer informasjon finnes på Hybridsenterets hjemmesider.

Medlemsstatene kan sekondere nasjonale eksperter til senteret. Utenriksdepartementet, Forsvarsdepartementet og Justis- og beredskapsdepartementet har besluttet å etablere en norsk stilling ved senteret fra januar 2027. Stillingen har en varighet på inntil tre år. Arbeidsstedet er i Hybridsenterets moderne kontorlokaler i sentrum av Helsingfors. Senteret tilbyr et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og har et internt opplæringsprogram for alle ansatte.

jobs.title: Researcher in Food Control Literature Review
jobs.description:
Department of Animal Biosciences

We are looking for a researcher for a fixed-term position to conduct a scientific literature review on the effects of official food control.

About the position

We are looking for a motivated, thorough and responsible person to join our team. You will work independently on a project, with ongoing support and collaboration from the rest of the team.

A key part of the role will be to conduct a systematic literature review on the effects of official food control. The review will examine how food control influences the behaviour of food businesses and their compliance with food legislation. It will also assess which control methods and approaches have the strongest evidence of improving food safety, compliance, and the accuracy of information provided to consumers, such as food labelling.

Your main tasks will include searching for scientific literature, selecting relevant studies based on the project’s research questions, assessing the quality of the studies, and compiling and analysing the results. You will also identify gaps in current knowledge and areas where further research is needed. The role may also involve conducting interviews with relevant stakeholders, mainly in the Nordic countries.

Your profile

We are looking for someone with a PhD or other documented experience of conducting literature reviews and/or evidence reviews. Previous experience of food control, or other types of regulatory control or inspection, would be an advantage. You will be part of a supportive team while working independently and taking responsibility for this specific task. The applicant must have very good ability to read and write in English. Knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.

About us

The Department of Animal Biosciences is part of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Science and is responsible for education and research in several basic and applied areas. These areas include anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, pharmacology, toxicology, genetics, breeding, immunology, bacteriology, virology, parasitology, epizootology, comparative medicine, food safety, bioinformatics and One Health. Our research covers everything from production animals to sports and pet animals, laboratory animals and wild animals. The department's researchers work on the entire scale from molecular mechanisms and microbiology to the structure, function and behaviour of animals, and how these are affected by breeding, physical activity, care, production, stress, environmental factors and diseases.

For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/Animal-Biosciences/

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. jobs.title: Payroll Controller, Norway
jobs.description:
Company Description

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

Job Description

We are now looking for a Payroll Controller to join our finance team in Radisson Hotel Group!

As our Payroll Controller, Norway, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate, timely and compliant payroll across our Norwegian entities. Working closely with HR, Operations, Accounting, HR Tech/IT and our external payroll provider, you will bring strong Norwegian payroll expertise, robust controls and a continuous-improvement mindset to the end-to-end payroll process.

This is a role where your expertise will make a real difference. You will act as the key point of contact for Norwegian payroll, ensuring quality and compliance while identifying opportunities to simplify processes, reduce risk and improve the employee experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the monthly pre- and post-payroll control process, reconciling variances and driving corrective actions with external payroll provider.
  • Ensure accurate calculation and processing of salaries, overtime, allowances, holiday pay, leave balances and statutory deductions.
  • Calculate HR provisions and accruals and manage monthly payroll allocations.
  • Validate employee master data, employee lists and cost-allocation structures.
  • Ensure full compliance with Norwegian payroll legislation and applicable collective agreements.
  • Oversee key Norwegian payroll processes, including NAV sick pay applications and refunds, pension reporting, AFP/AGA and A-melding submissions.
  • Act as the key contact for auditors, statistical reporting and external payroll-related enquiries.
  • Manage the relationship with our external payroll provider, including SLA follow-up, quality management, escalation of issues and reduction of rework and additional service charges.
  • Coordinate Timeplan – payroll provider – SAP integration topics, including interfaces, field mapping, testing and defect resolution.
  • Own monthly reconciliations of payroll-related balance sheet accounts and ensure aged items are investigated and cleared.
  • Import and validate statistical metrics in SAP and perform plan-versus-actual checks.
  • Maintain and strengthen the payroll control framework, including master-data changes, payroll calendars and approval processes.
  • Identify end-to-end process gaps and drive continuous improvement, efficiency and risk reduction.
  • Ensure key Norway payroll consolidation milestones are delivered accurately and on time.
  • Provide functional input and expertise for the 2027 payroll tender.
  • Provide clear timelines, checklists and expectations to hotel PMs/HODs, HR and Finance stakeholders.
  • Deliver targeted training and guidance to relevant stakeholders on payroll processes and requirements.
  • Build strong working relationships across HR Norway, Operations, Controlling, Accounting, HR Tech/IT and external payroll provider.
Qualifications
  • 3-5+ years of relevant Norwegian payroll experience, ideally covering payroll across multiple entities or locations.
  • Expert knowledge of Norwegian payroll legislation, statutory requirements and collective agreements.
  • Strong experience with Timeplan, payroll systems and SAP, or comparable ERP systems.
  • Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations and accounting principles.
  • Experience managing or coordinating with an external payroll provider.
  • Experience with payroll systems integration and working with interfaces, data mapping, testing and issue resolution.
  • Strong analytical skills and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and multiple stakeholders.
  • Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain payroll matters to both HR and non-finance stakeholders.
  • A proactive continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to identify issues and turn them into practical solutions.
  • Experience with project delivery or payroll transformation would be an advantage.
Additional Information

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?

Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

Build a Great Career - No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development - helping you reach your full potential.

Experience the Team Spirit - Join a workplace that’s inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.

Lead with Your Ambition - Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

Enjoy Global & Local Perks - No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

Enjoy benefits such as - up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwide
Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends & Family
Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food & Beverage, Spa and more

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you’re ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.

jobs.title: Ravintolatilojen siivooja, Ruka
jobs.description:
Osa-aikainen siivooja ravintolatilojen siivoukseen

Etsimme asiakkaallemme luotettavia siivoajia ravintolatilojen siivoukseen. Työnkuvasi on siivota ravintolatiloja ja työvuorot tulevat painottumaan pe-ma välillä aamu-/päiväajalle klo. 06:00-13:00, mutta on myös arkivuoroja. Osan työstä pystymme myös suorittamaan klo. 13:00 jälkeenkin, joten työajat ovat joustavat oman käytettävyytesi mukaan. Työpäivien kesto vaihtelee riippuen siivottavasta kohteesta 4-6h. 

Kanssamme sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella työajoistasi, työpäivien määristä viikoittain sekä työajankohdista riippuen mahdollisista muista töistä, joita teet. Työ sopiikin joustavan luonteensa takia erinomaisesti esimerkiksi henkilöille, jotka haluavat osa-aikaisia töitä tai sitten lisätunteja oman työnsä oheen. 

Jotta olisit sopiva työhön, niin täytyy sinun olla valmis siivoamaan välillä hurjaksikin lipeävien juhlien railakkaita jälkiä. Siivoustekniikat, perusperehdytyksen työhön ja uudet ammattimaiset työvälineet tulet saamaan asiakkaaltamme, joten työhön voit hakea vaikka sinulla ei vielä kokemusta siivousalalta olisikaan. Toivomme kuitenkin, että et ole helposti säikähtävää luonnetta, sillä siivoustyön tiimellyksessä voit törmätä tahraan jos toiseenkin 

Tarjolla ei ole erikseen työn puolesta majoitusta, joten ennenkuin haet työtä, niin on sinulla oltava jo majoitus tai asunto lähialueella sekä tietenkin kulkuväline, jos liikut kauempaa kuin Rukan kylältä töihin. 

Palkkaa työtehtävästä maksetaan sopimuksen mukaisesti 12,59-14€/h + lisät kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta noudattaen.

Töitä on tarjolla nopeimmille jo syksystä alkaen ja jatkuen ympäri vuoden sesonkeja kuitenkin mukaillen! 

In english;

Looking for someone living in Ruka or nearby to pick up extra hours in restaurant cleaning!

We are looking for reliable cleaners for our client who are interested in earning extra income through part-time cleaning work. Your job will be to clean restaurant spaces, with shifts primarily scheduled between Friday and Monday in the morning or daytime hours from 6:00AM to 1:00PM. Some tasks can also be completed after 1:00PM, making work hours flexible to fit your availability. The duration of each shift varies depending on the cleaning site, ranging from 4 to 6 hours.

With us, you have the opportunity to negotiate your working hours, the number of workdays per week, and the exact scheduling of shifts based on any other jobs or commitments you may have. Thanks to its flexible nature, this job is perfect for those looking for part-time work or extra hours alongside their primary job. 

To be suitable for this role, you should be prepared to clean up after some wild parties at times! jobs.title: En roll för dig som gillar kvalitet – serviceteamare till Hemfrid Göteborg
jobs.description:
HEMFRID SÖKER DIG SOM VILL ARBETA SOM SERVICETEAMARE I GÖTEBORG/HISINGEN

Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med tjänster i hemmet så som städning, fönsterputs, flyttservice och mycket annat.

HEMSTÄDNING I VÄRLDSKLASS Att jobba med oss på hemfrid innebär att du får ett roligt, varierande jobb inom hemstädning. Som serviceteamare blir du en del av ett sammansvetsat team där du tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar för att göra våra kunders vardag enklare. Du kommer att arbeta med ett härligt gäng från olika delar av världen, där vi stöttar och hjälper varandra för att skapa bästa möjliga service.

Om rollen:

Som serviceteamare är du en del av vårt kvalitetsteam och arbetar nära Area Manager och Field Lead för att säkerställa hög kvalitet i vår leverans. Rollen innebär att du stöttar nya kollegor på fältet, samtidigt som du själv utför start- och storstädningar, fönsterputs och vikariepass. Du kommer även vid behov att genomföra kvalitetskontroller, följa nya medarbetare i deras introduktion samt avlasta med nyckelhantering.

Du är en viktig del i att skapa nöjda kunder, bidra till teamets utveckling och säkerställa att våra arbetssätt håller hög kvalitet. Rollen innebär också löpande dialog och återkoppling till chef samt deltagande i kvalitetsteamsmöten varje månad.

Vi letar efter dig som:

    

Tycker om att jobba i team med andra kollegor

    

Ha tidigare erfarenhet inom städning

    

Är engagerad och vill utvecklas inom städning

    

Pratar svenska eller engelska

    

Kan arbeta flexibla timmar, där arbetstiderna är kl. 8-17

    

Är flexibel att arbeta utan fasta kunder

    

Har giltigt körkort (B)

Vi erbjuder dig:

    

En tillsvidareanställning med en sysselsättningsgrad på 75-90%

    

Kollektivavtal och bra anställningsvillkor

    

Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring, pensionsförsäkring och friskvårdsbidrag

    

Utbildning inom hemstädning med fokus på din utveckling

    

Härliga kollegor från hela världen

Har du några frågor angående tjänsten eller vår rekryteringsprocess är du varmt välkommen att kontakta oss på hr@hemfrid.se.

Nyfiken på var vi söker personal? Upptäck alla områden här!

Hemfrid is Sweden's largest company in home cleaning. We assist our customers with household services such as cleaning, window washing, moving services, and much more.

We are constantly looking for staff who are interested in working with us in Göteborg/Hisingen and other parts of Sweden. Please visit our website www.hemfrid.se/karriar to see other cities where we are hiring.

WORLD-CLASS HOME CLEANING

Working with us at Hemfrid means you’ll have a fun, varied job in home cleaning. As a service team member at Hemfrid, you will be part of a close-knit team, working alongside your colleagues to make our customers' everyday lives easier. As a Serviceteamer, you will be part of our quality team, working closely with the Area Manager and Field Lead to ensure high-quality service delivery. In this role, you will support new colleagues in the field while also performing start and deep cleanings, window cleaning, and substitute shifts. When needed, you will carry out quality checks, accompany new employees during their onboarding, and assist with light administrative tasks.

You play an important role in ensuring customer satisfaction, supporting team development, and maintaining high standards in our workflows. The role also includes continuous communication and feedback to your manager, as well as participation in monthly quality team meetings.

We are looking for someone who:

    

Enjoy working in a team with other colleagues.

    

Have previous experience from a cleaning profession.

    

Is committed and wants to develop within cleaning

    

Speaks Swedish or English

    

Can work flexible hours, 8am-5pm

    

Are flexibel to work without fixed customers

An permanent employment, with an employment rate of 75-90%

    

Collective agreement and good employment conditions

    

Liability insurance, health insurance, pension insurance, and wellness allowance

    

Training in home cleaning with a focus on your development

    

Wonderful colleagues from all over the world

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager - Power Conversion Solutions, Utility-Scale
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Regional Sales Manager to drive sales and business development for our power conversion solutions within the utility-scale renewable energy sector. In this role, you will build and strengthen relationships with key customers, identify new business opportunities, and play a central role in expanding our presence across the region.

Working as part of a small and agile team, you will enjoy a high degree of autonomy and ownership, with a strong focus on delivering ambitious sales targets. The position involves regular travel throughout the region and offers an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-facing environment. While the role does not include direct people management responsibilities, it requires strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions to achieve business growth.

How you’ll make an impact

    Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies for utility-scale power conversion solutions (e.g., inverters, converters for solar, wind, battery storage) to achieve regional revenue and market share goals.
    Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities with utility companies, independent power producers (IPPs), developers, and EPC contractors in the assigned territory.
    Cultivate and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients, understanding their needs and positioning Hitachi Energy solutions effectively.
    Prepare and deliver compelling technical and commercial presentations, proposals, and quotations to clients.
    Negotiate contracts, terms, and conditions to secure profitable sales agreements.
    Collaborate closely with internal teams including engineering, product management, project management, and legal to ensure seamless project execution and customer satisfaction.
    Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats, providing valuable input for product development and strategic planning.
    Participate in industry trade shows, conferences, and events to promote Hitachi Energy's solutions and expand professional networks.
    Provide accurate sales forecasts, reports, and market intelligence to management.
    Ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards.

Your background

    Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field.
    Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive sales experience in the power conversion or renewable energy sector, with a proven track record of selling complex solutions to utility-scale clients.
    In-depth understanding of utility-scale solar, wind, and/or battery energy storage systems and associated power conversion technologies.
    Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and closing skills.
    Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers.
    Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
    Ability to work independently and as part of a global team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
    Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and Microsoft Office Suite.
    Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
    Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; proficiency in other regional languages is a plus.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​

    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
    Psychological support program ​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​
    The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​

jobs.title: Senior Research engineer - R&D Downstream Process Development viral vector
jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?  

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.  

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

We are looking for a Senior Research Engineer to join the Viral Vector Applications R&D section in Uppsala. The team consists of approximately 20 researchers focused on the development and optimization of downstream processes for viral vectors, plasmids, and nucleic acids, including purification, filtration, and analytical workflows. The work is closely connected to product development, translating process understanding into solutions that meet customer needs.

We are now seeking a new colleague who will work with downstream process development activities for viral vector manufacturing. The role focuses on developing, optimizing, and scaling purification processes, with particular emphasis on filtration and chromatography operations. The successful candidate will apply process understanding to improve productivity, robustness, scalability, and manufacturability while supporting the development of next-generation Cytiva technologies.

What You'll Do:

As a Senior Research Engineer, you will focus on the development, optimization, and implementation of filtration and purification processes for AAV and lentiviral vectors, including harvest and clarification of upstream material. Your work will span new product development, product care, and market support projects, always with a strong customer and process performance focus.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Driving process development activities within filtration and downstream purification, including experimental design, method development, and method verification to ensure robust and scalable processes.
    Applying a holistic understanding of the end-to-end workflow (Upstream to Downstream including analytics) to design efficient, integrated process solutions and provide technically sound recommendations aligned with customer needs and regulatory requirements.
    Independently planning, executing, and analyzing experiments in a structured and data-driven manner, and effectively communicating results in project teams and customer interactions.
    Owning and maintaining process-related infrastructure by ensuring proper use, calibration, and upkeep of instrumentation, as well as developing and updating standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support reproducibility and quality.
    Evaluating, proposing, and implementing new technologies and technical solutions within your area, with a focus on improving process efficiency, robustness, and scalability.
    Contributing to scientific dissemination by preparing and delivering posters and oral presentations at conferences, translating process development outcomes into clear and impactful insights.

Who you are:

    You hold a MSc and have at least 5 years of industrial experience in biopharmaceutical process development, particularly within harvest and downstream processing.
    You have hands-on experience in developing and optimizing end-to-end purification processes, with a strong understanding of critical process parameters, scalability, and process robustness. Experience with viral vectors is highly desirable.
    You enjoy working in the lab, bringing structure to complex tasks, and take pride in maintaining clear, accurate, and well-organized documentation.
    You possess strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex process data into clear insights.
    You are fluent in English (spoken and written) and having working proficiency in Swedish in seen as a plus.

It would be a plus if you also possess experience in:

    Experience working with large-scale production equipment is considered a strong advantage and demonstrates your ability to bridge process development and manufacturing.
    You thrive on working in cross-functional teams, where collaboration and communication are essential to drive projects forward. You enjoy working in a dynamic environment and maintain a strong focus on delivering robust, customer-oriented process solutions.

jobs.title: Station Manager  China Eastern Airlines, Stockholm Arlanda Airport
jobs.description:
The Station Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient and compliant operation of China Eastern Airlines' flights at Stockholm Airport and for the overall management of daily station operations.

Key responsibilities include:

    Maintain effective communication and coordination with relevant departments at China Eastern Airlines' headquarters in China, possess a solid understanding of airline station operations and support functions, be proficient in relevant operational and business systems, and be able to quickly undertake station management responsibilities independently;
    Lead and coordinate station operations and related support functions, including maintenance, flight operations and ground handling, ensuring compliance with the Company's safety, operational and service standards;
    Develop and implement station work plans, budgets, operating procedures and management systems covering administration, personnel, training and asset management;
    Manage station personnel, including work allocation, performance management, attendance and training, while ensuring compliance with applicable Swedish employment and workplace requirements;
    Oversee flight operational safety, apron safety and the performance of contracted ground handling service providers, ensuring compliance with applicable civil aviation regulations and Company policies;
    Establish, maintain and implement station emergency response procedures, organize emergency drills and coordinate on-site responses to operational incidents;
    Monitor flight punctuality and operational performance, lead the handling of irregular operations, and coordinate passenger, crew and relevant service-provider arrangements;
    Coordinate major transportation and operational support assignments and, where required, support airport-related commercial activities;
    Maintain effective communication and coordination with airport authorities, ground handling companies, service providers and other relevant external parties.

The Station Manager reports directly to the General Manager of China Eastern Airlines' Stockholm Office and is accountable for the station's overall operational performance, safety and service quality.

jobs.title: Cleaner
jobs.description:
**We are looking for a Cleaners in Kokkola**

Are you interested in working in an international and people-oriented environment where appreciation, trust, and commitment are reflected in everyday actions, and where opportunities for growth and development are encouraged? At N-Clean, work is carried out responsibly as part of a reliable team.

At the beginning of your employment, you will work in various commercial and service properties, such as care homes, offices, gyms, and shopping centres. Work is mainly performed on weekdays and weekends in different shifts, including early morning shifts starting at 6:00 AM, as well as morning and evening shifts. In this role, you will independently ensure the cleanliness of our client sites and carry out other customer service tasks related to cleaning services. You will play an important role in supporting the smooth running of daily operations. You will work responsibly, follow safety and quality procedures, and take care of your working environment.

**Your responsibilities include**

- Daily cleaning and maintenance tasks

- Ensuring the quality of your own work

- Proper use and maintenance of cleaning equipment and materials

- Cooperation with customers and colleagues

- Working independently and carefully

- Acting responsibly and reliably

- A willingness to learn and develop your skills


**We expect you to have**

- Previous experience in cleaning or housekeeping services

- The ability to understand work instructions and communicate sufficiently to manage your employment and work safely, either in Finnish or English. Fluency in Finnish is not required, and English language skills can replace Finnish language proficiency. We value a diverse workplace where different languages and cultural backgrounds are considered strengths.

- A way of working that supports a safe, equal, and respectful work community

- A valid work permit if you are not a Finnish citizen


**We offer you**

- A fixed-term employment contract, 5 hours per week

- Employment starting as soon as possible once the right person is found and ending on 30 September 2026

- A competitive salary in accordance with the collective agreement, €11.33–€12.59/hour

- Comprehensive onboarding and support for starting your work through our renewed Onboarding Path and N-Clean Academy

- A start date agreed together

- Opportunities for professional development and internal career advancement

- A safe and respectful work environment

- A responsible employer committed to fair employment terms, a safe workplace, and employee wellbeing

- A people-first workplace with an eNPS score of 55


**Equality and Responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and respectfully regardless of their background. We do not tolerate discrimination in any form.

We operate responsibly and transparently and are committed to maintaining a safe and healthy work environment.

**Why Join Us?**

Our goal is to ensure that you enjoy your work and feel that what you do matters. We invest in employee experience and making everyday work run smoothly, and it shows in our results: our employee eNPS score is an outstanding 55.

This is not just a number. It is reflected in our positive working atmosphere, mutual appreciation, and strong teamwork. We have also received recognition for our efforts:

- In 2024, we were selected as Finlands Most Human-Centric Workplace

- In 2025, we placed third in the same category

- In 2025, we achieved third place in the Finlands Most Human-Centric Working Life Act category


These results are based on feedback and experiences shared by our employees and help guide our continuous development.

We also offer opportunities to grow your career. Many of our supervisors started as cleaners and progressed into positions with greater responsibility. We support professional development and provide opportunities for additional training and new roles based on your interests and skills. Read more about career stories on our website and get inspired!

**Join Our Top Team!**

**Submit your application no later than 10 September 2026. We review applications throughout the recruitment period, and the position may be filled or the application process closed before the deadline.**

We only accept applications submitted through the application form on our website.

jobs.description:
Elsker du at svejse MAG/co2 svejsning? Så læs nærmere her!

Randstad søger en svejser til daghold. Det vil til at starte med være et vikariat på 2-3 måneder dog med mulighed for fastansættelse. Jobbet er ved en produktionsvirksomhed i Spøttrup. 

Arbejdsopgaverne vil være c02 svejsning af rør eller plade i sort stål. Det er ikke et krav, at du er faglært, hvis du har erfaring med at svejse.  Fordel hvis du kan valse men heller ikke et krav.

Løn og ansættelse efter overenskomst

Vi forventer, at:
- du har erfaring med svejsning
- du er god til at arbejde selvstændigt
- du er stabil og kvalitetsbevidst
- du kan starte med kort varsel

Ansøg
Hvis du synes at ovenstående lyder spændende, ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV. Tryk på knappen 'ansøg nu' for at sende dit CV. Såfremt du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Asmus Dam på tlf. 4880 8201. Vi afholder løbende samtaler, og alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Om randstad
Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

jobs.title: Senior Internal Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will join a fast-moving tech environment where internal communication plays a key role in driving engagement, clarity, and participation. jobs.title: Research Assistant / Forskningsassistent (Academy of Finland-project REALS)
jobs.description:
About the job

This is a tight call for a Ukrainian-speaking RESEARCH ASSISTANT to be employed for project REALS – Relational Ethics and Affective/Lived Security: Care, Resilience and Embodiment in Times of Crisis and Hanken School of Economics.

Hanken School of Economics is a leading, internationally accredited business school, recognized for its international orientation and outstanding research quality in proportion to its size. We have close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 16 000 alumni. We are located in Helsinki and Vaasa, Finland.

Project

Project REALS explores how security is organised when formal systems are under strain, such as in times of war, disaster, or large-scale societal disruption. Bringing together perspectives from organisation studies, ethics of care, and arts-based research, the project extends understandings of security as purely institutional or technical. A central focus is how care, trust, and shared responsibility emerge in everyday practices when communities respond to crisis situations. The research draws on fieldwork conducted in Ukraine, including observations and interviews with emergency responders, humanitarian actors, and members of civil society.

Work

The tasks can be, but are not limited to:

- transcribing and translating interviews
- data search online (YouTube interviews, public media articles, reports, and other publicly available sources)
- participant recruitment and fieldwork activities, including identifying potential interviewees, assisting with interview scheduling and coordination, and, where appropriate, conducting interviews.
- assisting in the planning and organization of research dissemination and stakeholder engagement activities, such as seminars, workshops, and other communication events.

Employment: part-time employment (80 %), 1.10.2026-31.12.2026 (with a possibility of extension).

Job requirements

- good proficiency of English and Ukrainian, both spoken and written.
- good personal skills and ability to work as a member of a team.

- Please note that the research project engages with sensitive topics and contexts. Candidates should therefore be prepared to work with potentially challenging material and demonstrate an awareness of: emotional self-management and well-being, self-care practices when engaging with sensitive research data, ethical and secure data management. Training, guidance, and relevant support resources will be provided throughout the project.
- Familiarity with, and genuine interest in, the research context and subject matter will be considered a strong asset.

Documentation to be attached:

- CV
- Cover letter
- Language certificates if the skill level is not apparent in other attached documents
- Additional attachments, e.g. degree certificates, work experience and other merits that the applicant wishes to be considered

The salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (including employee healthcare, pension, and holiday contributions) and placed on job requirement level 4-6 for administrative staff, with an additional personal performance-based salary element.

For more details of the position, please contact the project PI, Anna Dziuba, anna.dziuba@hanken.fi.

Applications including the CV and other relevant documentation should be submitted in Hanken recruitment database LAURA no later than 06.09.2026.

___________________________________________________________

Forskningsassistent (ukrainsktalande) till projektet Finlands Akademi-projektet REALS vid Hanken Svenska handelshögskolan

Om positionen

Vi söker en ukrainsktalande forskningsassistent som ska anställas inom projektet REALS – Relational Ethics and Affective/Lived Security: Care, Resilience and Embodiment in Times of Crisis vid Hanken Svenska handelshögskolan.

Hanken är en ledande, internationellt ackrediterad handelshögskola som är erkänd för sin internationella profil och höga forskningskvalitet i förhållande till sin storlek. Vi har nära samarbete med näringslivet och ett aktivt alumnnätverk med över 16 000 alumner. Hanken finns i Helsingfors och Vasa.

Projektet

Projektet REALS undersöker hur trygghet och säkerhet organiseras när formella system utsätts för påfrestningar, exempelvis under krig, katastrofer eller omfattande samhälleliga störningar. Genom att förena perspektiv från organisationsforskning, omsorgsetik och konstbaserad forskning utvecklar projektet förståelsen av säkerhet bortom rent institutionella eller tekniska perspektiv.

Ett centralt fokus är hur omsorg, tillit och delat ansvar växer fram i vardagliga praktiker när samhällen och lokalsamhällen hanterar krissituationer. Forskningen bygger på fältarbete i Ukraina, inklusive observationer och intervjuer med räddningspersonal, humanitära aktörer och representanter för civilsamhället.

Arbetsuppgifter

Arbetsuppgifterna kan inkludera, men är inte begränsade till:

- transkribering och översättning av intervjuer
- informationssökning på internet (YouTube-intervjuer, offentliga medieartiklar, rapporter och andra offentligt tillgängliga källor)
- rekrytering av deltagare och fältarbetsaktiviteter, inklusive identifiering av potentiella intervjupersoner, stöd vid tidsbokning och koordinering av intervjuer samt, när det är lämpligt, genomförande av intervjuer
- medverkan i planering och organisering av forskningsspridning och aktiviteter för intressentdialog, såsom seminarier, workshoppar och andra kommunikations-arrangemang

Anställning: Deltidsanställning (80 %) 1.10.2026–31.12.2026 (med möjlighet till förlängning)

Kvalifikationskrav

- goda kunskaper i engelska och ukrainska, både muntligt och skriftligt
- god samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att arbeta som en del av ett team
- Observera att forskningsprojektet behandlar känsliga ämnen och sammanhang. Kandidater bör därför vara beredda att arbeta med potentiellt krävande material och visa medvetenhet om: emotionell självhantering och välbefinnande, egenomsorg vid arbete med känsligt forskningsmaterial, etisk och säker hantering av forskningsdata. Utbildning, handledning och relevanta stödtjänster erbjuds under hela projektets gång.
- Erfarenhet av och ett genuint intresse för forskningskontexten och ämnesområdet ses som en betydande merit.

Bilagor som ska bifogas ansökan

- CV

jobs.title: Microbial Food Specialist - BRIGHT
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about food and flavour? Eager to help tackle some of our most pressing global challenges? Excited by the idea of working and learning at the intersection of science, cooking, sustainability, and food culture in a cutting-edge, interdisciplinary research environment? Then join us as our new Microbial Food Specialist!

This position is a part of BRIGHT's mission- oriented Microbial Food research programme (“referred to as Mission 2”), which aims to build an AI-powered framework for the rational design of microbial foods that meet four targets: consumer acceptance, health, sustainability and scalability. The first phase focuses on two fungal chassis, Aspergillus and Yarrowia, characterizing more than 500 prototypes through multi-omics, sensory analysis, life-cycle assessment and safety testing. Predictive models for flavor, texture, nutrition and process scale-up are trained iteratively through active learning. The scientific scope spans strain engineering, adaptive laboratory evolution, solid- and liquid-state fermentation, sensory and consumer research, and pre-clinical and clinical evaluation of safety, bioavailability and cardiometabolic health, in collaboration with national and international partners.

The Sustainable Food Innovation Group (SFI) addresses interconnected food systems challenges—diminishing diversity, inequitable production and distribution, knowledge privatisation, nutritional depletion, blandness—through interdisciplinary research, product development, knowledge-sharing and creative public engagement. As we get our new institute BRIGHT and its Microbial Foods mission up and running, we are seeking a Microbial Food Specialist to coordinate activities in the laboratory as well as conduct their own research on microbial foods for sustainability.

The job
As our Microbial Food Specialist you will:
  • Coordinate activities in the laboratory, including onboarding and offboarding for new members, training in equipment and protocols, data management, LEAF certification, and other organisational and administrative tasks to facilitate smooth and effective running of the labs
  • Identify traditional and novel microbial foods with the greatest sustainability potential and analyse them using multi-omics methods
  • Create and investigate novel fermentations that apply microbes and techniques from traditional animal-based products to plant-based substrates
  • Support other projects involving research and innovation with novel microbial food products

What we’re looking for
You will have a PhD in food science, microbiology, or a related discipline and at least three years of postdoctoral training in relevant areas of research.

You will have excellent organisational skills, and will enjoy taking initiative to advance your own research.

You will be fluent in spoken and written English, and have literacy in common IT systems.

The ideal candidate will also:
  • have demonstrable experience with genomics, metagenomics, transcriptomics, and/or metabolomics (the more the better)
  • have demonstrable leadership, managerial, supervisory, and/or organisational experience
  • have basic knowledge about fermentation, food systems and sustainability issues
  • have some experience making fermentations, traditional and/or novel
  • be able to work with others and independently
  • be comfortable in an interdisciplinary environment, where different types of knowledge co-exist
  • be patient, charitable, curious and playful—key qualities for interdisciplinary work

What we offer in return
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer an engaging and rewarding job in an international, cutting-edge research environment. We place great emphasis on personal and professional development, so there will be ample opportunities for skills development and continuing education as part of the position, according to your career goals.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for managers (TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The salary will be assessed according to your level of experience, and will be agreed upon with the relevant union.

The position is full-time and is based at DTU’s Lyngby campus.

The starting date is from 01-01-2027 or according to mutual agreement with the Group Leader. The position is for four years.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than Sunday, 13 September 2026. Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach the following materials:
  • Cover letter
  • CV
  • PhD diploma
  • One letter of reference, with referee’s email and phone number

For additional information about the position, please contact Group Leader Joshua Evans at joshuae@dtu.dk

You can read more about BRIGHT below, and at www.bright.dtu.dk

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

Sustainable Food Innovation Group (SFI)
The Sustainable Food Innovation Group uses culinary research & development to make flavourful sustainable foods, natural sciences to study how they work, and social sciences and arts to understand and experiment with how they can fit into food culture. Through this union of innovation, transdisciplinary research, and open knowledge-sharing, we work for a food system that is more sustainable, equitable, and transparent, offering foods that are diverse, nourishing, and delicious.

BRIGHT Mission 2: Microbial Foods
BRIGHT Mission 2 aims to build an AI-powered framework for the rational design of microbial foods that meet four targets: consumer acceptance, health, sustainability and scalability. The first phase focuses on two fungal chassis, Aspergillus and Yarrowia, characterizing more than 500 prototypes through multi-omics, sensory analysis, life-cycle assessment and safety testing. Predictive models for flavor, texture, nutrition and process scale-up are trained iteratively through active learning. The scientific scope spans strain engineering, adaptive laboratory evolution, solid- and liquid-state fermentation, sensory and consumer research, and pre-clinical and clinical evaluation of safety, bioavailability and cardiometabolic health, in collaboration with national and international partners.

BRIGHT – The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition (BRIGHT) is a major initiative based at DTU that aims to accelerate the development of biosolutions and strengthen the bio-based economy. BRIGHT serves as a hub for academic and industrial partners working together to unlock the potential of bioproduction. BRIGHT focuses on three main areas: Sustainable materials (Developing bio-based alternatives to fossil-derived materials), Microbial foods (Innovating food production through microbial technologies), and Microorganisms for net-zero agriculture (Creating solutions to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in agriculture). The goal is to develop and scale innovative biosolutions within these areas, ultimately creating sustainable and competitive alternatives to fossil-based products and processes that can make significant contributions to reducing global greenhouse gas emissions.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: Keikkatekijää keittiöön Kristiinankaupunkiin
jobs.description:
Etsimme Kristiinankaupungille keikkatekijöitä keittiön eri tehtäviin. Olipa taustasi sitten suurtalouskokki tai astiahuoltaja, niin etsimme eri pituisiin sijaisuuksiin reippaita ja motivoituneita tekijöitä.

Kristiinankaupungin alueella sekä lähikunnissa on kouluja sekä päiväkoteja, joiden keittiöihin tarvitaan silloin tällöin sijaisia. Onko sinulla tarvetta keikkatyölle tai haluatko saada "jalkaa oven väliin"? Tässä on sinulle oiva mahdollisuus päästä tutustumaan eri toimipisteiden tehtäviin.

Etsimme osaavia ja koulutuksen omaavia kokkeja sekä keittiöapulaisia avustaviin tehtäviin.
- Kokin tehtävään vaadimme koulutuksen tai vähintään työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä sekä kielitaitoa (suomi tai ruotsi).
- Keittiöapulaiseksi etsimme reippaita, motivoituneita tekijöitä, jotka omaa kokemusta keittiö ympäristön eri töistä. Kielitaitona mieluiten suomi tai ruotsi, mutta myös hyvä englanti riittää.
Mitä me etsimme:
- Tarvetta on erityisesti keikka-tekijöille, joten arvostamme mahdollisuutta vastaanottaa työvuoroja lyhyelläkin varoitusajalla. Toki samoja sijaisia kysytään aina ensisijaisesti myös pidempiin sijaisuuksiin.
- Työvuorot ovat aina arkisin 7-17 välisenä aikana.
- Oman auton käyttöä, sillä sijaisuuksia voi tulla myös lähiseudulta
- Hygieniapassin tulee olla voimassa

Noudatamme työssä KVTES palkkataulukkoa:
Keittäjän (tasopalkka 4RUO50B1) tuntipalkka 15,25€
Keittäjän (tasopalkka 4RUO50A1) tuntipalkka 13,95€
Keittiöapulaisen tuntipalkka (tasopalkka 4RUO70A1) 13,32€

På Svenska:
Vi söker till Kristinestad inhoppare till olika köksuppgifter. Oavsett om du har bakgrund som storkock eller diskare söker vi pigga och motiverade personer för vikariat av olika längd.
I Kristinestads område samt i närliggande kommuner finns skolor och daghem vars kök periodvis är i behov av vikarier. Har du behov av inhopp eller vill du få in en fot genom dörren? Här har du en utmärkt möjlighet att bekanta dig med arbetsuppgifter vid olika enheter.

Vi söker yrkeskunniga och utbildade kockar samt köksbiträden för assisterande uppgifter.
- För kockuppgifter kräver vi utbildning eller minst arbetserfarenhet från motsvarande uppgifter samt språkkunskaper (finska eller svenska).
- Som köksbiträde söker vi pigga och motiverade personer, som har erfarenhet av olika arbetsuppgifter i köksmiljö. Språkkunskaper i första hand finska eller svenska, men även god engelska räcker.

Vad vi söker:
- Behovet gäller i synnerhet inhoppare, så vi uppskattar möjlighet att ta emot arbetspass även med kort varsel. Samma vikarier tillfrågas i första hand också för längre vikariat.
- Arbetspassen är alltid vardagar mellan kl. 7–17.
- Tillgång till egen bil, eftersom vikariat även kan förekomma i närområdet.
- Giltigt hygienpass krävs.
Vi erbjuder en bra introduktion!

Vi följer KVTES lönetabell:
- Kock (grundlön 4RUO50B1): timlön 15,25 €
- Kock (grundlön 4RUO50A1): timlön 13,95 €
- Köksbiträde (grundlön 4RUO70A1): timlön 13,32 €

jobs.title: Master Thesis Project at Aros electronics
jobs.description:
Aros electronics develops and manufactures customized industrial electronics. Motor controls, power electronics, and fieldbus technology are their areas of expertise. In these fields, there is constant advancement of technologies, knowledge levels, and production methods. Aros electronics are not keeping up with technology, they drive it. Want to be a part of their journey? Read more and apply below!

ABOUT THE POSITION:

Friday are on behalf of Aros electronics looking for master thesis students. The master thesis is starting in January 2027 with the aim to result in a permanent position and a tailored talent program of one year together with Friday and Aros, starting in August 2027.

A few examples of thesis areas:

    Advandced control systems
    Power electronics
    Electromagnetics, simulation, modelling and electrical motors
    Machine Learning
    Embedded real-time critical systems

Since Aros develops everything from idea to finished product, they have their own unique production line for PCB:s (printed circuit boards) in-house and also for motor and mechanics via their sister company. This is therefore the perfect master thesis opportunity for you who wants to be close to the product development.

WHY CHOOSE AROS ELECTRONICS FOR YOUR MASTER THESIS?

    World-Class Mentorship:

At Aros electronics, you won't just be a student; you'll be a valued member of our team. You'll have the opportunity to work alongside experts in the field who are passionate about mentoring the next generation of innovators.

    Real-World Impact:

Your Master Thesis Project at Aros electronics won't collect dust on a shelf; it will drive real-world change. They are dedicated to tackling complex challenges and providing solutions that make a difference.

    Access to Cutting-Edge Technology:

Their state-of-the-art facilities are equipped with the latest technology and tools. You'll have access to resources that will enable you to conduct groundbreaking research and push the boundaries of what's possible.

jobs.title: Fire Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Do you want to enable green energy transition, and together with colleagues meet the world’s needs for sustainable, flexible and insecure energy?

We are now looking for a Fire Engineer who will be a part of our department at TPC. As a Fire Engineer, you will be involved in coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities, providing technical support for design, testing and commissioning, and ensuring projects are completed within budget and safety standards. We believe that you have knowledge and experience, capable of acting as a design authority, preparing comprehensive project documents, and interacting with customers and contractors. If you enjoy cost-effective, high-quality solutions and thrive in a dynamic environment, we want to hear from you!

Our team culture is flexible and cooperative with the highest regards for safety and occupational health.

This role is based in either Ludvika (Sweden), Mannheim (Germany) or Glasgow (Scotland).

How you'll make an impact

    Ensure fire detection and fire protection system designs comply with applicable standards, regulations, and HVDC-specific requirements.
    Develop and maintain requirement specifications, technical documentation, and design deliverables based on customer requirements, industry standards, and local regulations.
    Coordinate technical interfaces with multiple engineering disciplines throughout all project phases, from design and engineering through testing and commissioning.
    Proactively identify potential technical challenges, risks, and project constraints, and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful project execution.
    Support the onboarding, training, and coaching of new team members and provide technical guidance to customers when required.
    Collaborate closely with colleagues and engineering teams across different functions and geographical locations, promoting knowledge sharing and best practices.
    Participate in regular project meetings, monitor progress, and take timely actions to address technical issues and project needs.
    Develop fire detection and protection system concepts for HVDC tenders, including identifying required clarifications, assumptions, and deviations for both internal and external stakeholders.
    Support tender cost estimation and budgeting activities related to fire detection and protection systems.
    Perform technical risk assessments of proposed tender solutions and implement appropriate mitigation measures to ensure robust and compliant designs
    Develop and maintain Fire Concepts / Fire Strategies for buildings and HVDC facilities, translating fire safety objectives into compliant and practical fire protection solutions.

Your Background

    Degree, diploma, or equivalent experience in Fire Engineering, Fire Safety, Risk Engineering, or a related field.
    Knowledge of fire codes, standards, regulations, and fire safety principles, with the ability to apply them in practical engineering environments.
    Experience with fire modeling, fire simulation tools, or related analytical methods used to assess fire safety and performance requirements.
    Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders and explain technical concepts clearly.

We recognize that candidates may have gained relevant expertise through different combinations of education, professional experience, and industry training, and we encourage applicants with transferable skills to apply.

More about us 

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

jobs.title: Love RevOps, Salesforce, and Gen AI? Join us
jobs.description:
At boost.ai, we’re redefining how people interact with companies. As a Gartner Magic Quadrant Conversational AI Challenger, we empower organizations around the world to deliver next-generation customer experiences through intelligent chat and voice automation. Because AI is our core product, we believe in practicing what we preach, using cutting-edge AI tools internally to optimize our way of working. As we continue to scale globally, we’re looking for a process-obsessed, tech-curious Revenue Operations & AI Efficiency Specialist to help keep our revenue engine running smoothly.

Our sales motion doesn’t end at “Closed Won.” You will ensure deals flow seamlessly through Salesforce while actively leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, and modern automation to eliminate manual bottlenecks and supercharge our team's productivity.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Customer Excellence, and Marketing. You’ll be the operational architect ensuring the data, systems, and AI-driven workflows behind every deal work flawlessly.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Execution & Revenue Systems Support:

    Salesforce Record Reviews: Support sales throughout the deal lifecycle by conducting pre-close Salesforce record reviews to ensure accurate billing and reporting readiness.
    Workflow Automation: Assist with active Salesforce administration, supporting flow automation, integrations, testing, and quality checks to ensure reliable data flow.
    Data Hygiene & Accuracy: Ensure exceptional CRM data accuracy and hygiene by validating records, flagging discrepancies, and streamlining data entry.
    System Troubleshooting: Partner with Revenue Management and RevOps leadership to troubleshoot system problems, resolve data issues, and escalate complex technical errors.

AI-Driven Efficiency & Process Optimization

    Identify opportunities to embed AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Slackbot, or internal AI frameworks) into daily RevOps workflows to speed up data handling and reporting.
    Prompt Engineering & Scripting: Create and refine prompts, internal AI assistants, or low-code automations to analyze sales data, draft documentation, and summarize pipeline health.
    Root-Cause Resolution: Eliminate repetitive manual tasks by building automated Salesforce shortcuts or AI-assisted workflows.

Data, Enablement & Cross-Functional Insights

    Dashboard Modernization & Reporting: Build, maintain, and modernize Salesforce reports and dashboards to provide leadership and cross-functional teams with clear visibility into pipeline health, sales performance, and key revenue metrics.
    AI-Enhanced Documentation: Create and maintain clear sales process documentation, playbooks, and system guidance, leveraging AI tools to keep training materials dynamically updated as workflows evolve.
    Sales Onboarding & Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales Enablement and cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Marketing, Customer Success) to support sales training initiatives, ensuring new hires seamlessly adopt our revenue systems and automated workflows.

Skills & Mindset

    1–3 years of experience in Revenue Ops, Sales Ops, Business Operations or a similar role.
    Strong Salesforce Proficiency: Hands-on experience working inside Salesforce is required. You must understand its structure and how fields, objects, and reports interact under the hood.
    AI Tool Fluency: Practical, hands-on experience using Generative AI tools to solve work problems, format data, write formulas, or accelerate daily tasks.
    Comfort with structured data: A natural attention to detail. you instantly spot data irregularities or things that "don't look right."
    Process oriented: The ability to strictly follow defined processes while proactively finding ways to improve them over time.
    Strong communication: Clear communication skills and confidence collaborating across international teams spanning EMEA and North America.

Bonus points if you:

    Have deep experience with Salesforce automation tools (Flows, validation rules, or integrations).
    Understand basic SaaS concepts like subscriptions, ARR, billing cycles, or renewals.
    Enjoy documenting how things work so others don’t have to guess.
    Have partnered with Finance, Marketing, Revenue Management or Customer Success teams before

You’ll love this role if you:

    Get a strange sense of satisfaction from clean data and well-designed processes.
    Dislike doing the same manual task twice and would rather spend time automating or AI-prompting a solution than doing manual data entry.
    Are genuinely excited about the future of AI-driven business productivity.
    Learn fast, ask great questions, and love "connecting the dots" across global teams.Enjoy figuring out how systems work (and why they sometimes don’t)
    Prefer fixing root causes instead of applying manual band-aids
    Like being the person who connects the dots across teams
    Care deeply about things “flowing” correctly from one step to the next
    Are curious about an AI-driven businesses
    Learn fast, ask good questions, and aren’t afraid to dig into details
    Are energized by working in a global, cross-regional environment spanning EMEA and North America
    Get a little nerdy about Salesforce, workflows, and reporting

About boost.ai

Boost.ai is the trusted leader in AI-powered customer experience solutions for regulated industries.

Proven performance and enterprise-grade reliability make boost.ai the partner of choice for leading brands across the US, including Credit Union of Colorado, MSU Federal Credit Union, Coursera, Tokio Marine HCC, and more. Boost.ai is recognized as a Challenger in Gartner’s 2025 Magic QuadrantTM for Conversational AI Platforms.

Our core values—trust, innovation, teamwork, and fun—are central to everything we do. We are committed to building a supportive environment that drives growth, encourages collaboration, and helps us achieve our goals while maintaining a fun and vibrant culture. These values provide a strong foundation that empowers our team members to excel.

It is our policy to provide equal opportunities for employment and career advancement based on an individual's abilities, qualifications, and suitability for the role. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, gender identity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
