jobs.title: Sales & Recruitment, Espoo
jobs.description:
AALTOVOIMA - AALLON VOIMALLA TÖIHIN 

Oletko ihmisläheinen, myyntihenkinen ja etsit uusia haasteita kasvavassa yrityksessä? Haluatko päästä mukaan henkilöstöpalvelualalle käytännönläheisesti rekrytoinnin kautta ja kasvattaa rooliasi vähitellen myös myynnin ja asiakkuuksien pariin? Jos vastasit kyllä, saatat olla etsimämme tekijä!

 

Aalto Henkilöstöpalvelut on monialainen henkilöstöpalveluyritys Suomesta, joka yhdistää työn ja tekijät. Olemme osa laajempaa Workteam Groupia, joka on henkilöstö- sekä palvelualan konserni. 

Perusta toiminnallamme on luotettavuus ja joustavuus. Keskeisimpiä arvojamme ovat yhdessä menestyminen, nopea reagointi ja positiivinen palvelu. Jokainen työntekijä ja asiakas on meille tärkeä.

Henkilöstöllämme on kymmenien vuosien kokemus rakentamisen, logistiikan, teollisuuden ja palvelualojen rekrytoinneista henkilöstöpalvelualalla.

 

Henkilöstöllämme on vuosien kokemus henkilöstöpalvelualalta. Palveluitamme ovat henkilöstövuokrauksen ohella joustorekrytointi, urakat, suorarekrytointi ja ulkoistus.

 

Haemme nyt kasvavaan Espoon toimistoomme Sales & Recruitment -osaajaa!

Roolissa yhdistyvät rekrytointi, työntekijöiden kanssa työskentely sekä myynti ja asiakkuuksien kehittäminen. Tehtävän alkuvaiheessa pääset syventymään henkilöstöpalvelualan arkeen erityisesti rekrytointien kautta: haastattelet hakijoita, etsit sopivia osaajia avoimiin tehtäviin ja olet mukana varmistamassa onnistuneita työntekijä- ja asiakaskohtaamisia.

Kun toimiala, asiakkaamme ja toimintatapamme tulevat tutuiksi, pääset kasvattamaan rooliasi yhä enemmän myös myynnin ja asiakkuuksien pariin. Tavoitteena on, että pääset ajan myötä rakentamaan omia asiakassuhteita, kartoittamaan yritysten henkilöstötarpeita ja tarjoamaan niihin sopivia ratkaisuja.

Aikaisempaa kokemusta henkilöstöpalvelualalta ei siis tarvitse olla, vaan tärkeintä on halu oppia, kiinnostus ihmisiä ja liiketoimintaa kohtaan sekä rohkeus tarttua myös puhelimeen.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu:

 * Rekrytointiprosessin hoitaminen yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa
 * Sopivien työntekijöiden etsiminen ja yhdistäminen avoimiin työtehtäviin
 * Yhteydenpito työntekijöihin ja asiakkaisiin
 * Asiakkaiden henkilöstötarpeiden kartoittaminen
 * Uusasiakashankinta ja potentiaalisten asiakkaiden kontaktointi
 * Henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluiden tarjoaminen asiakasyrityksille
 * Asiakassuhteiden rakentaminen ja kehittäminen
 * Myynnin ja toiminnan kehittäminen yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa

Arvostamme sinussa:

 * Aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisiä, rekrytointia ja myyntiä kohtaan
 * Myyntihenkistä ja aktiivista työotetta
 * Rohkeutta olla yhteydessä uusiin ihmisiin ja yrityksiin
 * Hyviä viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
 * Paineensietokykyä ja kykyä toimia välillä vauhdikkaassakin arjessa
 * Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä kykyä kommunikoida englanniksi
 * Kaupallista koulutusta tai muuta tehtävään soveltuvaa taustaa

Tässä tehtävässä sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis henkilöstöpalvelualan ammattilainen ensimmäisenä työpäivänä. Etsimme ennen kaikkea motivoitunutta henkilöä, jolla on halua oppia, tehdä töitä ihmisten kanssa ja kasvaa vähitellen myös tulokselliseksi myynnin osaajaksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

 * Vaihtelevan ja mielenkiintoisen työn henkilöstöpalvelualalla
 * Mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa ja kasvattamassa Espoon toimistoa ja liiketoimintaa
 * Mukavat kollegat ja positiivisen, innostavan työyhteisön
 * Hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittyä ja edetä kasvavassa yrityksessä
 * Kiinteän pohjapalkan sekä kannustavan tulospalkkiomallin


Tule mukaan rakentamaan Aalto Henkilöstöpalveluiden kasvua Espooseen!

jobs.title: True Dates Production Operator
jobs.description:
True Co. was founded in 2017 and began as an entrepreneurial journey in the founders’ kitchen, where they experimented with developing plastic-free chewing gum. The idea of revolutionizing snacking through more natural alternatives has since developed into a company that today also produces True Dates. The products are sold in more than 50 countries and the company is growing. True Co. is therefore looking for operators for newly established shifts at the True Dates factory in Glostrup at Formervangen 13. Working hours will be 21.55 to 07.10 Monday to Thursday

Your primary tasks

  • Physical production, operation, and monitoring of production and processing equipment.

  • Rotation between stations and different parts of the process is a natural part of the work.

  • Ongoing checks, measurements, and record-keeping in accordance with documented standards.

  • Troubleshooting and problem-solving in collaboration with the maintenance team.

  • Cleaning and preparation of equipment and the production area.

  • Ensuring quality and food safety.

  • Ad hoc tasks related to production, warehouse, and cleaning depending on needs.

Qualifications

  • You enjoy working in a dynamic work environment with clear production targets and requirements for tasty products, while actively contributing to maintaining high food safety standards.

  • You like working in teams where colleagues help each other to complete tasks.

  • Not a requirement but a plus if you have experience as a process operator, industrial operator, process technologist, or similar. Experience from food production or another regulated environment is an advantage.

  • You have a mechanical/technical interest.

  • You can read and understand English, as documentation, instructions, and the corporate language is English.

The work is carried out under controlled conditions, and therefore requirements apply regarding personal hygiene and mandatory clothing provided by the company.

We offer

  • Thorough training in operating machines.

  • Training in producing food according to GMP standards.

  • Competitive salary

jobs.title: Stefanshjemmet søger en Socialpædagog til afdelingen Strandvejen Stuen. i en stilling med blandede (overvejende aften) vagter på ca. 30-37 timer om ugen.
jobs.description:
Stefanshjemmet søger en Socialpædagog til afdelingen Strandvejen Stuen. i en stilling med blandede (overvejende aften) vagter på ca. 30-37 timer om ugen.

Stefanshjemmet er et bo- og beskæftigelsestilbud til mennesker med erhvervet hjerneskade og/eller fysiske handicap i forskellige grader. På Strandvejen Stuen., bor 12 beboere, som er visiteret til et bo- og aktivitetstilbud. Her har vi den flotteste udsigt ud over Århus bugt med adgang til skov og strand, placeret tæt på Århus centrum. Vi kan tage på ture - både i bus, på gåben, i kørestole eller elcykel.

Vi søger en socialpædagog, som har lyst til at indgå i plejen og omsorgen for beboerne samt være med til at give dem et aktivitetstilbud dagligt. Vi er pædagoger, terapeuter, SOSU’er og omsorgsmedarbejdere og vi arbejder i tværfaglige teams, med udgangspunkt i beboernes ønsker og drømme. Vi værdsætter såvel monofagligheden som tværfagligheden, så de enkeltes kompetencer og viden kommer i spil til gavn for beboerne.

Vi søger en pædagog, som:

·        er uddannet pædagog eller Socialpædagog

·        er fagligt velfunderet, brænder for sit fag og for at arbejde som kontaktperson og samarbejdet med pårørende

·        har kendskab til KRAP, Modulus, NAU, LA og LA2, vil være en fordel, men ikke et must.

·        har blik for at anvende sin faglighed i hverdagen, både gennem den daglige pleje og omsorg og gennem meningsfuld og aktivitet for og med beboerne

·        gerne har viden om neuropædagogik og gerne vil sætte det i spil i en tværfaglig kontekst

·        gerne vil inddrage sansestimuli i beboernes hverdag og udbrede brugen af det

·        evner at tage sig tid til nærvær med beboerne og påskønner livshistorierne

·        er engageret og god til at se muligheder

·        er opsøgende og initiativrig

·        ser værdien i dokumentation og deling af viden i en tværfaglig kontekst

·        Sætter en ære i at bidrage til godt samarbejde og kollegaers trivsel

 

Vi tilbyder:

·         god mono- og tværfaglig viden og udvikling

·         mulighed for personlig udvikling

·         åbenhed for faglige tiltag

·         beboer med fantastiske personligheder

·         en struktureret hverdag

·         monofaglige netværksmøder

·         faglige temadage

·         kærlige og engageret kollegaer, som virkelig vil hinanden!

 

På afdelingen er der mellem 13 og 15 fastansatte medarbejdere og en del weekendmedarbejdere med forskellig baggrund og faglighed til at varetage pleje, omsorg, bostøtte og aktivitet for beboerne efter serviceloven. I praksis betyder det bl.a., at vi hver dag tilbyder aktiviteter for vores beboere i afdelingen eller ud af huset.

Som ansat på Stefanshjemmet er det vigtigt for os, at du er fagligt stolt, engageret og har hjertet på rette sted og et menneskesyn der stemmer overens med Stefanshjemmets værdier, herunder respekten for det enkelte menneske og retten til selvbestemmelse. Dagligdagen byder på faglige udfordringer, etiske dilemmaer, gode kollegaer, godt arbejdsmiljø og højt humør. Vi påskønner de gode grin sammen med hinanden og med beboerne. Vi er en afdeling med blanding af nye og erfarne dygtige medarbejdere og har mange ideer, vi gerne vil sætte i spil sammen med dig.

Vores beboer har brug for dig som kan se bag om hjerneskadens adfærd. At du kan agere roligt, tålmodigt og handle på måder der er i deres bedste interesse.

For at du kommer til at føle dig velkommen og godt klædt på, vil du blive oplært af din kollegagruppe både i praksis som følge i plejen, men også i administration som medicin-givning og dokumentation. Vi har internt på Stefanshjemmet et sundhedsfagligt netværk, et pædagogisk netværk og et terapeutisk netværk, hvor vi har et læringsmiljø, som vi i fællesskab understøtter.

Arbejdstiden er skiftende dag- og aftenvagter, men med overvejende aftenvagter, 6-8 timers af gangen og arbejde hver 3. weekend (gennemsnitligt)

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til principperne om ny løn efter overenskomst med de faglige organisationer.

Stefanshjemmet er en selvejende institution med driftsoverenskomst med Aarhus Kommune. 

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte pædagog Anne Samsudeen for at høre mere om det daglige arbejde eller for at få en rundvisning og en kop kaffe inden du søger. Ring til afdelingen på: 41 86 67 26 og spørg efter Anne.

Du er også velkommen til at kontakte forstander Mille Hammershøj tlf. på 6192 3547

Du kan indhente mere viden om Stefanshjemmet på vores hjemmeside: www.stefanshjemmet.dk

Stillingen ønskes besat så hurtigt som muligt eller 1.10.26 og vi afholder samtaler løbende, så vent ikke med at sende din ansøgning, hvis du kan se dig selv i stillingen.

Ansøgningen skal sendes pr. mail til stefanshjemmet@aarhus.dk mærket ”pædagog til Strandvejen Stuen.”

Venlig hilsen os på Strandvejen Stuen. som glæder sig til at møde dig – vores nye kollega

jobs.title: General Chef
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
SMC Ltd are recruiting a General Chef for a restaurant in Dublin City Centre. As General Chef, you will build a kitchen culture where high standards, teamwork, cleanliness and pride are evident in every service. This is a role for someone who enjoys maintaining an exceptionally clean and organised kitchen, and delivering outstanding food every day. The Role You will have overall responsibility for the day-to-day running of the kitchen, ensuring exceptional food quality and working as part of a team. You will lead operations while maintaining the highest standards of food, cleanliness, organisation and service.Key Responsibilities Team Development Lead, motivate and inspire the kitchen team Create a positive, respectful and supportive working environment. Lead by example with professionalism, consistency and a strong work ethic. Encourage teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement. Build a culture where everyone takes pride in the food they produce. Kitchen Operations Oversee the day-to-day operation of the kitchen. Ensure every dish is prepared and presented to consistently high standards. Deliver smooth, efficient service without compromising quality. Ensure recipes and specifications are followed at all times. Maintain excellent communication throughout the kitchen. Food Safety & Kitchen Standards Maintain excellent HACCP and food safety standards. Ensure the kitchen is always clean, organised and exceptionally well maintained. Oversee food storage, stock rotation and labelling. Promote a culture where cleanliness is everyone's responsibility. About You Minimum 3 years experience as a General Chef or Experience within a busy, quality-focused restaurant. Passionate about producing exceptional food every day. Excellent organisational and communication skills. HACCP certification required. Calm under pressure and able to lead a busy service. Flexible to work evenings, weekends and public holidays. Applicant must have experience using Rational oven.

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö lähi- ja laitetukitiimiin
jobs.description:
**Haluatko mukaan tuottamaan ja kehittämään uudistuvia ICT-palveluitamme?**

Etsimme palvelupäällikköä johtamaan Lähi- ja laitetukipalveluitamme Etelä- ja Pohjois-Karjalassa. Vastaat kahden tiimin ja noin 30 asiantuntijan organisaatiosta ja palveluista, jotka tukevat asiakkaidemme päivittäistä työtä neljän maakunnan alueella.

Tiimien vastuulla on tarjota lähitukea sekä hoitaa päätelaitteiden asennuksia, toimituksia ja käyttöönottoja asiakkaillemme Etelä-Karjalan, Pohjois-Karjalan, Etelä-Savon ja Päijät-Hämeen alueella. Tiimien ammattilaiset auttavat asiakkaidemme työntekijöitä erilaisissa ongelmatilanteissa asiakkaiden toimipisteissä suoritettavana lähitukena sekä vastaavat päätelaitteiden elinkaarenhallinnan sujuvuudesta. Lähi- ja laitetukitiimit ovat tärkeä osa Meitan noin 200 ICT-ammattilaisen ryhmää, ja ne tekevät päivittäin tiivistä yhteistyötä keskenään ja muiden Meitan asiantuntijatiimien kanssa.

Palvelupäällikkönä toimit kahden asiantuntijatiimin noin 30 työntekijän esihenkilönä. Esihenkilönä varmistat tiimienvetäjien tukemana, että Meitan palvelut ja tuottamamme asiakaskokemus vastaavat asiakkaidemme muuttuviin tarpeisiin. Pääset osallistumaan oman vastuualueesi johtamisen ja kehittämisen lisäksi laajemmin Meitan kehittämiseen ja mm. osallistumaan uusien teknisten ratkaisujen kuten tekoälyn käyttöönottoon. Monipuoliset tehtäväsi sisältävät esihenkilötyön ja kehittämisen lisäksi mm. palvelutasojen seurantaa, sopimusvelvoitteiden täyttymisen varmistamista ja aktiivista asiakasyhteistyötä. Talouden seuranta, budjetointi, raportointi ja ennusteiden laatiminen ovat niin ikään osa työtäsi. Palvelupäällikkönä olet osa johtotiimiämme, jossa sinua on sparraamassa yli 40 kollegaa.

Tiimiesi vastuulla ovat asiakkuudet koko Meitan toimialueella Pohjois- ja Etelä-Karjalassa, Etelä-Savossa ja Päijät-Hämeessä. Suurin osa tiimiesi henkilöistä työskentelee pääsääntöisesti Joensuussa tai Lappeenrannassa, joista toista toivomme myös sinun työskentelypaikkakunnaksesi. Pääosan ajasta työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tiimiesi kanssa Meitan toimistolla Joensuussa / Lappeenrannassa tai asiakkaiden luona, mutta työhösi sisältyy myös suunnittelu- ja palaveripäiviä, jolloin etätyöskentely on mahdollista modernien etätyöratkaisujen avulla. Työsuhde on vakituinen.

**Odotamme hakijalta:**

- Kokemusta / vahvaa motivaatiota esihenkilötyöhön

- Erinomaisia yhteistyötaitoja

- Ymmärrystä moderneista it-palveluprosesseista ja kokemusta niiden käytännön toteutuksista

- Kykyä mukautua erilaisiin tilanteisiin ja toimia itsenäisesti

- Vähintään kolmen vuoden soveltuvaa työkokemusta

- Kokemusta palvelutuotannon ja prosessien johtamisesta

- Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto

- Halua itsensä ja oman vastuualueen jatkuvaan kehittämiseen

- ITIL-sertifiointi ja/tai vankkaa kokemusta palvelunhallinnasta

- Sujuvaa kirjoitetun ja puhutun suomen kielen taitoa

jobs.title: ICT-arkkitehti
jobs.description:
Konsernipalvelujen toimiala, Tietohallintopalvelut
Asiakkuudet ja ratkaisut
Neilikkatie 17 , 01300 Vantaa

Me VAKEssa rakennamme yhdessä rohkeasti hyvinvointialuetta, johon asukkaamme voivat luottaa. Haluamme olla vakaa edelläkävijä, joka uudistaa toimintaa avoimesti ja ihmislähtöisesti. Arvomme oikeudenmukaisuus, vastuullisuus ja rohkeus ohjaavat arjen työtämme. Tunnistatko näistä myös omat arvosi?

Tule sinäkin Hyvantekijät-joukkueeseemme!

Haluatko olla rakentamassa tulevaisuuden digitaalisia sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastuspalveluita Suomen rohkeimmin uudistuvalla hyvinvointialueella?

Etsimme ICT-arkkitehtia vakituiseen tehtävään osaksi Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialueen tietohallinnon Asiakkuudet ja ratkaisut -yksikköä. Tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan laajojen digitaalisten palveluiden, tietojärjestelmien ja teknologiaratkaisujen kehittämiseen sekä varmistamaan, että hyvinvointialueen ratkaisut tukevat vaikuttavia, turvallisia ja sujuvia palveluita alueen asukkaille.

Mitä tehtävä sisältää?

ICT-arkkitehtina toimit keskeisessä roolissa hyvinvointialueen kehittämisessä ratkaisuarkkitehtuurin näkökulmasta. Vastaat vaativien kehityskokonaisuuksien ratkaisuarkkitehtuurista osana ratkaisutoimistoa, joka tukee toimialojen kehitystarpeiden arviointia, ratkaisujen suunnittelua ja kehittämisen ohjausta.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

- vaativien kehityskokonaisuuksien ratkaisuarkkitehtuurin suunnittelu ja ylläpito
- tietojärjestelmien, integraatioiden ja teknologiaratkaisujen kuvaaminen
- ratkaisuvaihtoehtojen arviointi ja vertailu toiminnan, kustannusten ja teknologian näkökulmista
- ratkaisujen turvallisuuden, tietoturvan ja lainmukaisuuden varmistaminen
- kehitystarpeiden arviointi yhdessä toimialojen asiantuntijoiden kanssa
- työpajojen fasilitointi ja ratkaisujen valmistelun tukeminen
- osallistuminen ICT-hankintojen valmisteluun, vaatimusmäärittelyihin ja teknologiavalintoihin
- ratkaisuarkkitehtuuridokumentaation tuottaminen ja ylläpito
- tiivis yhteistyö asiakkuusvastaavien, ratkaisusuunnittelijoiden, projektipäälliköiden, palveluvastaavien, arkkitehtien ja hankinta-asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Odotamme tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa tai muuta tehtävään soveltuvaa osaamista, joka on hankittu koulutuksen tai työkokemuksen kautta.

Arvostamme erityisesti:

- kokemusta ratkaisuarkkitehtuurista, kokonaisarkkitehtuurista tai laajojen tietojärjestelmäkokonaisuuksien suunnittelusta
- kykyä yhdistää toiminnalliset tarpeet teknisiin ratkaisuihin
- kokemusta integraatioista, tietovirroista ja järjestelmäkokonaisuuksista
- vahvoja vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja
- fasilitointiosaamista
- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä merkityksellisten palveluiden kehittämisen parissa sekä vaikuttaa hyvinvointialueen digitaaliseen tulevaisuuteen. Pääset osaksi asiantuntevaa ja yhteistyöhön perustuvaa työyhteisöä, jossa yhdistyvät toiminnan kehittäminen, teknologia ja moderni arkkitehtuuriajattelu.

Työskentelet laajassa yhteistyössä niin liiketoiminnan, tietohallinnon kuin ulkoisten kumppaneiden kanssa ja pääset osallistumaan monipuolisiin kehityshankkeisiin sekä hyvinvointialueen kehittämistiekartan toteuttamiseen.

Tule mukaan rakentamaan vaikuttavia digitaalisia palveluita

Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialueella teemme työtä sen eteen, että palvelut ovat sujuvia, turvallisia ja asiakaslähtöisiä. ICT-arkkitehtina olet avainroolissa varmistamassa, että teknologiset ratkaisut tukevat tätä tavoitetta nyt ja tulevaisuudessa.

Miksi Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue?

Meillä hyvinvointi ja arjen sujuvuus ovat aidosti tärkeitä. Tarjoamme lounasedun sekä 400 euron Epassi-edun liikuntaan, kulttuuriin, hyvinvointiin tai työmatkoihin. Lisäksi hyvinvointiasi tukevat lakisääteiset työterveyspalvelumme.

Olemme ihmisläheinen organisaatio, jossa kehitämme toimintaa rohkeasti ja yhdessä. Meillä johtaminen on lupaus selkeistä tavoitteista, arvostavasta kohtaamisesta ja rohkeasta yhdessä uudistamisesta.

Saat selkeän näkymän omaan työhösi sekä mahdollisuuksia kokeilla ja kehittää uusia tapoja tehdä työtä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia myös oman osaamisesi vahvistamiseen ja urasi kehittämiseen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä joka päivä: autamme, hoidamme ja pelastamme.

Tutustu meihin tarkemmin > [Meille töihin-sivullamme](https://vakehyva.fi/fi/tyopaikat)

jobs.title: Operatør til Stena
jobs.description:
Trives du med rutineprægede opgaver, hvor kvalitet og sund fornuft er i højsædet? Vil du være med på en vækstrejse, hvor teamet går fra 5 til over 20 ansatte, og hvor dit arbejde gør en direkte forskel for miljøet? Så er det nu, du skal slå til!

Om Stena Recycling

Stena Recycling er førende inden for bæredygtige affaldsløsninger. De lever af at give ressourcer nyt liv, og på deres lokation i Roskilde har de stort fokus på batterisortering. De er en arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerheden altid kommer først, og hvor man vægter et godt fællesskab højt. De står over for en spændende udvidelse – særligt i forhold til håndtering af elbilsbatterier – og mangler de rette hænder til at hjælpe dem med at bygge fundamentet for fremtiden.

Særligt for lokationen i Roskilde er, at der udelukkende håndteres to typer affald: Batterier og på sigt elbilsbatterier- en vigtig opgave inden for det grønne område, der kun bliver større med tiden

Om jobbet

Som operatør hos Stena Recycling bliver du en central del af deres sorteringsflow, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre korrekt håndtering og sortering af batterier direkte ved produktionsbåndet. Arbejdet kræver både koncentration og fysisk indsats, da batterierne sorteres manuelt for at sikre, at de værdifulde nikkelmetaller kan udvindes og genbruges.

Sideløbende med sorteringsarbejdet vil du stå for den interne logistik, hvor du betjener mindre gaffeltrucks, stablere og klemmetrucks til at afhente, transportere og placere materialerne de rette steder på pladsen.

Da afdelingen er i vækst, vil hverdagen også byde på diverse ad hoc-opgaver og forfaldent arbejde.

  • Arbejdstider: Vi kører pt. skiftehold med dertilhørende tillæg. Dog er det også muligt at arbejde rent daghold eller rent aftenhold, men ideelt set vil vi gerne have et skiftehold op og stå.

Din profil:

Vi leder efter dig, der møder ind med en positiv indstilling og en god portion sund fornuft. Da vi arbejder med materialer, der skal behandles på en speciel måde, er det vigtigt, at du er kvalitetsbevidst.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Du kan have en baggrund som procesoperatør, produktion, lager eller lignende.

Du taler og forstår dansk.

Du har almindeligt kørekort B.

Du har truckcertifikat

Har du kurset "Varmt arbejde!" er det en fordel

Som person trives du i et arbejdsmiljø med faste rutiner, hvor du sætter en ære i at levere en ensartet høj kvalitet i din sortering. Da sikkerhed er højeste prioritet, forventer vi, at du møder ind med sund fornuft og en ansvarsbevidst indstilling til dit arbejde og dine kolleger.

Vi tilbyder:

Hos Stena Recycling bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor din sikkerhed, tryghed og trivsel altid kommer i første række. Vi tilbyder et job med gode rotationsmuligheder og hjælpsomme kolleger i et stærkt fællesskab, hvor kvalitet og hjælpsomhed er i højsædet. Du får rig mulighed for at tage ansvar og udvikle dig personligt i takt med, at deres afdeling vokser.

Stillingen starter som et Try & Hire-forløb med gode muligheder for efterfølgende fastansættelse for den rette kandidat. Som ansat får du naturligvis stillet arbejdstøj til rådighed og en frokostordning.

Ansøgning og kontakt:

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på "ansøg". Randstad varetager rekrutteringsprocessen på vegne af Stena Recycling. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt, og der afholdes løbende interviews. Så send gerne din ansøgning så hurtigt som muligt, hvis du vil med på holdet.

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Liv Nielsen på liv.nielsen@randstad.dk.

Om Randstad:

Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle, uanset baggrund, og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
O’Carroll Engineering is an innovative, off-site modular engineering steel fabrication specialist. Established in 1990 we combine a highly skilled workforce with technologically advanced and digital fabrication methods to produce efficient-install solutions to industrial and construction markets. Specialists in modular walkways and access systems, stairs and modular apartment balconies. O’Carroll Engineering is offering an opportunity to join our 165+ strong, highly skilled team and be a part of an innovative, technology-driven, industry-leading manufacturer. Our team members are at the core of our growth and we endeavour to strike the best possible work-life balance along with training and advancement opportunities to ensure we challenge and motivate employees. Located in one of Ireland's most vibrant and scenic towns Killarney, we are proud that the majority of our staff have over five years of service with us. For more information visit www.ocarrollengineering.com. We are expanding our innovative, award-winning team and currently seeking a Metal Fabricator. The Metal Fabricator is part of the team of Fabrication Technicians, Metal Fabricators and Welders who fit and weld steel components. The Metal Fabricator will primarily work from technical drawings to fabricate, fit and tack weld competent parts before the item is moved on for welding. The role will require the fabrication of components using a jig. The Metal Fabricator will work under the direction of the workshop supervisors to produce components to the standard required. The Metal Fabricator is responsible for checking that their work is produced in accordance with technical drawings provided and that the component is handed over to the welder in an acceptable condition for welding. Main duties: Lead and interpret technical drawings to produce steel components Take measurements to ensure accuracy Cutting steel as required Use welder to tack components Ensure components are as per the specification required Work from jigs as required Operate power and hand tools to complete jobs Run machines as required to complete jobs Maintain all health and safety standards at all times This list is not exhaustive and duties may be amended, added or removed Minimum requirements of Fabricator: Experience in the fabrication of metal components from technical drawings Working knowledge of steel Previous experience in a manufacturing or production environment Team player Proven ability to multi-task Flexibility to move between projects The Metal Fabricator role requires a minimum of 39 hours per week, Monday to Friday. A reasonable level of overtime may be required at morning, evening or weekend time to ensure the fulfilment of the requirements of this role.

jobs.title: Student Assistant– Cyber Security & Compliance
jobs.description:
Want to gain hands-on experience within cyber security and compliance, in critical IT infrastructure?

Join our Infrastructure & Security team and get hands-on experience with vulnerability management, audits, access governance, security reporting, and compliance activities. You'll work alongside experienced specialists and help protect business-critical systems while building valuable real-world skills.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

The Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnet, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centers, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

You can read more about Nordic RCC and the services we deliver on our website https://nordic-rcc.net/ 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant – Cyber Security & Compliance who likes to make a difference!

Job description:

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support the Infrastructure & Security team. The role will work closely with the Cyber Security and Compliance functions, helping maintain governance processes, security operations, reporting, and documentation while gaining practical experience within enterprise IT security and compliance. The position supports activities within vulnerability management, access governance, audits, and security reporting.

Responsibilities:

Security Operations Support

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Assist with endpoint compliance reviews and Intune-related administrative activities.

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Coordinate follow-up with system owners and suppliers regarding security findings.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Collect, organize, and maintain audit evidence.

  • Support preparation for internal and external audits.

  • Maintain compliance documentation and evidence repositories.

  • Track audit findings and remediation activities.

Access Management & Governance

  • Assist with periodic access reviews.

  • Track completion of access review activities.

  • Help maintain governance processes and security controls documentation.

Documentation & Process Management

  • Update security procedures, standards, and runbooks.

  • Maintain SharePoint-based documentation repositories.

  • Ensure documents are reviewed and updated according to governance requirements.

Requirements:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within IT, Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Structured and detail-oriented approach to work.

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Excel, and SharePoint is an advantage.

  • Interest in cyber security, governance, risk, and compliance.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note:

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 30/09/2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

jobs.title: Hinnoittelija/myyjä, Relove, Helsinki
jobs.description:
Nyt on loistava mahdollisuus päästä osaksi Reloven lämminhenkistä ja inspiroivaa tiimiä! Etsimme uutta työkaveria vahvistamaan second hand -toimintaamme Helsingin Punavuoren ja Töölön myymälöissä.

Relove on kotimainen, arvoihin nojaava perheyritys, joka yhdistää vastuullisen muodin, laadukkaan kahvilakulttuurin ja sydämellisen asiakaspalvelun ainutlaatuiseksi kokonaisuudeksi. Liikkeemme ovat kokonaisvaltaisia elämyksiä, jossa laatu, estetiikka ja tunnelma kohtaavat.

Hinnoittelijan tehtävässä yhdistyvät second hand -vaatteiden ja asusteiden hinnoittelu sekä myymälätyöskentely. Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on vahva kiinnostus muotiin, erinomainen tuotetuntemus sekä kyky tunnistaa laadukkaat ja halutut tuotteet.

Hinnoittelijan työssä arvioit asiakkaiden myyntiin tuomia vaatteita ja asusteita sekä määrittelet niille Reloven hinnoitteluperiaatteiden mukaisen myyntihinnan. Arvioinnissa huomioit muun muassa tuotteen brändin, materiaalit, laadun, kunnon, ajankohtaisuuden, sesongin, kysynnän sekä second hand -markkinan hintatason. Tavoitteena on rakentaa asiakkaidemme iloksi laadukas, kiinnostava ja kaupallisesti houkutteleva valikoima.

Hinnoittelun lisäksi työskentelet tarvittaessa myyjänä Relove Fredan ja Töölön myymälässä. Myyjän työhön kuuluu asiakaspalvelua, kassatyöskentelyä, tuotteiden esillepanoa, myymälän visuaalisesta ilmeestä huolehtimista sekä muita myymälän päivittäisiä tehtäviä. Relovessa visuaalisuus ja inspiroiva ostokokemus ovat tärkeä osa konseptiamme, joten pääset myös vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä myymälämme näyttää ja tuntuu.

Vastapainoa vaihtelevalle ja vauhdikkaalle työpäivälle tuovat ihanat asiakkaat, lämmin työyhteisö sekä mahdollisuus työskennellä vastuullisen muodin parissa. Relovessa persoonallisuus saa näkyä ja omaa osaamista sekä näkemyksiä pääsee aidosti hyödyntämään työn arjessa.

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos sinulla on

- vahva osaaminen vaatealasta, brändeistä, materiaaleista sekä niiden hintatasosta
- luontainen intohimo muotiin ja trendien seuraamiseen
- second hand -markkinan tuntemus
- kyky arvioida tuotteiden laatua, kuntoa ja jälleenmyyntiarvoa
- tarkka ja tehokas työskentelyote sekä kyky tehdä itsenäisesti päätöksiä
- positiivinen ja asiakaslähtöinen palveluasenne

Vaatealan koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätön. Arvostamme ennen kaikkea käytännön vaateosaamista, second hand -tuntemusta sekä vahvaa kaupallista silmää.

Työsuhteen tiedot

- Työsuhdemuoto: Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, osa-aikainen
- Työaika: 30 h / viikko, maanantaista sunnuntaihin 07-21 välisenä aikana
- Palkkaus: Kaupan alan TES, palkkaryhmä B (13,66-15,64€/h)
- Aloitus: mahdollisimman pian
- Työsuhde-edut: ePassi-edut, kattava työterveyshuolto, alennus kahvilatuotteista sekä vaatteiden myyntijaksosta Reloven myymälässä

Mikäli jaat arvomme vastuullisuudesta, edelläkävijyydestä ja lempeydestä sekä tunnet second hand -maailman omaksesi, hae mukaan joukkoomme! Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Barona toimii rekrytoinnin yhteistyökumppanina, valitut henkilöt solmivat työsuhteet Reloven kanssa.

HUOM! Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia.

Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. Täytät profiilisi vain kerran, minkä jälkeen voit hakea kaikkia Baronan työpaikkoja samalla profiililla. Suosittelemme sinulle sopivia työpaikkoja työkokemuksesi, koulutustaustasi ja taitojesi perusteella. Barona Careers tekee työnhaustasi helpompaa kuin koskaan!

jobs.title: Byggdrifter
jobs.description:
Vil du være med å ta vare på byggene som betyr mest for innbyggerne i Stavanger?

Som byggdrifter i Stavanger kommune får du en variert arbeidshverdag med ansvar for alt fra historiske bygg i Gamle Stavanger til moderne tekniske anlegg i skoler, barnehager, sykehjem, kulturbygg og administrasjonsbygg.

Hos oss får du bruke fagkompetansen din, løse praktiske og tekniske utfordringer og ta ansvar for at byggene fungerer slik de skal. Du får stor grad av selvstendighet i arbeidshverdagen, samtidig som du blir en del av et stort fagmiljø med kollegaer innen flere tekniske fag.
Stavanger kommune har en av regionens største og mest varierte eiendomsporteføljer. Seksjon Byggdrift har ansvar for drift og oppfølging av over 650 kommunale bygg og rundt 3 000 boliger.

Vi søker nå fire byggdriftere i 100 % faste stillinger til ulike deler av kommunens bygningsportefølje.


Én av stillingene vil ha Rennesøy og Finnøy som sitt primære arbeidsområde. Oppgi gjerne i søknaden dersom du er spesielt interessert i denne stillingen.
Blant byggene vi ønsker å styrke oppfølgingen av er Sølvberget bibliotek og kulturhus. Vi er derfor også interessert i kandidater som motiveres av å jobbe med et stort og publikumsintensivt bygg med varierte tekniske og driftsmessige behov. Oppgi gjerne i søknaden dersom arbeid knyttet til Sølvberget er av særlig interesse.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Drift og oppfølging av kommunale bygg og boliger
  • Oppfølging og kontroll av tekniske anlegg
  • Utførelse av planlagte drifts- og vedlikeholdsoppgaver
  • Internkontroll og oppfølging av lovpålagte oppgaver
  • Registrering, dokumentasjon og rapportering i digitale FDV-systemer
  • Behandling og oppfølging av innmeldte avvik
  • Samarbeid med brukere, leverandører og kollegaer
  • Bidra til systematisk, bærekraftig og forebyggende byggdrift
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagbrev som byggdrifter er ønsket kompetanse og vil bli vektlagt
  • Har du et annet relevant teknisk fagbrev, ønsker vi også å høre fra deg. Erfaring fra byggdrift, tekniske anlegg og systematisk oppfølging av bygg vil bli særlig vektlagt
  • God digital kompetanse og evne til å bruke digitale arbeidsverktøy
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Førerkort klasse BE er en fordel
Personlige egenskaper
  • Vi ser etter deg som:
  • Tar ansvar og jobber selvstendig
  • Er praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet
  • Er serviceinnstilt og trives med kontakt med brukerne av byggene våre
  • Jobber strukturert og er opptatt av kvalitet
  • Er nysgjerrig og ønsker å utvikle deg faglig
  • Ser verdien av god og forebyggende byggdrift
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
Vi tilbyr
  • En variert arbeidshverdag hvor ingen dager er helt like
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og ansvar i egen arbeidshverdag
  • Arbeid med alt fra historiske bygg til moderne tekniske anlegg
  • Et av regionens største fagmiljøer innen byggdrift og teknisk eiendomsforvaltning
  • Et arbeidsmiljø hvor vi deler kunnskap, hjelper hverandre og gjør hverandre gode
  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling innen byggdrifterfaget og moderne byggdrift
  • Mulighet til å være med og utvikle hvordan Stavanger kommune drifter byggene sine
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP
  • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk

Lønn

  • Byggdriftere med fagbrev i byggdrifterfaget lønnes for tiden innenfor lønnsspennet kr 561 600–578 000 (751700 – Fagarbeider)
  • Søkere med andre relevante fagbrev lønnes for tiden innenfor lønnsspennet kr 528 000–550 000 (751700 – Fagarbeider)
KontaktinformasjonJunhild Driftland, Gruppeleder, 97530434
Andrè Strøm, Gruppeleder, 94003140
ArbeidsstedFabrikkveien

Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Stavanger kommune

Referansenr.: 5171247040
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 07.09.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere.

Vi mener inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi jobber for heltidskultur med mål  om å ansette i hele stillinger.

Som ansatt i Stavanger kommune får du utgjøre en forskjell for kommunen og innbyggerne og blir en del av en spennende storbyregion. 

Vi bygger fellesskap ved å være nære, åpne og nyskapende

Offentlig søkerliste: 
Stavanger kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

Politiattest:
Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse for stillinger der det er påkrevd iht. lovverk.

Vedlegg:
Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å bruke Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning utført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (eller NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

jobs.title: Sales Recruiter
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sales Recruiter you’ll help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization. You’ll recruit for new and evolving customer-facing roles—including Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, and Forward Deployed Engineers—that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner with Sales leaders and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires.

You will use Notion every day in the same way our customers do, giving you firsthand insight into the workflows and AI transformation behind the roles you are hiring for. You will also help build a new GTM motion at the intersection of AI, workflow design, enterprise transformation, and customer outcomes. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build trusted partnerships with Sales leaders, advising on role definition, search strategy, assessment design, and hiring decisions for new and evolving teams.

 - Deliver high-quality hires across the next generation of GTM roles, from sourcing through close, while creating a thoughtful, inclusive, and high-touch candidate experience.

 - Translate Notion’s product love, AI opportunity, and customer motion into accurate candidate narratives that help the right people self-select in.

 - Use talent-market research, mapping, and recruiting data to improve hiring strategy and decision quality.

 - Raise the quality and consistency of the hiring system through structured intake, calibration, debriefs, manager coaching, and sourcing strategies that expand representation.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Demonstrated success recruiting across GTM searches, with the judgment to learn and represent evolving role profiles accurately.

 - Ability to turn business strategy into clear candidate profiles, search plans, and objective assessment criteria—and to influence senior leaders toward strong decisions.

 - Strong sourcing, market-mapping, and closing instincts across various Sales disciplines.

 - Operational rigor and comfort using data to diagnose pipeline health, measure impact, and improve the candidate and hiring-manager experience.

 - Curiosity, learning agility, and a hands-on approach to AI tools: you use them to think better, improve recruiting workflows, and make your work easier for others to build on. 

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $136,000 - $170,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. jobs.title: Renewables Project Scheduler
jobs.description:
Apply

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

jobs.title: Procurement Lead Buyer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Procurement Lead Buyer (m/f/d)

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.

Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg

We are looking for a Lead Buyer (m/f/d) for our Procurement team

As a Lead Buyer reporting to the Procurement Manager, you will play a key role in supporting and developing the procurement function at KPMG Luxembourg. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and purchasing activities across your assigned procurement categories while working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver value through strategic procurement initiatives.
In this role, you will contribute to the development of purchasing strategies, supplier optimization initiatives and cost-saving opportunities. You will also ensure compliance with procurement policies, maintain strong supplier relationships and support the continuous evolution of the procurement function.

What you will be working on

• Propose and develop purchasing strategies for assigned procurement categories.
• Analyze spend allocation, supplier portfolios and procurement opportunities.
• Develop short-, medium- and long-term action plans including spend optimization, contract renewal strategies, supplier rationalization and risk mitigation initiatives.
• Participate in defining savings targets and identifying opportunities for improvement.

Job Description & Summary

Your mission: Today's business environment is more complex than ever. More automated. More connected. More virtual. With these advances comes opportunity, but also risk.  
  
As an Internal Control Senior Associate, you will:

• Work as part of a team of problem solvers in a highly dynamic environment with international teams, proactively assisting in the management of several projects, while reporting to the managers and above;
• Establish effective working relationships with the clients' representatives;
• Train and lead various teams of associates and trainees;
• You will regularly collaborate with professionals from both business and technology to help advise clients on operational risks related to business processes, applications as well as risk management framework and risk assessments;
• Depending on your background and areas of focus, you will have the chance to be involved in projects where you will:
• Participate in internal control review assignments covering a wide and interesting array of businesses processes for clients in the financial, private and public sector;
• Perform risk assessments, process and internal control reviews in order to improve the operational risk management and internal controls framework of clients;
• Review your work and that of others for quality, accuracy and relevance;
• Submit it for the manager's review within the established deadline;
• Support business development activities to identify and research opportunities for new projects or clients.
  
Be a part of our team where you will have:  

• The possibility to discover and gain a deep expertise in various economic sectors and industries;
• Challenging and rewarding work environment;
• Systematic education process to support professional and personal development and on-the-job training;
• The chance to work in a dynamic environment of multicultural teams while enjoying a competitive remuneration package and contributing to a societal impact;
• A flexible learning and development policy that will enable you to design and schedule your training plan based on your needs and personal aspirations;
• Full support in your plans of upgrading your skills through participation in external relevant courses, drafting of thought leadership publications or network driven working groups;
• Stimulating work environment with workplace flexibility, and an open-minded team for new and innovative ideas.
  
Let's talk about you. If you …  

• You hold a Bachelor or Master degree in a relevant field (e.g.: Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Management Information Systems & Accounting, Computer and Information Science, Computer and Information Science & Accounting, Economics, Economics and Finance, Economics and Finance & Technology, Business Administration/Management, Engineering, Accounting & Technology, Mathematics or other related studies);

• Understand internal controls and the external audit process;
• Leadership, interpersonal, communication and good writing skills;
• Demonstrate problem solving skills and the ability to prioritise and handle multiple tasks;
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment;
• Team player and keen learner;
• You have a good command of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint);
• You are fluent in English and French (the languages commonly spoken by our clients).

…You are the candidate we are looking for!

Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 450 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.

Our service to clients is differentiated by the end-to-end specialist advice we offer, covering all legal, regulatory, taxation, and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg.

Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.

Experienced Investment Funds Lawyer – Private Wealth

Provide strategic advice to an international clientele of Family Offices and High Net Worth Individuals, guiding them in the structuring and implementation of bespoke investment vehicles, including private investment funds, holding structures, and co investment platforms;

• Oversee the creation and coordination of tailored regulated and unregulated investment structures that reflect clients' wealth management, succession planning, and asset protection objectives;

Luxembourg

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
Join our Luxembourg team where your expertise directly contributes to humanity's greatest adventure, while maintaining the work-life harmony that makes great engineering possible. Be part of a collaborative, inclusive culture where safety and technical excellence drive every decision as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight from the heart of Europe.
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
As part of a hardworking team of supply chain professionals, technicians, and engineers, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our organization adheres to all relevant regulations, develops automated compliance reports, and educates our teams on designing compliant processes. The International Supply Chain Manager manages relationships with non-US external vendors and suppliers, ensuring contractual obligations are fulfilled while protecting the organization's interests, maintaining compliance, and optimizing.

Special Mentions:

Relocation provided
Travel expected up to 25% of the time
Interviews may will include a technical assessment

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Global Supplier Development & Relationship Management

Identify, evaluate, and onboard suppliers across international markets based on quality, capacity, reliability, and cost
Build and nurture cross-cultural business relationships that respect regional practices and communication styles
Monitor supplier performance against KPIs and implement improvement strategies across global operations

International Contract & Financial Management

Negotiate and administer agreements compliant with multiple legal jurisdictions and international standards
Leverage global market intelligence to secure optimal pricing while balancing quality and risk
Manage currency fluctuations, payment terms, and financial controls across international transactions
Maintain comprehensive documentation of all contract activities and changes

Global Compliance & Risk Mitigation

Ensure adherence to international trade regulations, export/import laws, and country-specific requirements
Identify and address risks unique to global procurement (political instability, logistics disruptions, trade disputes)
Implement appropriate risk management strategies through contract terms, insurance requirements, and contingency planning
Coordinate quality assurance across international suppliers to maintain consistent standards

Global Supply Chain Optimization

Manage international logistics, customs clearance, and documentation requirements
Implement efficiency improvements in global procurement processes and inventory management
Generate performance analytics on international supplier metrics and compliance reporting
Stay informed about international market trends and regional business conditions that impact supply chain decisions

Strategic Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with legal, finance, engineering, and logistics teams across global operations
Align international procurement activities with organizational objectives and program requirements
Facilitate effective communication between international suppliers and internal stakeholders
Serve as subject matter expert on global sourcing strategies and international supply markets

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, international business, or related field
Experience: 5+ years in international procurement or supplier management
Language Skills: Proficiency in multiple languages relevant to key supplier regions
Knowledge: Understanding of international trade laws, customs regulations, and global logistics
Travel Capability: Willingness to travel internationally (typically 20-30%)
Cultural Competence: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures and business environments
Technical Skills: Proficiency with global procurement systems and international payment platforms
Domain Expertise: Engineering, Manufacturing or Procurement experience across multiple aerospace domains and commodities

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelors degree and/or previous working experience as an Engineer, Apprentice or Technician
Experience working in a multi-cultural environment with both internal and external customers and stakeholders
Experience with ISO 9001, AS9100, or other quality management systems in aerospace
Fluent in multiple languages

Culture Statement

Don't meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right
candidate for this or other roles.

Criminal Record Check

Given the nature of the work we do at Blue Origin, which allows access to sensitive and proprietary information of our company and customers, please be aware that, in accordance with the amended law of 29 March 2013 on the organisation of criminal records, the selected candidate will be requested to provide an extract from the criminal record (bulletin n°3)

We're committed to building the road to space so our children can build the future. We are a mission-driven company focused on ideas and innovation, and encourage fresh perspectives from bold voices. At Blue, our team is building the future as their unique selves. Thank you for your interest in working at Blue Origin

Information Security Officer

About Luxtrust

We are a multicultural and forward-thinking qualiﬁed Trust Services Provider based in Capellen, Luxembourg, with over 110 professionals and actively expanding our business internationally. We provide state-of-the-art on on-boarding, digital identities, strong authentication and security services, and qualiﬁed electronic signatures, all bundled into integrated digital documents & identity management solutions.

As a Trusted Partner, we prioritize building long-lasting relationships with our international clients and stakeholders, based on trust and integrity. We strive to be a Committed Partner, dedicating ourselves to delivering exceptional performance and showing steadfast commitment to make a positive impact. As a Visionary Scout, we are constantly seeking out new opportunities for growth and innovation, always staying ahead of the curve in our industry.

Join us in our mission to drive innovation and co-create a better future!

We are currently looking for a motivated and driven Information Security Officer.

Summary

This role contributes to improve IT security controls effectiveness, increase ISMS process maturity and keep IT risks exposure under accepted level by assisting the Chief Information Security Officer in its missions.

Missions of the role

• Security Operation activities such as vulnerability management; threats monitoring; threat prevention (phishing tentative, SIEM alerts) and log review. Improve threat detection capabilities by reviewing SIEM use cases on a regular basis in closed collaboration with our SOC partner.
• The security recurring controls annual plan such as access right reviews, suppliers due diligence, Supplier Review Meetings, hardening guide and CIS conformity audits of IT.
• Involved in penetration-testing campaign on corporate environment. Defines pen-testing scope, prepare and coordinate pen-testers activities, review pen-testing results with IT department and manage recommendations action plan.
• LuxTrust security controls: contribute to annual supplier due diligence assessment, represent department in the Compliance and audit exercises and maintain our security controls documentation accordingly.
• Security incident: Involved in security Incident review, problem review and associated KPIs / KRIs reporting.
• Contribute to an ongoing, proactive risk assessment program for all new and existing systems in our corporate environment and ensure that effective controls to manage these risks are in place against the company's goals and business processes.
• Participate in Audit ISO27001 and any other audits applicable to LuxTrust entities.
• Manages security awareness annual program.
• Implements security improvements by assessing current situation; evaluating trends; anticipating requirements; evaluation security incidents.
•  Provide Information Security advisory to both IT and Business units by assisting Legal, Compliance and Sales teams in due diligence exercises, new process flow or use cases and any security questions. Lead supplier due diligence assessment for the security aspects.
•  Maintain and improve ISMS documentation based on knowledge of best practices, regulatory requirements and specific needs of LuxTrust. Involved in procedures development and maintain it on annual basis. Participate to the Policy/Standards document review.
•  Assist the IT team in performing risk assessment related to technology implementation :
o Perform research and coordination with IT to drive security
o Perform research and recommendation of appropriate security protection products and services, such as log management, security event management, and intrusion detection
•  Project management of any related project.

Required skills

Qualifications / diploma(s): Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Information Security or related experience.

Years of experience in the area:

• 5+ years of experience in Information Technology with security focus.
• Experience in developing, documenting and maintaining policies, processes, procedures and standards
• Prior security audit experience would be an asset
• Knowledge of and experience in understanding documentation and regulatory compliance requirements is an asset.

Technical competencies:

• Skills and knowledge of IT, networks and Information security business
• PKI knowledge is an asset

Languages: French and English fluent. Any other language is an asset.

Specific skills:

• Strong analytical skills to analyze information security requirements and relate them to appropriate controls
• Organized, responsive, accountable and highly thorough of problem solving oriented and solution driven
• Ability to synthesize
• Proactive attitude
• Good team player and positive attitude in a challenging environment
• Strong communication and writing skills
• Foster teamwork and collaboration

Core competencies at LuxTrust:

• Analytical mindset & decision making
• Organizational fluency
• Personal effectiveness
• Results-driven
• Client service mindset
• Strategic vision
• Leadership

What we offer

• A permanent contract based in Capellen - Luxembourg
• A competitive salary, in accordance with your education and experience.
• Attractive benefits and advantages including an employee benefit plan, a gym, meal vouchers and additional holidays.
• A healthy work-life balance including flex work arrangements.
• Parking spaces for all employees.
• An open and transparent career path.
• Development and growth opportunities in a state-of-the art digital company.

Our company is committed to fair recruitment, based on the skills of each candidate, regardless of gender nationality, sexual orientation, religion, or any other discriminatory criterion.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Director, Product Design to lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, reporting to the Co-Founder & Head of Design.

This is a true player-coach role for someone who loves building products as much as leading people. You'll lead and develop a talented team of product designers while remaining deeply embedded in the work itself. You'll whiteboard with designers, navigate complex product decisions.

The Co-Founder & Head of Design remains closely involved in design critique and product quality. Your role is to lead the day-to-day design organization by creating the structure, alignment, and momentum that enable exceptional work. You'll stay two to three layers deeper than the Co-Founder & Head of Design on active initiatives, surfacing the context, tradeoffs, and insights needed to make thoughtful decisions without requiring constant immersion in every project.

Success in this role requires exceptional product judgment, strong design taste, technical fluency, and a collaborative approach. You're someone who naturally connects disciplines, elevates the people around you, and makes both the work and the team better every day.

 
 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, ensuring work is aligned, prioritized, and delivered to an exceptionally high standard.

 - Manage, mentor, and develop a team of product designers, helping them grow their craft, confidence, and impact.

 - Shape and elevate the customer journey

 - Work alongside designers every day by whiteboarding ideas, exploring alternatives, reviewing work in progress, and solving complex product and interaction challenges.

 - Stay deeply informed across active initiatives, surfacing the context and insights that enable the Co-Founder & Head of Design to engage quickly in meaningful design critique and high-impact product decisions.

 - Raise the quality of product design through thoughtful feedback, exceptional craft, and strong design taste.

 - Help evolve Replit's design practices, workflows, and team culture while preserving the speed and flexibility of a high-growth company.

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard exceptional product design talent as the organization grows.

 
 


WHO YOU ARE

You're a builder first and a manager second.

You enjoy being close to the work, helping designers think through difficult problems, and making good teams even better. You're equally comfortable sketching ideas on a whiteboard, giving thoughtful design feedback, coaching a designer through a difficult challenge, or partnering with engineering on implementation details.

You combine exceptional product judgment with strong design taste and technical fluency. You're collaborative, humble, curious, and energized by helping great work happen.

 
 


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience leading product design teams within high-growth technology companies.

 - Proven ability to balance people leadership with meaningful hands-on product design contribution.

 - A portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft, interaction design, product thinking, and systems thinking.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to deliver technically sophisticated products.

 - Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development in fast-moving environments.

 - Exceptional communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

 - Strong design taste, sound judgment, and a bias toward action.

 - Experience simplifying complex technical products into elegant, approachable user experiences.

 
 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience designing developer tools, technical products, or software creation platforms.

 - Experience building AI-powered products or AI-native workflows.

 - Coding experience or strong technical curiosity.

 - Experience growing design teams in startup or scale-up environments.

 - Active use of AI throughout your design process.

 
 


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

This isn't a traditional design leadership role.

We're looking for someone who thrives in the work, not above it. Someone who enjoys solving problems alongside designers, building strong partnerships across Product and Engineering, and bringing the depth of context that allows the Co-Founder & Head of Design to focus on the moments where their perspective has the greatest impact.

This is a role for someone who is excited by complex product challenges, passionate about developing exceptional designers, and motivated by building products that make powerful technology feel intuitive.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.title: Sejlmager, Autosadelmager, kalechesmed eller bare snild med hænderne.
jobs.description:
Sejlmager, Sadelmager eller bare snild med hænderne.

Velkommen til Schultz Sejlmageri ApS

Vi søger en ny kollega til vores systue/sejlloft i Kolding – en dygtig håndværker med flair for syning og sans for kvalitet. Har du erfaring med kalecher, sejl, telte eller autosadelmageri? Eller måske bare hænderne skruet rigtigt på og lyst til at arbejde i en niche, hvor ingen dage er ens? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Du bliver en vigtig del af vores produktion, hvor vi udvikler, opmåler og syr kalecher, sprayhoods og sejl til både samt diverse industrielle afdækninger. Du kommer også til at bidrage til den generelle udvikling af virksomheden og vores produkter. Er du uddannet sejlmager så vil du komme til at stå for vores sejlloft som indebærer kunderådgivning, reparationer af sejl, opmåling og montering samt bestilling af nye sejl hos det anerkendte mærke Hyde Sails.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Opmåling, tilpasning og syning af kalecher, sprayhoods og sejl

  • Arbejde med forskellige materialer og specialopgaver

  • Kvalitetskontrol og løbende forbedringer i processer og produkter

  • Samarbejde med kolleger i en travl og alsidig hverdag

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke være uddannet sejlmager – men du skal have erfaring med håndværksfag, hvor præcision og kvalitet er i fokus. Måske har du arbejdet med autosadelmageri, telte, møbelpolstring eller noget helt fjerde?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er dygtig til håndværk og har erfaring med syning

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Bevarer overblikket i travle perioder

  • Er løsningsorienteret og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Trives i en mindre virksomhed med stor frihed

Hvem er vi?

Schultz Sejlmageri er en mindre virksomhed fra 1897 med ca. 8 medarbejdere. det startede som en læderforretning med seletøj, som senere blev til autopolstring og fra 70erne var det primært bådbranchen der blev produceret til. vi levere til både private og erhverv, i både ind- og udland.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode fysiske rammer og flextid

  • En hverdag med frihed under ansvar

  • Mulighed for at præge din egen rolle

  • Et uhøjtideligt miljø med passion for faget

  • løn efter kvalifikationer

Klar til at komme med ombord?

Send din ansøgning og evt. CV til info@schultz-sejl.dk – eller kig forbi os på Hesselly 8, 6000 Kolding. mærk ansøgningen med Sejlmager.

Har du spørgsmål? Ring til Nicolai Schultz på 76 32 12 00.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette.

Skal vi sy noget stort sammen?✂️

Day-to-day of the role:
