jobs.title: Ajoneuvoasentaja/Korjaamopäällikkö
jobs.description:
AJONEUVOASENTAJA / KORJAAMOPÄÄLLIKKÖ

**ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy – Hyvinkää**

ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy on uusi, kasvava ja kehittyvä autokorjaamo Hyvinkäällä. Haemme nyt joukkoomme **kokenutta ajoneuvoasentajaa / korjaamopäällikköä**, joka haluaa ottaa vastuuta korjaamon päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja olla mukana rakentamassa yrityksestä juuri sellaisen kuin siitä parhaimmillaan voi tulla.

Tässä tehtävässä et ole vain asentaja muiden joukossa. Etsimme henkilöä, joka haluaa **ottaa vastuuta, kehittää toimintaa ja vaikuttaa siihen, mihin suuntaan yritys tulevaisuudessa menee.**

TEHTÄVÄ

Korjaamopäällikkönä vastaat korjaamon päivittäisestä toiminnasta yhdessä toimitusjohtajan kanssa. Työhön kuuluu sekä käytännön korjaamotyötä että korjaamon johtamiseen ja kehittämiseen liittyviä tehtäviä.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- Ajoneuvojen vianhaku, diagnostiikka ja korjaaminen

- Huolto- ja korjaustöiden suunnittelu ja työnjohto

- Asiakaspalvelu ja asiakkaiden kanssa asiointi

- Tarjouslaskenta ja töiden hinnoittelu

- Työmääräysten tekeminen ja töiden aikataulutus

- Varaosien ja tarvikkeiden tilaaminen

- Korjaamon päivittäisen toiminnan organisointi

- Työn laadun ja tehokkuuden seuranta

- Reklamaatioiden ja haastavien asiakastilanteiden hoitaminen

- Korjaamon toimintatapojen, palveluiden ja työskentelyn kehittäminen

- Työkalujen, laitteiden ja muiden hankintojen suunnittelu

- Muut korjaamopäällikön tehtävät


Tehtävässä pääset siis tekemään monipuolisesti **sekä käsillä että päällä**.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on vähintään noin **2–5 vuoden kokemus ajoneuvoalalta** ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti.

Sinulta odotamme erityisesti:

- Vahvaa ajoneuvojen teknistä osaamista

- Kykyä itsenäiseen vianhakuun ja vaativampienkin korjausten tekemiseen

- Oma-aloitteisuutta

- Vastuuntuntoa

- Hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Ongelmanratkaisukykyä

- Kykyä organisoida ja priorisoida työtehtäviä

- Halua kehittää sekä itseäsi että työpaikkaa

- Yrittäjähenkistä ja rakentavaa asennetta


**VAG-osaaminen katsotaan erityiseksi eduksi**, mutta haemme ennen kaikkea hyvää ja monipuolista ajoneuvoalan ammattilaista.

B-ajokortti on tehtävässä välttämätön.

MITÄ ME TARJOAMME?

ModHaus on uusi yritys, joten tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan asioihin tavalla, joka ei välttämättä ole mahdollista suuremmissa ja valmiiksi organisoiduissa korjaamoissa.

**Sinun ei tarvitse vain sopeutua valmiisiin toimintatapoihin – pääset rakentamaan niitä kanssamme.**

Kuuntelemme työntekijöiden kehitysehdotuksia ja haluamme antaa korjaamopäällikölle mahdollisimman hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittää toimintaa. Keskustelemme asioista yhdessä toimitusjohtajan kanssa, mutta tehtävässä on **suhteellisen vapaat kädet viedä korjaamoa haluttuun suuntaan**.

Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan esimerkiksi:

- Korjaamon toimintatapoihin

- Työkaluihin ja laitteisiin

- Palveluiden kehittämiseen

- Varaosahankintoihin ja yhteistyökumppaneihin

- Hinnoitteluun ja työn tehokkuuteen

- Asiakaspalveluun

- Korjaamon tulevaisuuden suuntaan


Ja mikä tärkeintä, **onnistuessasi sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa yrityksen mukana.**

MAHDOLLISUUS OSAKKUUTEEN

Tehtävässä on **mahdollisuus myöhemmässä vaiheessa yrityksen osakkuuteen**.

Etsimme siis henkilöä, joka ei välttämättä halua olla vain työntekijä, vaan jolla on halua ja kiinnostusta olla rakentamassa ModHausista pitkäjänteisesti menestyvää yritystä.

TYÖSUHDE

- **Tehtävä:** Ajoneuvoasentaja / Korjaamopäällikkö

- **Työsuhde:** Vakituinen

- **Työaika:** 37,5 h / viikko

- **Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian

- **Palkkaus:** Sopimuksen ja kokemuksen mukaan

- **Työpaikka:** Hyvinkää


KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos kuulostaa siltä, että tämä voisi olla sinun paikkasi, **lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille itsestäsi, työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaisena näet hyvän ja toimivan autokorjaamon.**

Hakemuksen voit lähettää sähköpostitse osoitteeseen:

**sami@modhaus.fi**

Voit hakea myös suoraan ilmoituksen hakulinkin kautta.

**ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy**_Rakennetaan yhdessä korjaamo, jossa haluaisimme itsekin asioida._

jobs.title: Barcelona Varmkundsförsäljning
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till varmkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 150 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Fleksibel Social- og sundhedsassistent søges til respiratorisk barselsvikariat fra 1. december med mulighed for fastansætteæse.
jobs.description:
Vi søger en social- og sundhedsassistent til to piger i hver sin invasive respiratoriske ordning i henholdsvis Slagelse og Kastrup. Stillingerne omfatter samlet 10 dagvagter fordelt på de 2 ordninger.

Pigen i Kastrup

Den unge pige har en medfødt hjerneskade, er uden verbalt sprog og har behov for omfattende pleje døgnet rundt, herunder 24-timers invasiv respiratorisk overvågning.

Hun bor hjemme hos sin far, som er en aktiv og vigtig del af hendes pleje. For at kunne yde den bedst mulige omsorg er det vigtigt, at du lærer hendes mimik, signaler og individuelle udtryk at kende. Plejen tilpasses løbende ud fra hendes symptomer, behov og dagsform.

Der er kat i hjemmet, og der er gode parkeringsmuligheder lige foran huset.

Pigen i Slangerup

Den unge pige bor på et bosted i Slangerup. Hun har Cerebral Parese og behov for hjælp i alle daglige aktiviteter. Hun har epilepsi, som håndteres af bostedets personale.

Hun har ikke et verbalt sprog, men kommunikerer gennem øjenkontakt og mimik. Hun er glad for aktiviteter og et aktivt hverdagsliv, og du vil derfor følge hende i forskellige gøremål såsom:

  • Svømning med sine forældre, hvor du overvåger fra bassinkanten

  • Udendørsaktiviteter og oplevelser i det fri

Fælles for begge ordninger er

  • Respiratorisk overvågning og invasiv behandling

  • Observation og håndtering af respiratorisk udstyr

  • Medicingivning og sondeernæring

  • Dokumentation og løbende observation af borgerens tilstand

  • Samarbejde med team, forældre, hjemmepleje/bostedets medarbejdere

  • Deltagelse i borgerens daglige aktiviteter og rutiner

  • At skabe ro, stabilitet og tryghed på dine vagter

Der udføres ingen personlig pleje i denne ordning. Din primære opgave er respiratorisk behandling, overvågning og håndtering af det respiratoriske udstyr.

Om jobbet 

Du skal være uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent, og meget gerne være have arbejdet som respiratorisk overvåger i en invasiv ordning. Men har du ikke certifikat, og ellers det rette match, så sørger vi for oplæringen og certificering på RCØ (Respiratorisk Center Øst).

Som del af teamet har du ansvar for;

  • Respiratorisk overvågning og behandling

  • Medicingivning og sondeernæring

  • Observation og dokumentation

  • At skabe ro, stabilitet og tryghed på dine vagter

Vagter

Der er 10 dagvagter fordelt over 6 ugers rul også weekend. Vagtlængden er 12 timer og 15 minutter. 

  • Dagvagt: kl. 07.00-19.15

Stillingen kræver, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og bidrage til et trygt og stabilt miljø for pigerne gennem hele vagten. 

Derudover arbejder vi med selvdækkende teams, hvilket betyder at teamet selv dækker ledige vagter ved bla. sygdom og ferie. Derfor har vi forventning om at vores kommende medarbejder er fleksibel. Oplæringen foregår både på dag vagt og nattevagt, der ligger fra kl. 19.00-7.15. Dette er for at få indblik i de daglige rutiner og have mulighed for at træde til ved sygdom.

Om dig

  • Du er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent

  • Har respiratorisk erfaring

  • Er rolig, ansvarsbevidst og selvstændig

  • Motiveres af at arbejde 1:1 i et roligt og struktureret miljø på flere ordninger

  • Er fleksibel og forstår værdien af at være en del af et selvdækkende team

  • Trives i et privat hjem/bosted og i dit eget selskab – også på nattevagter

  • Har bil og trives med at arbejde i forskellige hjem.

Vi tilbyder:    

✔ Faste vagter
✔ God work-life balance
✔ Grundig oplæring og certificering
✔ Mulighed for ekstra vagter

Hvorfor Olivia Danmark?
 Vi hylder mangfoldighed og skaber plads til både grin og omsorg i hverdagen. Samtidig får du rammer, der gør arbejdet både professionelt og personligt givende:

  • Grundig oplæring

  • Fast 6-ugers vagtrul

  • En fast områdeleder, der lytter og støtter

  • Personalemøder og supervision

  • Fællesskab, medindflydelse og gensidig fleksibilitet

Hos os er det vigtigt, at vi passer på både vores borgere og hinanden.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Kitt Borum Rusborg på mail kitt.rusborg@oliviadanmark.dk eller telefon +45 71 92 40 75

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Contract Manager @ Davie Shipyards in Finland
jobs.description:
**Calling all experienced contract managers who are ready for their next challenge!**

Are you a customer-centric and commercially minded contract management professional? Do you have exposure to working with complex and high-value projects? Are you motivated by taking ownership in a growth-seeking business environment?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Davie Shipyards in Finland** as their very first **Contract Manager**!

This newly established role will be part of the Legal team and offers a unique opportunity to help shape contract management practices and work at the interface between Projects, Procurement, Legal and Business teams. Due to a strong order book and the strategic decision to pursue growth, the operations of Davie Shipyards in Finland are expanding rapidly, making this a particularly exciting time to join the team!

_Davie Shipyards in Finland brings together Helsinki Shipyard in Helsinki and SATA Shipbuilding in Pori, combining internationally recognised Finnish shipbuilding expertise with some of the world's most demanding maritime projects. Davie, a privately held international marine group with operations in Canada, Finland, and the United States_, _is one of the world's leading builders of icebreakers, specialised vessels and offshore structures. As part of Davie, Davie Shipyards in Finland works on complex projects in Finland and internationally. You can learn more about Davie Shipyards in Finland athttps://helsinkishipyard.fi/company/helsinki-shipyard-oy/._

**In this role,** you will contribute to the successful delivery of complex international shipbuilding projects in direct customer-interface. In more practical terms, you will:

- Identify and manage contractual and commercial risks

- Serve as the first point of contact towards customers, ensuring that that they remain updated on the progress of the project

- Support in contract interpretation and implementation

- Manage change orders, contractual notices and claims processes

- Participate in contract negotiations and commercial discussions

- Ensure compliance with contractual obligations during project execution

- Develop contract management processes, templates and best practices

- Promote contractual awareness across the organisation


The legal team of Davie Shipyards in Finland works primarily from the Helsinki Shipyard office in southern Helsinki. While the team works flexibly, we are looking for someone who enjoys working mainly on-site and being an active part of the team's day-to-day collaboration. The role requires occasional travel.

You will join a growing team of a handful of legal professionals, and report to the Head of Legal of Davie Shipyards in Finland. You will also have a dotted reporting line to the Head of Sales and get support from your international contract management colleagues based in other Davie office locations.

**This role would be ideal for a contract management professional who:**

- has a relevant degree e.g. in Business, Engineering or Law, combined with 5+ years of experience in contract management, commercial management or project environments;

- has experience in working with complex commercial contracts and a strong understanding of contractual risk management, as well as experience in working with and supporting project organisations;

- works with a practical and commercially minded, customer-centric approach;

- is capable of building processes and best practices, and knows how to raise awareness and influence others across the organization; and

- has great communication skills and excellent working proficiency in both English and Finnish.


Experience in shipbuilding, industrial, construction, infrastructure or EPC projects is considered an advantage.

**Davie Shipyards in Finland offers you:**

- **Independent responsibility:** As the first Contract Manager to join Davie Shipyards in Finland, you will have an independent and integral role in supporting in large-scale, technically complex international projects.

- **Building a Contract Management Function in Finland:** You get to shape the way Davie Shipyards in Finland operates in terms contract management in Finland.

- **Frontline role:** You will have a frontline role working with clients, as well as in close co-operation internally with business, legal, procurement and project teams.

- **International & growth-seeking working environment**: You will be part of world-leading icebreaker and special vessel projects around the world, working with international customers and contractors and alongside colleagues across the Davie organisation in an actively growth-seeking corporate setting.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter no later than **3 September 2026.** If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjon's recruitment consultant Vilma Suomi (+358 50 360 5134 or vilma.suomi@minjon.fi).

_In line with the hiring policies ofDavie Shipyards in Finland, a security clearance based on the Security Clearance Act (726/2014) as well as drug testing will be performed on the selected candidate._

jobs.title: Barselsvikar som idrætskoordinator i socialpsykiatrien
jobs.description:
Så er chancen her for at blive vores nye idrætskoordinator i en periode. Vores nuværende idrætskoordinator skal på barsel og vi søger derfor hendes afløser i perioden fra d 1-11 2026 til forventelig sommer 2027.

Har du erfaring med idræt og brænder du for at udvikle fællesskaber for mennesker med psykiske sårbarheder?

Du vil være en del af socialpsykiatrien, som består af et bofællesskab, et midlertidigt botilbud for unge samt dagsbeskæftigelse, bostøtte og café. Derudover er der et senhjerneskadeområde ligeledes med dagsbeskæftigelse og bostøtte.

Idrætskoordinatoren skal dække ovenstående områder.

Derudover har psykiatrien en meget velfungerende idrætsforening, LIF, - Limfjordens idrætsforening. Foreningen blev stiftet i september 2015 med henblik på at skabe et meningsfuldt og aktivt fællesskab for psykisk sårbare borgere i Morsø kommune. Foreningen er under Dansk Arbejder Idræt og har et samarbejde med Idræt for Sindet foreninger i hele Danmark.

Som Idrætskoordinator skal du arbejde tæt sammen tæt med bestyrelsen i idrætsforeningen om at arrangere aktiviteter og arrangementer både lokalt og ved deltagelse i idrætsarrangementer/stævner i andre kommuner sammen med borgerne.

Som idrætskoordinator bliver du både koordinator, igangsætter, instruktør og støtteperson i foreningen. Der vil også være praktiske opgaver og der vil være administrative opgaver i forhold til driften af LIF.

Fagligt forventer vi, at du;

  • Har en idrætsprofil og en relevant uddannelse, som f.eks pædagog, fysioterapeut, ergoterapeut, lærer eller har en uddannelse indenfor idræt og sundhed eller tilsvarende
  • Har erfaring med frivillige foreninger, enten som træner, instruktør eller lignende og kan indgå i samarbejde med frivillige foreninger
  • Evner at tilpasse din træning og instruktion efter deltagernes niveau og særligt i forhold til ikke idrætsvante mennesker
  • Har erfaring med eller viden om de udfordringer, psykisk sårbare mennesker har i dagligdagen
  • Har erfaring med at motivere andre

Vi forestiller os, at du som person:

  • Er engageret og empatisk og vil møde borgerne med et åbent og anerkendende sind
  • Har et godt og smittende humør
  • Har en indfaldsvinkel, der er motiverende, støttende og inspirerende for den enkelte
  • Har forståelse for forskelligheden båret af respekt for andre
  • Er rolig og tydelig i din kommunikation
  • Brænder for at gøre en forskel
  • Er selvstændig og kan tage ansvar
  • Har det fint med, at mange timer og aktiviteter kan ligge efter kl. 16
  • Kan samarbejde tværfagligt med kollegaer på alle område

 

Vores mission er at styrke borgernes mestring i eget liv, i samspil med det omgivende samfund, så vi bidrager til øget inklusion. Det handler både om at skabe tryghed for borgeren og øget selvstændighed. Vores indsats baserer sig på at møde den enkelte borger, via den nære og anerkendende relation, samt tage udgangspunkt i dennes kompetencer. 

 

Løn- og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst. Desuden fastsættes lønnen efter aftale og under medvirken af den forhandlingsberettede organisation.

For yderligere oplysninger eller spørgsmål kontakt leder Inge Kappel på tlf. 99 70 66 64.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 17. september 2026.

Samtaler forventes afholdt d 28. september 2026.

Der vil blive søgt en straffeattest inden ansættelsen og denne skal være forenelig med ansættelse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Assistant Professors and/or Associate Professors in Clinical and Preventive Odontology
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark is seeking two motivated individuals for two fixed-term appointments (2 years, up to 37 hours per week, with the possibility of extension). The successful candidates will have the opportunity to contribute to the establishment of the newly established Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and to play an active role in the development of the upcoming educational programmes for dentists and dental hygienists.

These positions offer a rare opportunity to influence the development of education, research, and clinical teaching from the very beginning, while joining an ambitious academic community dedicated to excellence, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

About the positions

We are seeking candidates with a broad background in dentistry and an interest in the development of university education.

We welcome applicants with diverse dental competencies and subspecialties, for example within:

  • Cariology and Endodontics

  • Periodontology

  • Prosthodontics

  • Orthodontics

  • Oral Surgery

  • Oral Medicine

  • Paediatric Dentistry

  • Clinical Dentistry in General

  • Preventive Dentistry

  • Digital Dentistry

The decisive factor is not your subspecialty alone, but your commitment to contributing to the development of a modern, research-led education in dentistry.

 

Main responsibilities

 

As part of the establishment and development of the department, you will be expected to contribute actively to:

  • the development of the new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, which are expected to commence in the summer of 2027

  • the planning and development of courses and teaching activities

  • teaching at both undergraduate and graduate levels

  • teaching dentistry and dental hygiene students

  • the development of clinical learning activities, simulation-based training, and competency-based education

  • student assessment and supervision

  • collaboration with clinical instructors, private training clinics, and other external partners

  • the development of the department’s teaching and learning environment

  • the development and implementation of research projects within clinical and preventive dentistry

  • scientific publishing and dissemination of research findings

  • the development of national and international research collaborations

  • securing external research funding and contributing to grant applications

Teaching will be based on evidence-based dentistry and will emphasize the close integration of basic sciences, clinical skills, and patient care.

Research

The department is concurrently establishing the Research Unit APEX, which aims to build strong national and international research environments within clinical and preventive dentistry.

We are therefore seeking candidates with an interest in research and academic development.

To be successful in this position, we expect you:

  • have documented research experience

  • have published scientific articles in peer-reviewed journals

  • are motivated to further develop your own research profile

  • have an interest in interdisciplinary and international collaboration.

The research component of the position will be tailored to the individual candidate’s qualifications and career stage.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

  • hold a degree in Dentistry

  • have obtained a PhD degree

  • hold Danish authorization to practice as a dentist, or meet the requirements for obtaining Danish authorization

  • combine strong clinical competencies with a well-developed scientific and analytical mindset

  • are motivated to contribute actively to the development of a new dental department

  • thrive in an interdisciplinary university environment

  • possess strong collaborative and interpersonal skills.

In addition, the following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • documented teaching experience

  • experience with curriculum development

  • experience supervising students

  • experience from specialist training or other advanced areas of clinical expertise.

For candidates appointed as Assistant Professors, participation in the Lecturer Training Programme (Universitetspædagogikum) is planned as part of the appointment.

 

Appointment to the positions requires academic qualifications at PhD level and in accordance with the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

 

What we offer

You will become part of a growing department with a unique opportunity to make a significant academic and professional impact.

Among other things, we offer:

  • the opportunity to help shape new educational programmes from the ground up

  • a strong research-based university environment

  • close integration of research, clinical practice, and teaching

  • excellent opportunities for academic career development

  • the opportunity to contribute to the establishment and development of the Research Unit APEX

  • an engaged and ambitious collegial environment with a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and innovation.

About the department

The Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) aims to advance and disseminate new knowledge within dentistry through excellent research, research-based education in SDU’s new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, and close collaboration with the healthcare sector.

The Department will educate the next generation of dentists and dental hygienists through research-based teaching, modern simulation and clinical training, and close engagement with the wider healthcare system, supported by a strong international research environment of the highest academic standard.

Our vision is to create a strong, internationally oriented research and educational environment where clinical excellence, evidence-based practice, and interdisciplinary collaboration go hand in hand.

Application deadline

October 19, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Contact

Further information about the position may be obtained from Professor and Head of Research Torben H. Thygesen, tthygesen@health.sdu.dk, +45 22 34 13 64, or Acting Head of Department and Dean Jakob Grauslund jgrauslund@health.sdu.dk, +45 93 50 70 42.

Salary and terms of employment 

The applicants will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as assistant professor or associate professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. 

In addition, a centrally agreed assistant professor or associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application 

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total): 

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 3 for assistant professors, and 6 associate professors, scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy 

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.   

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Assessment 

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process.  

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.  

Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

Join us in shaping the future of dentistry

We are seeking ambitious colleagues who wish to contribute to more than teaching alone. We invite dentists with a passion for academic development, research, and education to join us in building a new academic environment and educating the oral healthcare professionals of the future.

Together, we are creating the foundation for Denmark’s newest Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and shaping the future of dental education and research.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  • Med fordel har truckcertifikat og kørekort B.


Vores nye Lagermedarbejder
Du vil blive en del af at sikre, at vi efterlever vores værdier. Det betyder, at vi udviser ordentlighed, passion og stolthed overfor vores kunder, samarbejdspartnere, leverandører og kollegaer i det daglige arbejde. For at trives i rollen som lagermedarbejder er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og lægger vægt på det gode samarbejde.

  • Du er god til at planlægge og skabe struktur, og du evner at imødekomme forskellige kunder og hjælpe dem godt videre.

Den rette kandidat, for os, kan både være ufaglært eller faglært inden for lager/logistik, salg eller have en anden relevant uddannelse. Selvom produktkendskab og brancheerfaring kan være nyttigt, er det ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste for os er din interesse og motivation for at arbejde med lagerhåndtering, kundeservice og salg som en del af STARK holdet.

Bliv en del af STARK holdet

Hos STARK ser vi mangfoldighed som en værdifuld egenskab, og vores medarbejderes bidrag er nøglen til vores fremgang. Vi opfordrer derfor alle, som kan se sig selv i stillingen til at søge. Udover gode arbejdsforhold og ansættelse på overenskomst har vi personalepolitikker, der tilgodeser medarbejderen i tråd med STARKs værdi om ordentlighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer med arbejdstider mellem 6 til 17 og hver 3. weekend, og vi håber, at du kan starte snarest.

Send os dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge stillingen hos STARK Brønderslev via linket. Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og afslutter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK Brønderslev som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte Driftschef Majbrit Leer på telefon +45 51552114.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

___________________________________________________

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 80 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. STARK tilbyder også faglig rådgivning og en lang række services til både entreprenører og professionelle håndværkere. Virksomheden beskæftiger over 2.500 medarbejdere og er en del af STARK Group, der med flere end 19.000 medarbejdere og 1.100 forretninger og distributionscentre i Norden, Storbritannien, Tyskland og Østrig er en førende leverandør af byggematerialer i Europa.

STARK har tilsluttet sig FN’s Global Compact principper for ansvarlig virksomhedsførelse og arbejder med videnskabsbaserede mål for at holde den globale opvarmning under 1,5 °C. Målet er at nå netto nul emissioner inden 2050.

Vi bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

 - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer

 - Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline

 - Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path

 - Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

 - Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 1-3 years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room

 - Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

 - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

 - You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion


By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550.  https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Collaborate with business leaders, department heads, and operational teams to understand business needs, challenges, and opportunities and translate them into clear and actionable requirements. Analyse existing business processes, workflows, systems, and reporting structures to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement across business and operational functions. Document, structure, and prioritise business requirements to support the development and implementation of practical, technology-driven solutions. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation, with a focus on improving efficiency, accuracy, cost effectiveness, and overall business performance. Identify opportunities for automation and AI integration across daily, weekly, and monthly reporting and operational processes. Develop and support automated reporting solutions using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other reporting or data visualisation tools. Explore and support the introduction of AI-based tools and automation technologies to reduce manual workload in areas including reporting, data entry, scheduling, forecasting, and operational analysis. Work with internal teams and external IT providers to support the design, development, and implementation of business systems and digital solutions. Support system integration activities to ensure new tools and platforms operate effectively with existing business systems, processes, and workflows. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure business requirements are clearly communicated, understood, and appropriately delivered. Assist with solution design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support for new systems and business process changes. Develop and enhance management reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to support effective, data-driven decision-making. Support the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data across reporting and operational systems. Promote appropriate data governance practices, including compliance with GDPR and internal data security requirements. Translate technical concepts into clear business language and communicate business requirements effectively to technical stakeholders. Support training, onboarding, documentation, and change management activities to assist with the successful adoption of new systems, processes, and technologies. Promote continuous improvement and digital innovation across the organisation by identifying and supporting smarter and more efficient ways of working.

jobs.title: 1.assistent til rengøringsteam SMP - Fyn
jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til vores rengørings-team på Fyn.

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.09.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

jobs.title: Inspector, Private Home Cleaning  - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
RengøringsAgenterne ApS is looking for a dedicated inspector for our private home cleaning department

Do you have an eye for detail, and do you thrive in a role where quality and great customer relations go hand in hand? Then you might be our new inspector.

RengøringsAgenterne ApS is a Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified cleaning and property services company based in Kastrup. We have more than 200 employees, run a 100% electric vehicle fleet, and won the Børsen Gazelle award in both 2023 and 2024. We provide cleaning for housing associations, businesses and private customers across Greater Copenhagen – and it is our private customers you will be working with.

About the job

As inspector in our private cleaning department, you will be the link between our customers and our cleaning teams. You will report to the company's owner and managing director and play a central role in making sure quality is spot on every single time.

Your main tasks will be:

•      Quality control – ongoing inspection of completed cleaning in our private customers' homes

•      Quality reports – documentation and follow-up on inspection visits

•      Customer contact and relations – dialogue with customers, handling requests and feedback, and building long-term customer relationships

•      Operational support – hands-on support for the daily operations of the private cleaning department

Other tasks within the scope and responsibility of the position may also occur.

We expect that you

•      Have experience from the cleaning industry, the service industry or a similar role with quality responsibility

•      Have a sharp eye for detail and high standards for quality

•      Are outgoing and service-minded and enjoy daily customer contact

•      Communicate confidently in Danish, both spoken and written, including for reporting

•      Work in a structured and independent way and can plan your own day

•      Hold a category B driving licence, as the working day involves driving between customers

Experience with quality control or inspection work is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We offer

•      A full-time position of 40 hours per week with a fixed monthly salary

•      Employment as a salaried employee (funktionær) under proper terms – any overtime is compensated with time off in lieu at a 1:1 ratio

•      Health insurance paid by the company

•      A company car for work use by agreement, and work clothing where the position requires it

•      An informal and busy working day in a growing company with short decision-making paths

•      Green values in practice: Nordic Swan Ecolabel certification and an electric vehicle fleet

Practical information

•      Workplace: Fuglebækvej 3D, 2770 Kastrup – with daily driving to customers across Greater Copenhagen

•      Working hours: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday between 8:00 and 17:00 (Friday until 16:30)

•      Start date: As soon as possible, or by agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV via Jobnet or to privat@ren-agenterne.dk. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate – so send your application today.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to write to us at privat@ren-agenterne.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 5A0090 - Procurement Professional
Job flexibility: Hybrid

Please visit the following page for more information about the position and application process: https://careers.cern/jobs/procurement-and-contracts-officer/

jobs.description:
Position Overview: We are seeking a full-time Support & Training Specialist based in Copenhagen, Denmark. In this role, you will provide front-line technical assistance, software guidance, and application training to users of our clinical trial technology platform. Your primary responsibilities will focus on resolving user software inquiries, handling application data change requests, creating end-user documentation, and guiding platform onboarding. This role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to technical troubleshooting.

We are looking for candidates who are detail-oriented, responsive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Ideal candidates will demonstrate a passion for customer service, the ability to execute tasks with precision, and excellent communication and documentation skills.

What You’ll Do:

● User Application Support: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for software users across Europe and globally, diagnosing and resolving application usage questions via ticket or email.

● System & Data Management: Process application data change requests with accuracy, verifying data integrity within the platform.

● User Onboarding & Training: Conduct virtual application walkthroughs and training sessions to ensure platform users understand system functionality and protocol-specific workflows.

● Technical Documentation: Create, update, and maintain user-facing help guides, application FAQs, training manuals, and application release notes.

● Incident Logging & Escalation: Track, document, and reproduce technical software issues reported by users, escalating system bugs to internal engineering teams when necessary.

● Quality Assurance: Verify system functionality post-updates and contribute to feedback loops for software usability improvements.

 

 What You’ll Need:

● Strong interest in user support, software training, or technical help desk functions.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain software features clearly to non-technical users.

● High attention to detail and strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

● Ability to manage incoming support tickets effectively in a fast-paced environment.

● Experience creating software documentation, user guides, or training materials.

● Bachelor’s Degree preferred.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the  opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native level Japanese, business level English




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

jobs.title: Fundraiser til Humanitær Organisation i Malaga, Spanien
jobs.description:
Dansktalende FUNDRAISER til Malaga

Drømmer du om at kombinere sol, kultur og meningsfuldt arbejde? Tag din passion for humanitært arbejde til det smukke Malaga, Spanien, hvor hver dag er en mulighed for at gøre en forskel. For dette projekt gør en forskel for andre! Bliv en del af vores danske team og lad os sammen skabe positive forandringer i verden, mens vi nyder det spændende liv i solrige Spanien. 

Som fundraiser vil du være ansvarlig for at opbygge relationer og engagere potentielle donorer i vores mission om at støtte humanitære operationer. Dine primære opgaver vil omfatte at arrangere fundraisingkampagner og personligt interagere med en bred vifte af mennesker. Din evne til at kommunikere vores sag og værdier vil være afgørende for succes i denne rolle.

Kvalifikationer:

  • Gode dansk kundskaber (Engelsk & spansk ikke et krav) 

  • Gode kommunikationsfærdigheder 

  • Selvstændig og proaktiv arbejdsstil

  • Fordel: Interesse for humanitært arbejde og vilje til at gøre en forskel

  • Erfaring med fundraising eller salg vil være en fordel, men ikke et krav

Dette er en fuldtidsstilling baseret i Malaga, Spanien. Vi tilbyder en konkurrencedygtig løn, mulighed for lønstigning/bonus samt mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling i et inspirerende miljø. Du kan opnå værdifuld erfaring inden for forskellige humanitære organisationer, hvilket vil styrke dit CV betydeligt.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role:

Join our FDE team and work directly with some of the world's largest organizations to turn their most ambitious ideas into production applications on Replit. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner closely with customers to understand their technical and business needs, architect solutions, and build the integrations and applications required to deploy Replit successfully within complex enterprise environments.

This is a deeply technical and hands-on role. You won’t just advise customers on what to build—you’ll build alongside them. You’ll take applications from initial idea and prototype through deployment and production, navigate complex enterprise environments, and solve the technical challenges that emerge when AI-powered software development meets real-world infrastructure, data, security, and organizational constraints.



You will:

 - Build with Customers: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to design and build high-impact applications and AI-powered workflows on Replit, taking projects from initial concept through production deployment.

 - Architect Enterprise Solutions: Design secure, scalable architectures that connect Replit with customers’ existing systems, data, APIs, identity providers, and infrastructure.

 - Integrate with the customer's stack: SSO, data warehouses, internal APIs, and SaaS systems.

 - Own Technical Deployments: Serve as the technical owner for complex enterprise implementations, identifying blockers, debugging issues, and driving projects through to successful production adoption.

 - Bridge Customers and Product: Develop a deep understanding of how enterprises use Replit and translate field insights, technical constraints, and recurring customer needs into actionable feedback for Replit’s product and engineering teams.

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences

 - Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data

 - Turn field patterns into templates, playbooks, and product requirements. Ship the best patterns back to the platform.



Required skills and experience:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and deploying production software

 - Strong programming skills and the ability to quickly understand and work across unfamiliar codebases, APIs, and technical environments

 - Hands-on work with LLM applications in production: retrieval, tool calls, and evals.

 - Experience designing and owning complex technical systems from architecture through production

 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and independently drive technical projects to completion

 - Strong technical communication skills and experience working directly with customers, partners, or cross-functional stakeholders

 - Ability to translate business requirements and customer problems into pragmatic technical solutions



Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, consulting, or another highly technical customer-facing role

 - Experience building and deploying AI-powered applications, agents, or developer tools

 - Experience with modern cloud infrastructure, application deployment, databases, APIs, authentication, and enterprise integration patterns

 - Experience integrating software into complex enterprise environments, including identity and access management, internal data sources, APIs, and existing developer infrastructure

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Finance Systems & Compliance
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead the systems, data, and process work behind how we bill, recognize revenue, close the books, and prove our controls work.



You won't be writing the code or drawing the architecture; you'll be deciding what gets built, in what order, and why it matters. This is a role for someone who wants to understand a business well enough to change how it runs: learning the objectives, processes, and system flows end to end, then shaping them into strategic technical programs with real owners, deliberate sequencing, and decisions that hold up under audit. You'll sit between Finance and Accounting on one side and Engineering, Data, and Product on the other, and you'll be accountable for making new revenue streams operable and auditable, from a pricing model on a slide to a billed invoice, a booked journal entry, and a control that passes testing.



You'll report to the Lead Technical Program Manager for Data, Biztech & AI Transformation, within EPD. You'll get high-level direction and clear priorities from your manager, and independent ownership of how the work actually gets delivered. You'll bring engineering-side rigor and platform thinking to finance problems, and work as part of a team modernizing how the whole company operates.



Most of your time will go to three things: making new product and pricing launches work end to end in the finance stack, running the platforms and data flows behind quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and driving the IT general controls (ITGC) program so controls are designed into systems up front rather than retrofitted after go-live.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Act as Finance's technical counterpart on new product, pricing, and packaging launches, translating commercial models into requirements across order capture, rating and billing, tax, revenue recognition, and downstream reporting, and defining what "revenue-ready" means before go/no-go: who owns each piece, what's actually done versus asserted, and which risks are still cheap to fix

 - Broker the trade-off when a launch date and systems reality don't line up: a scoped manual workaround with an owner, a cost, and an expiration date, plus the path to the automated version. Then close the loop after launch on billing accuracy, exception rates, where revenue landed, whether the new controls actually operate, and what must be true to do this again at 10x volume

 - Independently own delivery and multi-quarter roadmaps for your finance systems programs, including ERP, billing and subscription management, CPQ, revenue subledger, procurement, and the reporting layer on top. Run the working groups that deliver them across Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Data, and Security, with clear accountability and updates leadership can read in two minutes

 - Run the operating rhythm: intake and prioritization, decision logs, early risk escalation, and a small set of metrics that show whether the work is actually improving anything, and flag early when committed scope and capacity don't line up

 - Map current-state processes and data lineage end to end and go after the breaks: reconciliation gaps, recurring manual journal entries, spreadsheets doing load-bearing work, competing sources of truth for the same metric. Partner with Data Engineering on the definitions and data contracts that let finance metrics tie cleanly to source systems, and hold the line when teams drift

 - Drive ITGC workstreams across in-scope financial systems: logical access and segregation of duties, change management, SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, job scheduling, and data interfaces. Partner with Internal Audit on scoping and control design, with a named owner for every control

 - Facilitate designing controls into new systems, systems changes, and launches before go-live with Controllership, Internal Audit, and Engineering, and serve as the systems-side point of contact for internal and external audit on ITGC walkthroughs and testing, translating between control language and engineering language, and driving deficiencies through root cause, named owners, evidence, and validation that the fix holds

 - Build AI-assisted workflows that expand what the teams around you can cover, and hold them to real standards: a defined task, a way to evaluate output quality, explicit human review gates on anything touching financial reporting, and documentation so someone else can run it




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 -  5+ years in technical program management, business systems, finance transformation, or a related field, with substantial time on finance or revenue systems; public-company or IPO-track experience is a strong plus

 - Working fluency in finance operations; you don't need to be an accountant, but you should hold your own on quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and know why revenue recognition is not the same as billing

 - Hands-on ITGC program experience across access, change management, and IT operations for in-scope financial systems, plus practical SOX knowledge. You understand how ITGC reliance determines what auditors will accept from automated controls and system-generated reports, can tell a key control from a non-key one, know where ITACs fit alongside ITGCs, and have been through remediation and audit cycles rather than only reading about them

 - AI-native operating mindset; this is a core requirement for this role. You already use AI to draft requirements, synthesize status, triage intake, and assemble evidence packages, and you share the patterns so others work differently because of what you built

 - A track record of independently delivering technical programs end to end, ideally transformation work such as system modernization, a large-scale migration, or an ERP or billing platform implementation, and turning messy or incomplete inputs into a concrete plan with owners and dates; you're pulled into problems before they're scoped and you're as useful advising a controller on process design as an engineering lead on sequencing

 - Working understanding of data lifecycle and analytics tooling, and real experience running change management for business systems, not just launching them

 - Influence without authority and a bias toward closure. You have no direct reports, so you work through credibility and clear reasoning, knowing when to push and when to escalate; you chase ambiguous items to a decision, will reopen the uncomfortable question a week before launch, and communicate clearly with Director/VP+ stakeholders, including when the news is bad




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Hands-on experience working in enterprise billing, ERP, and revenue systems such as NetSuite, Stripe, or comparable tools, with an understanding of how orders, invoices, and revenue data flow between them

 - Experience supporting an IPO readiness or first-year SOX program, including standing up ITGCs from scratch

 - CISA, CIA, or equivalent certification, or equivalent time embedded on an IT audit team

 - Experience building internal tooling or agents on a workspace platform rather than only configuring vendor systems

jobs.title: Director of Compensation Strategy
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ROLE SUMMARY

Replit is the world's most widely used AI coding platform, and as we scale, we're rebuilding how compensation works internally from the ground up. This role owns that. You'll go beyond traditional comp management to architect the systems, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled workflows that make fast, consistent, and high-quality compensation decisions possible at scale. 

You will serve as the architect of our compensation engine: translating compensation philosophy into scalable systems, and utilizing AI to improve speed, accuracy, and transparency. 

You will partner closely with People Business Partners, Recruiting, Finance, People Operations, and the Data team to embed compensation directly into company workflows, eliminating manual processes and reducing reliance on comp as a service layer.

You will shape how we attract, reward, and retain top talent, while building infrastructure that scales with the business.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Compensation Strategy

 - Evolve our compensation philosophy across cash and equity; design and maintain salary bands, leveling frameworks, and equity structures

 - Ensure market competitiveness while partnering with Finance on cost and workforce planning

 - Operate compensation planning cycles and generate first-pass recommendations for comp decisions

 - Build dashboards and analytical frameworks covering market competitiveness, internal equity, retention risk, and workforce cost



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in compensation, total rewards, or related analytical roles, ideally at a high-growth tech company

 - Deep expertise in salary bands, equity design, and market benchmarking (broad-based, sales, and executive)

 - Strong systems thinker who can translate policy into scalable workflows and decision logic

 - Product mindset - you think in terms of users, workflows, and iteration

 - High ownership; willing to operate hands-on


Nice to have

AI-Native Workflows

 - Design and implement AI-enabled workflows for offers, merit, promotions, and market adjustments

 - Build human-in-the-loop validation frameworks to audit AI-generated recommendations for bias, accuracy, and logic
   
   
   Tools: Pave, Radford, Rippling, Lattice, Ashby, Carta, Google Sheets, internal AI/automation tooling

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.
