 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.

NICE TO HAVES

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. About the location:

Opened in 2008, Four Seasons Hotel Macao has become a coveted destination for both business and leisure travelers who seek exceptional and personalized services. Its numerous awards and satisfied customers attest to its excellence. In October 2020, Four Seasons Hotel Macao introduced The Grand Suites, an all-suite tower that took the concept of luxury and bespoke services to new heights. With the addition of 289 suites, the Hotel's room count increased to a combined total of 649 keys, making it the largest property within the Four Seasons group. Situated at the heart of the Cotai Strip, the hotel provides an elegant oasis with elite entertainment, high-end shopping, world-class dining, and the indulgent pampering that defines Four Seasons.

Applicants must hold a Macao ID due to work permit restrictions.

About The Role

The Bell Captain is responsible for assisting guest with their arrival and departure experience; makes necessary deliveries to and pick up from guest rooms, transports guests and hotel packages, faxes, envelopes and parcels. Extends guidance and training to bell persons, working closely with other departments in the hotel to ensure a superior guest experience.

  • Coordinate with other departments to fulfill guest requests and needs
  • Handle guest inquiries and complaints promptly and professionally
  • Assist with transportation arrangements, including Taxi, Shuttle and Limousine services

What You Bring

  • Reading, writing and oral proficiency in Cantonese, Mandarin and English
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Committed to achieving high levels of service excellence and guest contentment.
  • 1-2 years luxury hotel experience as Bell Attendant or Bell Captain
  • Knowledge of the local area and attractions is a plus

What We Offer

  • Excellent Training and Development opportunities
  • Employee Discount for stays at any Four Seasons worldwide
  • Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms
  • Complimentary Employee Meals

Schedule & Hours

  • 48 Hours weekly
  • Work on shift

Hybrid working model, part-time/full-time Flexible hybrid working arrangements with an emphasis on collaboration rather than fixed office attendance. Pension contribution. Opportunity to work in an international aviation business. jobs.title: Barcelona Tvsäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av tv-abonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications
You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.
You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricated tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department: The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the transport and immersion of the elements.

To float, move and immerse the Tunnel Elements, temporary installations are required. A team of mechanics, riggers and electricians installs and tests these systems. The Commissioning Engineer analyzes technical input to optimize performance and plan ahead, working closely with technical staff and operations.

Main tasks and responsibilities: The Site Engineer Automation ensures operational readiness of the temporary systems in the tunnel elements and continuously improves them based on operational feedback to optimize installation efficiency.

  • Creates and follows a testing protocol for all installations.

  • Leads the commissioning of the standard and special tunnel elements.

  • Adapts system changes according to new insights.

  • Provides correct reports and documentation to the site engineers.

  • Is responsible for adjusting control systems, and coordinates changes.

Qualifications:

  • Is fascinated by technology and wants to understand how things work.

  • Is an analytical thinker and a fast learner, able to comprehend, design and improve systems.

  • Has strong communication skills, necessary for project development with internal clients and contractors.

  • Is a problem solver

  • Speaks English.

Conditions: FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. FLC staff are expected to set their own targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions—irrespective of their position in the company. FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to the Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension, health insurance, and lunch arrangements will be available.

Workplace: Rødbyhavn, Denmark

Application: We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

Contact:

For questions related to the position, please contact tri@flc-jv.com, lge@flc-jv.com

jobs.title: Maintenance Operative
jobs.description:
OPPORTUNITY AWAITS AT SCAPE

Fancy working for a global brand that is genuinely going places? Scape is a premium accommodation provider with buildings across London, Surrey, Australia and the US. As such, we're always on the lookout for passionate people to join our growing family. Alongside an excellent benefits package which includes onsite gym, free fresh fruit, and a generous holiday allowance, we believe in supporting people to achieve their full potential, which means there are always opportunities to progress at Scape. So, if you're enthusiastic about working alongside a talented team to deliver the best living experience, don't hesitate to apply today. We look forward to receiving your CV.

Scape Hammersmith

Hours: 40 hours per week, shift patterns between 7am-8pm, Monday-Sunday.

Onboarding: The successful candidate will be asked to complete a DBS check and provide references to cover the last 3 years.

Maintenance Operative Hours: 40 hours per week to cover 7am-8pm, Monday-Friday. You will also be part of an on-call rota which will include evenings and weekends.

Your Main Responsibilities Include

  • Carry out reactive and preventative maintenance work (carpentry, tiling, basic plumbing, basic electrical, guttering, decorating, plastering, kitchen and bathroom maintenance and more)
  • Carry out fault finding and leak investigations
  • Carry out repairs and/or additional work arising from examinations and investigations
  • Comply with Health & Safety processes and responsibilities
  • Complete reports and paperwork as required
  • Oversee and work alongside the maintenance team of your site and the work carried out
  • Stock-taking (where appropriate) and keep records of stock levels
  • Ensure that plant rooms and other maintenance areas are kept tidy, and equipment is checked on a regular basis. Faulty or broken equipment is to be reported and resolved through liaison with your Maintenance Manager
  • Control and direct specialist sub-contractors at all times when they visit site
  • Replace light switches, receptacles, light bulbs and fixtures
  • Dealing with emergencies, unplanned problems and repairs
  • Participate in regular, structured on-call system within the UK
  • To be responsible for all keys and locks within the site
  • Undertake painting duties where applicable
  • Adhere to procedures to ensure that all maintenance issues are completed in a timely and correct manner, efficiently, economically and for the benefit of the site and the company
  • To be aware of and adhere to all company Policies and Procedures
  • Reporting all incidents/accidents to the Maintenance Manager, filling in the accident book when required and log all incidents/accidents in the Health & Safety computerised system
  • To observe good personal hygiene and appearance including uniform
  • Participate in any training sessions as required

Your Key Attributes And Skills Are

  • A strong team player who thrives in a collaborative environment
  • Good communication skills
  • Excellent time keeping
  • A friendly and professional manner
  • Excellent customer service
  • The ability to work under pressure
  • Experience in a similar role
  • Eligible to live and work in the UK
  • Flexible in working hours

Why work with us?

As a Scape Maintenance Operative you will be part of an enthusiastic team who work hard to give students the ultimate Scape experience. If you want to provide excellent customer service and are a team player, then we're sure you'll fit right in!

We Have a Range Of Employee Benefits Including

  • Birthday day off!*
  • Access to our onsite gyms
  • Employee assistance programme (EAP)
  • Employee of the month awards
  • Annual exceptional performance awards
  • Access to our Cycle to Work and Tech Scheme*
  • Increasing holiday allowance*
  • Â£150 for recommending a friend to Scape*
  • Long service award for our loyal employees
  • Maternity + Paternity benefits*
  • Career progression and development opportunities
  • Overtime and the opportunity to work across Scape sites
  • Enrolment onto the Scape Pension Scheme*
  • Team socials!!

If this sounds like you and you want to hear more, forward your CV and contact details.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Scape Hammersmith Team

jobs.title: Residential Technician
jobs.description:
Celebrate Life, the Southworth Way

The Company: Welcome to Southworth. We own and operate a growing portfolio of premier private communities, each offering inspired environments and locations. Our dedication to hospitality and endless activities for the entire family ensures our members experience a world at play like never before.

With a solid reputation for stability, integrity, and innovation, Southworth's clubs and communities provide exceptional locations where our members can truly live life at ease. Our dedicated team members play a crucial role in elevating the experience for our members, residents, guests, and fellow team members. We encourage all our team members to be and belong by providing a wide array of benefits, engagement programs, unique perks, discounts, and, of course, a lot of fun!

The Benefits: We are proud of our âfamily companyâ roots and understand everyone has a unique set of needs: we want to support you as best we can so you can live your best life with us. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive options for medical, physical, and mental health and wellness, life insurance, 401k matching, paid time off, and more.

Grow with us! The sky is the limit for talented, driven individuals. With our ever-expanding portfolio, we offer opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. We look forward to growing together.

Be YOU with us! At Southworth, we are working to redefine the country club. We seek talent from a diverse range of backgrounds, experiences, and cultures to ensure an innovative edge. Here, diversity is a driver of our success.

About The Abaco Club: The Abaco Club is a paradise for the soul. It is an unassuming haven crafted in the pursuit of connection, happiness and belonging. Here, members unwind in barefoot luxury in island-inspired homes, golfers take on the #1 golf course in The Bahamas, and generations come together on 2 miles of uninterrupted white sands on one of the most pristine beaches on Earth.

Working at The Abaco Club means being part of a vibrant community that values your knowledge and offers opportunities for professional growth and development. Here, you can turn your passion for hospitality into a rewarding career while enjoying the stunning scenery of this beautiful place. Become a part of our team and help us show what makes the Abaco Club truly extraordinary.

The Opportunity: The Residential Technician is responsible for performing preventive interior and exterior home maintenance, including monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, and annual services and inspections as assigned by the Homeowner Services Manager. This role ensures homes and Club facilities are maintained to the highest standards, working closely with Homeowners Representatives, Housekeeping, Front Desk, and Reservations. The technician will complete punch-list items, identify deficiencies, and follow through to resolution to preserve the Homeownersâ assets.

Duties And Functions

  • Coordinate with the Homeowner Services Manager and Assistant Manager on all home-related issues, ensuring timely follow-up with relevant departments.
  • Assist with the installation and setup of new homes as needed.
  • Inspect homes at least five days prior to member and guest arrivals to confirm they meet Club and Owner Standards; resolve maintenance issues promptly. Pre-arrival checks include: air filters, shower heads, bathroom hardware, kitchen appliances, HVAC functionality, light fixtures, bulbs, fans, internet/TV services, septic systems, door locks, propane levels, plumbing, grills, and any reported issues.
  • Conduct monthly, quarterly, and annual maintenance services per the Management program.
  • Record all services and inspections using the designated app, including work performed, materials used, and time allocated.
  • Inspect and maintain all aspects of the homeâs interior and exterior, including pools and pool equipment.
  • Assist with golf cart and vehicle maintenance/cleaning as assigned.
  • Support maintenance of Club outlets and facilities as directed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Qualification Standards

  • Minimum of 2 yearsâ experience in a similar or related role
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and flexible work schedule
  • Physically able to stand, bend, and lift up to 30 lbs for extended periods
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently
  • Professional demeanor with integrity and a positive attitude
  • Strong teamwork skills with the ability to interact respectfully with residents, guests, and colleagues
  • Knowledge of standard maintenance policies and procedures
  • Availability to work weekends and holidays as required

The Residential Technician is a vital part of ensuring that homes and Club facilities meet the highest standards for members and guests. This position contributes directly to the quality of the homeowner experience by preserving property integrity and delivering prompt, professional service.

Apply today to start your new career, the Southworth Way

jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Füsioterapeut on spetsialist, kes taastab, säilitab ja arendab kliendi liikumis- ja tegevusvõimet ning tema osalust igapäevaelus.
Füsioteraapia eesmärk, mis saavutatakse koostöös kliendi ja/või tema tugivõrgustikuga, on toetada ja arendada kliendi iseseisvust tema eale vastavates igapäevategevustes, sooviga parandada elukvaliteeti. Füsioterapeut kasutab oma töös klientidega erinevaid sekkumisviise (näit kehalised harjutused ja funktsionaalne treening, manuaalsed tehnikad, erinevaid füüsikalise ravi meetodeid jt). Füsioteraapia ülesanneteks on võimalike tervisekahjustuste ennetamine, liigeste liikuvusulatuse ja lihaste jõu säilitamine või parandamine, häirunud funktsioonide taastamine, kompenseerimine, valu leevendamine. Töö on nii lastega kui ka täiskasvanutega.

Omalt poolt pakume: - toetav ja sõbralik meeskond,
- paindlik töögraafik, - enesetäiendamise võimalusi, - motiveerivat töötasu.

jobs.title: Research & AI Coordinator – Fuengirola ☀️
jobs.description:
Heltid | Hybrid | Costa del Sol

Vill du arbeta med rekrytering, research och AI och samtidigt bygga din karriär på Costa del Sol?

Sway Sourcing är ett snabbväxande svenskt rekryterings- och konsultbolag med vårt interna team baserat i Fuengirola och verksamhet i både Sverige och Spanien. Vi arbetar med rekrytering och konsultlösningar med huvudsakligt fokus på den svenska marknaden.

Nu växer vi vidare och söker en Research & AI Coordinator som vill bli en del av vårt team och vara med och utveckla både våra arbetssätt och vår verksamhet. 🚀

Det här är en bred roll för dig som är nyfiken, digital, strukturerad och driven och som gillar att hitta information, identifiera möjligheter och testa smartare sätt att arbeta.

Om rollen 🔎

Du kommer att arbeta nära våra rekryterare och ledning och få en viktig roll i hur vi fortsätter utveckla Sway.

En stor del av arbetet handlar om research och sourcing – att identifiera kandidater, företag och möjligheter på arbetsmarknaden samt ta fram relevanta underlag som hjälper teamet framåt.

Samtidigt kommer du att arbeta praktiskt med AI och moderna digitala verktyg. Vi vill hela tiden hitta smartare sätt att arbeta och du blir en del av att testa, utveckla och implementera nya lösningar i vår vardag.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter

    

Researcha och identifiera kandidater, företag och möjligheter på arbetsmarknaden

    

Arbeta med sourcing och utveckla vårt stora kandidatnätverk

    

Ta fram kvalificerade underlag till våra rekryterare och affär

    

Arbeta med LinkedIn och andra digitala kanaler

    

Använda AI och moderna digitala verktyg för research och effektivisering

    

Testa och implementera nya AI-baserade arbetssätt och processer

    

Stötta våra rekryterare och vår affärsutveckling

    

Bidra inom sociala medier, digitalt innehåll och marknadsföring

    

Vara delaktig i utvecklingen av Sways hemsida och digitala närvaro

    

Delta i interna utvecklingsprojekt och hjälpa oss hitta ännu smartare sätt att arbeta

Rollen är ny och kommer att utvecklas tillsammans med dig. För rätt person finns därför stora möjligheter att påverka både rollen, våra arbetssätt och din egen utveckling inom Sway.

Vem söker vi? 🙋

För oss är personlighet, driv och potential viktigare än en specifik utbildning eller tidigare jobbtitel.

Vi tror att du:

    

Är nyfiken och tycker om att hitta information och lösa problem

    

Är driven, initiativtagande och gillar att få saker att hända

    

Arbetar strukturerat och kan ta eget ansvar

    

Har god digital förståelse och lätt för att lära dig nya system och verktyg

    

Är genuint intresserad av AI och hur ny teknik kan användas praktiskt

    

Har ett kommersiellt tänk och är bra på att identifiera möjligheter

    

Uttrycker dig mycket väl på svenska, både i tal och skrift

    

Har goda kunskaper i engelska

    

Trivs i ett mindre team med stort eget ansvar och korta beslutsvägar

Erfarenhet av rekrytering, sourcing, research, AI-verktyg, LinkedIn, digital marknadsföring, sociala medier eller affärsutveckling är meriterande, men inget krav.

Det viktigaste för oss är att hitta rätt person med rätt driv, nyfikenhet och potential.

Varför Sway? ☀️

Vi tycker att ett bra jobb ska gå att kombinera med ett bra liv.

Hos Sway blir du en del av ett engagerat team där du får stort eget ansvar, frihet och möjlighet att påverka. Vi arbetar hybrid, tror på frihet under ansvar och gillar korta beslutsvägar.

Har någon i teamet en bra idé ska det inte behöva ta sex månader innan vi testar den.

Och arbetsmiljön är svår att klaga på.

Vårt kontor ligger i Fuengirola på Costa del Sol, med havsutsikt och stranden runt hörnet. Här har du nära till restauranger, caféer, träning och livet längs strandpromenaden. 🌊

Hos oss får du bland annat

    

Hybridarbete och frihet under ansvar

    

Friskvård och gemensamma aktiviteter

    

Kontor med havsutsikt och närhet till stranden

    

En internationell arbetsmiljö med verksamhet i Sverige och Spanien

    

Möjlighet att arbeta praktiskt med AI och modern teknik

    

Stora möjligheter att påverka och utveckla din roll

    

Möjlighet att växa tillsammans med ett snabbväxande bolag

    

Fast lön med möjlighet till prestationsbaserad bonus

Kort sagt: ett professionellt arbete med framför allt den svenska marknaden, men med möjligheten att bygga både karriär och liv på Costa del Sol.

Om tjänsten 📍

Placering: Fuengirola, Spanien Omfattning: Heltid Arbetssätt: Hybrid Start: Enligt överenskommelse Ersättning: Fast lön + möjlighet till prestationsbaserad bonus

Ansökan

Låter det som något för dig?

Skicka in ditt CV och en kort presentation av dig själv. Vi genomför urval och intervjuer löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Välkommen till Sway Sourcing! 🚀

Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.

Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

About This Role:

 

We are looking for an enthusiastic, customer-obsessed Studio Sales Associate to join our team in our Lincoln Park studio location. You will be responsible for creating an exceptional piercing and shopping experience for our customers in a genuine and enthusiastic manner, supporting the team on the weekends. This position involves assisting customers with ear piercings, providing product recommendations, and ensuring the studio maintains Rowanâs high standards of cleanliness and safety. Your responsibility is to infuse the Rowan experience, bring brand awareness, product knowledge and the art of ear stacking to life, through engaging customer interactions. This is an hourly, non-exempt position, reporting to the Studio Manager.

 

 

Ideal Availability:

 

We are seeking candidates with availability on weekends, Mondays, and Thursdays, along with flexibility to provide coverage throughout the week as needed.

\n


What you'll be doing as a Retail Store Associate:
Customer Service:
  • Warmly greet, and welcome, customers helping create a celebratory environment.
  • Check customers in or help them book an appointment leveraging POS, technology and software systems.
  • Help customers choose and style their piercing and hypoallergenic non-piercing jewelry.

Sales & Product Knowledge:
  • Promote and upsell Rowanâs products, including non-piercing jewelry, aftercare kits, and other related items.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Rowanâs product offerings, including materials, styles, and care instructions.
  • Meet or exceed individual sales targets and performance metrics, by effectively communicating the value of Rowanâs services and products to customers and converting piercing customers into non-piercing jewelry customers.
Studio Maintenance + Operations:
  • Help keep the studio clean, organized, and stocked with all necessary supplies, including jewelry, piercing and cleaning products.
  • Follow all health and safety regulations, particularly in areas related to piercing procedures and hygiene.
  • Assist managers to receive, restock, price, display, clean, and maintain inventory through day-to-day upkeep of visual displays.
Team Collaboration:

Administrative Duties:

  • Strong communication skills.
  • Strong basic math skills.
  • The role involves tasks that may include climbing ladders, bending, lifting, pushing, and reaching above and below the waist. The ability to lift up to 25 pounds is required.
  • Standing for a full 8-hour shift is a regular part of this role.
  • We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job, provided that these accommodations do not create undue hardship for the company, impede job performance, or pose safety concerns.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
jobs.description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

 

Who we are

 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

 

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

 

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

 

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

 

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

 

Notice to staffing firms

 

Orca Bio does not accept resumes from staffing agencies with which we do not have a written agreement and specific engagement for a particular opening. jobs.description:
Job Description â Quantity Surveyor (QS Engineer)Position

Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer â Civil Construction

Project: Commercial Hotel Construction Project

Location: Vijayawada / Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh

Site: Daspalla Project Site

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in civil/building construction to join the project team for a commercial hotel construction project in Vijayawada/Amaravati.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in quantity estimation, BOQ preparation, rate analysis, measurement, subcontractor billing, client billing, material reconciliation and cost control.

Candidates with experience in commercial buildings, hotels, high-rise buildings or large-scale building projects will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review BOQs, quantity take-offs and estimates for civil and finishing works.
  • Prepare detailed quantity calculations from architectural, structural and MEP drawings.
  • Conduct regular site measurements and maintain accurate measurement records.
  • Prepare and verify contractor/subcontractor bills based on actual site measurements.
  • Review subcontractor RA bills, work orders, measurements and supporting documents.
  • Prepare client bills / RA bills and ensure timely submission.
  • Carry out rate analysis for various civil, structural and finishing items.
  • Monitor project quantities against the BOQ and identify variations.
  • Prepare and maintain variation statements, extra items and deviation statements.
  • Track project costs and assist in maintaining effective cost control.
  • Reconcile quantities of key materials such as cement, steel, concrete and other construction materials.
  • Coordinate with the Project Manager, Site Engineers, Planning Team, Purchase Team, Accounts Team and subcontractors.
  • Check drawings and specifications to identify quantity/cost implications before execution.
  • Maintain proper documentation of measurements, bills, work orders, quotations and quantity records.
  • Assist in preparing project cost forecasts and quantity/progress reports.
  • Support commercial negotiations with subcontractors and vendors when required.
  • Ensure that all billing and measurement documentation is accurate and submitted within project timelines.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer in civil/building construction.
  • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification.
  • Strong knowledge of BOQ preparation, quantity take-off, measurements and billing.
  • Good understanding of civil construction drawings and specifications.
  • Experience in subcontractor billing and client billing.
  • Strong knowledge of rate analysis and cost estimation.
  • Experience handling variation orders, extra items and reconciliation statements.
  • Good knowledge of Excel and quantity/billing-related software.
  • Ability to independently handle QS activities at a project site.
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.
  • Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in the following types of projects will be preferred:

  • Hotels / Hospitality Projects
  • Commercial Buildings
  • High-rise Buildings
  • Residential & Commercial Complexes
  • Large-scale Civil Construction Projects

jobs.title: Senior Governance Risk and Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst. 

 

About RainFocus

 

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one.

\n


Key Responsibilities:
Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships.
 
Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments.
 
Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking.
 
Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices.
 
Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls.
 
Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage.
 
Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program.
 
Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company.
 
Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT.
 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.
 
Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees.
 
Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress.
Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements.


Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable.

6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field.

In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others).

Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist.

Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable.

Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus.

Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus.


Personal Characteristics:

Strong work ethic and commitment to excellence.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to adapt to change and learn quickly.

Passion for security and privacy.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

 

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

jobs.title: ELEKTRIČAR/KA
jobs.description:
Organizacijska jedinica: Proizvodnja - RJ Održavanje, Elektro održavanje

Opis poslova:

  • preuzimanje poslova od poslovođe, nadzornika i vodećeg električara
  • defektiranje i otklanjanje kvarova na el. uređajima, instalacijama, VN i NN elektro motorima
  • montaža i instaliranje svih vrsta instalacija na postrojenju ili u radionici
  • izrađivanje novih razvodnih ploča
  • popravak NN i VN kabela, polaganje kabelskih razvoda
  • radovi na EX opremi po EX priručniku
  • prematanje elektro motora
  • remont i popravak izvlačivih kompleta
  • sudjelovanje u toplinskoj obradi zavara
  • redovna zamjena za popunu smjene te preuzimanje svih dužnosti dežurnog električara
  • informiranje nadređenog rukovoditelja
  • organizacija poslova na siguran način glede sigurnosti ljudi, opreme i okoliša
  • provođenje i kontrola primjene pravila ZNR i ZOP
  • provođenje mjera integriranih sustava upravljanja Društva
  • i ostali poslovi po nalogu neposrednog rukovoditelja, sukladno potrebama posla, osposobljenosti i osobnim radnim mogućnostima.

Uvjet:

  • SSS – elektrotehnički smjer
  • Radno iskustvo je prednost.

Traženi profil kandidata:

  • izražene organizacijske i komunikacijske vještine
  • spremnost na timski rad
  • odgovornost i pouzdanost.

Nudimo Vam:

  • ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad od 6 mjeseci
  • naknadu troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla
  • naknadu za prehranu
  • prigodne nagrade (uskrsnicu, regres, božićnicu) sukladno odrebama Kolektivnog ugovora I Odlukama Uprave
  • priliku za rad na raznovrsnim i zanimljivim radnim zadacima
  • mogućnosti za učenje na radnom mjestu i izvan njega.

Ako ste u navedenom radnom mjestu prepoznali izazov za svoju karijeru i udovoljavate navedenim uvjetima, prijavite se na email adresu: karijera@petrokemija.hr najkasnije do 30.8.2026. godine.

Razmatrane će biti samo pravovremene i potpune prijave (životopis i dokazi o ispunjenju uvjeta) pristigle pristigle na naznačenu e-adresu.

jobs.title: SERVISER/KA POLJOPRIVREDNE MEHANIZACIJE
jobs.description: Kao serviser u našem timu, bit ćete zaduženi za održavanje vrhunskih poljoprivrednih strojeva i pružanje tehničke podrške našim kupcima na terenu i u radionici. Ključne odgovornosti: • Dijagnostika kvarova: Detekcija mehaničkih, hidrauličkih i električnih kvarova na traktorima i priključnim strojevima pomoću suvremenih dijagnostičkih uređaja. • Popravak i održavanje: Izvođenje redovnih servisa, preventivnog održavanja te interventnih popravaka poljoprivredne mehanizacije. • Priprema strojeva: Sastavljanje, testiranje i priprema novih strojeva za isporuku krajnjim kupcima. • Terenski rad: Povremeni odlasci na teren kod kupaca radi otklanjanja kvarova u sezoni poljoprivrednih radova. • Vođenje dokumentacije: Točno i uredno ispunjavanje servisnih radnih naloga i tehničkih izvještaja. Što tražimo od vas: • Stručna sprema: Srednja stručna sprema (SSS) tehničkog usmjerenja (automehaničar, automehatroničar, poljoprivredni tehničar-mehanizator, strojarski tehničar ili srodno). • Radno iskustvo: Poželjno je minimalno 3 godine radnog iskustva na poslovima servisa strojeva (iskustvo s poljoprivrednom mehanizacijom je velika prednost, ali nije uvjet ako imate iskustva s teretnim programom). • Vozačka dozvola: Obavezna B kategorija (poželjna i C kategorija) • Računalna pismenost: Osnovno korištenje računala (zbog rada sa servisnom dijagnostikom). • Osobine: Samostalnost u radu, odgovornost prema alatima i opremi, spremnost na timski rad i želja za stalnim učenjem. Što vam nudimo: • Stabilnost: Siguran posao i ugovor o radu na [neodređeno vrijeme / određeno vrijeme uz mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja] s probnim rokom. • Primanja: Redovita i konkurentna primanja u skladu s vašim znanjem i iskustvom • Edukacija: Kontinuirano stručno usavršavanje i specijalizirane obuke kod inozemnih proizvođača mehanizacije. • Radna okolina: Rad s modernim alatima i dijagnostičkom opremom u ugodnoj i poticajnoj radnoj atmosferi. • Oprema za rad: Službeni mobitel, kvalitetan profesionalni alat, radna odjeća i sva potrebna zaštitna oprema. •Terenski rad: Za potrebe terenskog rada osigurano službeno servisno vozilo opremljeno potrebnim alatom i opremom. Nemate iskustva s poljoprivrednom mehanizacijom? Ako imate dobro iskustvo u servisiranju automobila, kamiona, građevinskih ili drugih radnih strojeva te želite naučiti raditi s poljoprivrednom mehanizacijom, slobodno se prijavite – osigurat ćemo vam potrebnu stručnu obuku. Kako se prijaviti? Ako ste prepoznali priliku za razvoj svoje karijere u dinamičnom okruženju, pošaljite svoj životopis i zamolbu najkasnije do 30. kolovoza 2026. putem: • E-maila: kokot-agro@kokot-agro.hr • Telefona: 01/6271-543 • Osobno / poštom na adresu: Trešnjevka 22,10450 Jastrebarsko Kandidati koji uđu u uži krug bit će kontaktirani radi selekcijskog razgovora. Veselimo se vašim prijavama!

jobs.title: BPM & Automation Engineer (all genders), Lausanne (Industrietechnologe/-technologin - Datentechnik)
jobs.description: We bring together AI expertise, engineering excellence and in-depth industry knowledge - driven by people who want to make a difference together. This leads to future-proof solutions that genuinely make a difference in our customers' everyday lives. We achieve this through people who take responsibility, recognise opportunities and turn technological possibilities into tangible results. To this end, we create an environment characterised by mutual support: opportunities for professional development, open communities where knowledge is readily shared, peer groups and training programmes tailored to your needs. Trust, appreciation and successes celebrated together shape the way we work together and make personal development an integral part of our culture. WHAT YOU CAN MOVE Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for automation and optimization. Model business processes using BPMN 2.0 and, where relevant, DMN and CMMN. Design, configure and develop workflows on Flowable, Camunda or similar BPM platforms. Implement process logic, forms, business rules, service tasks and integrations. Integrate BPM solutions with existing applications and IT landscapes using REST APIs and other web services. Work with relational databases and SQL to support process-related data requirements. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, subject-matter experts, architects and development teams. Translate business requirements into robust, maintainable and scalable technical solutions. Write readable, testable and maintainable code, following clean-code principles. Contribute to testing, deployment, documentation and the ongoing support of automation solutions. Participate in Agile delivery teams and contribute to continuous improvement. Stay up to date with developments in BPM, workflow automation, hyperautomation and related technologies. HOW YOU SUCCEED Good practical knowledge of BPMN 2.0; experience with DMN or CMMN is an advantage. Experience with process analysis, workflow modeling and the implementation of automated business processes. Solid understanding of RESTful web services and experience working with JSON and/or XML. Practical experience with SQL and relational databases. Experience with Git or another version-control system. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. A degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience. Full professional proficiency in French and English An agile mindset, strong analytical skills and a structured way of working. Good communication and collaboration skills, with confidence when interacting with both technical and business stakeholders. Customer-oriented, proactive and motivated to learn and develop in a growing Business Automation team. Nice to have 2 years of professional experience in BPM, workflow automation, software engineering, business analysis or a comparable field. Experience developing with Java and Spring Boot. Experience with Flowable, Camunda, Appian, Appway, IBM Business Automation Workflow, UiPath or similar platforms. Familiarity with JavaScript and modern web technologies. Experience with Docker and CI/CD practices. Knowledge of Agile methods such as Scrum, Kanban or SAFe. Interest in hyperautomation, AI-supported process automation or agentic automation. Relevant certifications in Flowable, Camunda or another BPM platform.  OPPORTUNITY GIVER - WHAT MAKES ADESSO SPECIAL Our promise: You will feel at home with us! Collegial, collaborative and on an equal footing - we live exchange, team spirit and respectful interaction. We value diversity and different perspectives just as much as you as a person. This and much more stands for our very special sense of togetherness. There's even a word for it: adessi.  Learn and grow with us: we support your continuous development with over 400 training courses and our digital learning platform. Experience real team spirit: joint events (e.g. sport weekend and the annual eduCamp training trip), welcome days and company runs strengthen our team spirit and allow you to be part of the team from the very beginning. Commitment that is rewarded: Your commitment pays off - with bonuses for recommendations, lectures, thesis supervision and attractive benefits via our corporate benefits portal. Our culture and the way we work together are characterized by mutual appreciation, recognition and support. This unites us - even when working from home. Part-time work is possible by arrangement (80-100%). We have once again been voted one of the best employers in Switzerland! Our extensive training program and a transparent career level model for everyone ensure that your development with us never stands still. 1. Dežurēt dienesta viesnīcā saskaņā ar apstiprināto grafiku, nodrošinot kārtību un drošību. Uzraudzīt telpu, inventāra un materiālo vērtību saglabāšanu, kā arī iekšējās kārtības un ugunsdrošības prasību ievērošanu.

2. Veikt telpu un teritorijas apsekošanu, konstatētos trūkumus fiksējot dežūras žurnālā. Nodrošināt piekļuves kontroli, atslēgu apriti un īrnieku uzskaiti.

3. Sadarboties ar dienesta viesnīcas skolotājiem un iestādes speciālistiem ar izglītojamo uzvedību un drošību saistītos jautājumos.

4. Nepieciešamības gadījumā operatīvi rīkoties ārkārtas situācijās un izsaukt atbildīgos dienestus.

5. Dežuranta darba laiks tiek organizēts, ievērojot summētā darba laika uzskaiti. Darba grafiks var mainīties, ņemot vērā iestādes darbības vajadzības, tajā skaitā citu dežurantu prombūtni (darbnespēja, atvaļinājums un t.t.).

  • ļoti labas komunikācijas un saskarsmes prasmes;

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.description:
Estimator - Construction

Location: Sheffield (with occasional travel to surrounding sites)
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: Up to Â£55k
Additional: Car allowance and company benefits scheme


About the Role

Our client, a construction specialist in both design and build, are seeking an experienced Estimator to join their growing construction team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong background in refurbishment works and new-build commercial projects. You will play a key role in preparing accurate tenders, developing cost plans, and supporting the delivery of successful projects across South Yorkshire and the surrounding regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review tender documentation including drawings, specifications, and project details.
  • Tender for projects of varying values, from receipt of tender packages through to full bills of quantities.
  • Produce logical, consistent pricing schedules and detailed cost breakdowns.
  • Meet subcontractors on site to source labour, plant, and material rates while negotiating competitive quotations.
  • Attend weekly site meetings and carry out site visits as required.
  • Work closely with project management, site teams, design staff, and procurement to ensure accurate and coordinated tender submissions.
  • Maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail while working to tight deadlines.
  • Work primarily from the office in a supportive, collaborative team environment.

About You

  • Previous experience reviewing tender documentation, drawings, and specifications.
  • Background in refurbishment work and new-build commercial projects.
  • Prior experience of working within refurbishment on NHS / hospital projects would be advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of construction processes and on-site requirements.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Excel; knowledge of Causeway software is advantageous but not essential.
  • Full UK driving licence.
  • Relevant construction industry experience in an estimating or similar role.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to build positive supplier relationships.

Benefits

  • Salary up to Â£55k dependent on experience
  • Vehicle allowance or company car
  • iPhone (or similar device)
  • Bonus percentage per contract awarded
  • 22 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Pension scheme
  • One day per week working from home (by mutual agreement)

The company is looking to arrange interviews quickly for the right candidate so if you feel you could be well suited, please apply with an updated CV or contact Rich at Linsco for further information.

Applications

If you feel that you have the relevant experience to be successful in this position and would like to find out more, please apply online today, attaching a copy of your current CV.

Due to the vast number of applications that we receive, it is not possible for us to contact all applicants; therefore, only suitable candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear anything back within 7 days of submitting your application, you have unfortunately not been selected.

Linsco is an equal opportunities employer. All applicants will be considered on their merits regardless of background, characteristics or personal circumstances. All applications will be dealt with in the strictest confidence.

MTS Metal Turning Services Limited is seeking skilled Metal Welders to join the team. The role involves carrying out high quality welding and fabrication according to engineering drawings and project specifications while maintaining high standards of quality and safety. Key Responsibilities: · Perform MIG, MAG, TIG and/or ARC welding as required for the role. · Read and interpret engineering drawings, welding symbols, and technical specifications. · Fabricate, assemble, and weld metal components and structures accurately. · Set up and operate welding equipment, tools, and machinery safely and efficiently. · Select appropriate welding techniques, materials, and consumables for each job. · Inspect welded joints and finished components to ensure they meet quality standards. · Carry out grinding, cutting, drilling, and other preparation work as required. · Identify welding defects and carry out necessary repairs or adjustments. · Maintain welding equipment, tools, and work areas in good working condition. · Follow company procedures relating to quality, health and safety, and environmental standards. · Work effectively as part of the engineering and production team. Qualifications & Requirements: · Proven experience as a Welder, preferably within an engineering, fabrication, manufacturing, or construction environment. · Ability to read and understand engineering drawings and welding specifications. · Good knowledge of welding processes, materials, and fabrication techniques. · Ability to produce clean, strong, and accurate welds. · Experience working with materials such as mild steel, stainless steel, and/or aluminium is desirable. · Good attention to detail and commitment to quality. · Ability to work independently and as part of a team. · Strong understanding of workplace health and safety requirements. · Relevant welding qualification or certification is desirable.

jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Key Responsibilities Install vinyl graphics, vehicle wraps, decals, lettering and fleet branding on cars, vans and other commercial vehicles. Prepare vehicle body surfaces before installation by cleaning, inspecting and ensuring surfaces are suitable for the application of graphics and decorative vinyl materials. Read and interpret job specifications, work dockets, measurements and installation instructions before commencing each project. Accurately position, align and apply graphics and vinyl materials to vehicle body panels to achieve the required design and finish. Cut, trim, shape and finish vinyl around vehicle panels, doors, windows, edges, recesses and other exterior fittings. Remove or temporarily adjust suitable external fittings where required to achieve a professional installation and refit them following completion of the work. Use appropriate hand tools, application equipment and specialist installation techniques to complete vehicle graphics and wrapping work safely and accurately. Inspect vehicle surfaces and completed installations for alignment, adhesion, finish and overall quality, correcting any defects or installation issues where required. Remove existing vehicle graphics, vinyl or branding and prepare the vehicle surface for replacement graphics where required. Carry out fleet branding projects involving multiple vehicles while maintaining consistent positioning, appearance and quality across the fleet. Identify potential installation or quality issues in advance and liaise with the production and sales teams where clarification or corrective action is required. Update job progress and completion information on the company's management information system. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with company quality procedures and applicable Health, Safety and Environmental requirements. Represent the company professionally when working at customer premises and ensure completed work meets both company and customer specifications. Deliver completed signage, printed products or other customer orders where required and obtain appropriate delivery confirmation. Requirements Minimum 1 year of experience in vehicle graphics installation, vehicle wrapping, fleet branding or a closely related graphics installation role. Demonstrable experience applying vinyl graphics and decorative materials to cars, vans and commercial vehicle bodywork. Strong practical skills in vehicle surface preparation, vinyl application, trimming, finishing and quality control. jobs.title: Warehouse Operation Specialist
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
End-to-End Operations Management of 3PL Warehouse • Responsible for the daily end-to-end operations management of a single warehouse in Europe under the 3PL model, covering inbound, outbound, and inventory management; ensure inventory accuracy, inbound/outbound timeliness, and stable order fulfillment quality. • Coordinate the standardized execution and continuous optimization of core operational processes, including inbound quality inspection, put-away and storage, picking and packing, and outbound shipping. • Monitor daily/weekly/monthly operational data of 3PL service providers, promptly identify abnormalities, and drive corrective actions to closure. 3PL Service Provider Coordination and SLA Management • Serve as the key point of contact with 3PL service providers, responsible for daily operational communication, issue escalation, and relationship management. • Develop and drive the implementation of SLA metrics for 3PL service providers, including timeliness, accuracy, damage rate, and capacity flexibility; conduct regular reviews and performance evaluations. • Lead operational quality audits of 3PL providers, identify service gaps, and drive improvements in areas such as labor, equipment, and system integration. Process Optimization and Cost Efficiency Improvement • Continuously optimize operational efficiency, such as UPH, in core processes including inbound, packing, and sorting, to reduce per-unit handling costs. • Monitor warehouse capacity utilization and promote the implementation of storage strategies such as slow-moving inventory clearance and accurate replenishment/re-slotting to improve space efficiency. • Analyze cost drivers based on the 3PL pricing structure and drive cost-reduction initiatives, such as packaging optimization and route optimization. Labor and Productivity Management • Conduct workforce demand planning based on business forecasts and monitor deviations between actual attendance and planned staffing. • Address unexcused absenteeism, improve employee retention, analyze fluctuations in labor costs through data, and propose improvement plans. Inventory and Quality Control Management • Manage differentiated inbound processes for goods from multiple channels to ensure delivery quality and timeliness. • Responsible for storage planning and implementation of operational standards for different product categories, including general merchandise, bulky items, high-value goods, and shelf-life-sensitive products. • Drive closed-loop returns management, return-to-supplier optimization, and compliant labeling for special product categories. Cross-Functional Collaboration • Collaborate with Planning/S&OP, Logistics, Procurement, and other departments to ensure efficient coordination among business forecasting, workforce preparation, and fulfillment delivery. • Respond quickly to capacity bottlenecks by coordinating urgent recruitment or temporary resource allocation across warehouses.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.
