jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Content Onboarding
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Content Onboarding team builds the systems that help customers move content into Notion, get started faster, and keep growing reliably over time. The role matters because one of Notion’s core differentiators is replacing multiple tools — and that only becomes real when customers can get their information out of those tools and into Notion with confidence. You’ll partner with product and engineering leaders to shape the future of our content importers, internal administrative tooling, and compliance workflows like exports.

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Shape the technical and product vision for Notion’s import systems, so customers can pull content from more sources and transform it into a trustworthy system of record.

 - By your 90th day, you’ll have clarified the near-term roadmap and de-risked the most important technical decisions for importers, exports, and internal admin tooling. You’ll connect AI-era and agentic workflow patterns to onboarding and import experiences — using AI to improve product judgment, prototyping, and engineering quality from design through production.

 - By the end of your first year, engineering excellence will be a team norm: reliable systems, clear operational standards, and a shared understanding of what it takes to keep critical workflows running. You will have a steady operating rhythm with HQ while owning a clear north star for the Content Onboarding surface area.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong technical leadership: you can represent the team’s work, hold a high engineering bar, and de-risk decisions through clear processes, delegation, and senior IC partnership.

 - Ability to craft and maintain multi-quarter team strategy, especially where outcomes depend on adjacent product and engineering teams.

 - Experience developing senior engineers, strengthening operating rhythms, and building high-performing engineering teams with durable standards.

 - Distributed-team leadership: you can set direction for a local team while staying tightly coordinated with cross-functional partners across time zones.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent), in Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

Nice to have

Bonus Points

- Experience

jobs.title: IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d)

vor Ort Roggwil TG, Thurgau, Schweiz

• Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze

• Transparente Kommunikation sowie eine familiäre Unternehmenskultur

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen und Rabatte

Jobbeschreibung

Die kybun Joya Retail AG in Roggwil gehört zur kybun Joya Gruppe, welche Komfortschuhe und weitere Gesundheitslösungen in der Schweiz entwickelt, produziert und in mehr als 40 Ländern vertreibt. Ziel ist es, den Menschen durch kompetente Beratung schmerzfreie Bewegung zu ermöglichen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Roggwil suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine teamfähige, flexible und belastbare Persönlichkeit.

Als IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator sind Sie das technische Rückgrat unserer digitalen Infrastruktur und gleichzeitig Motor unserer KI-Transformation. Sie sorgen für eine stabile, sichere Netzwerk- und Systemlandschaft und treiben aktiv die Integration von KI-Lösungen in unsere Geschäftsprozesse voran. Die Rolle ist eng verzahnt mit dem E-Commerce-, Support- und Marketing-Team.

Ihre Aufgaben

Netzwerk & IT-Infrastruktur

- Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Netzwerkinfrastruktur an unseren Standorten Roggwil, Sennwald und unseren eigenen Shops in Europa (LAN/WLAN, Firewalls, VPN, Switching, Routing)
- Betrieb und Pflege der Server-, Client- und Cloud-Umgebung (Microsoft 365, Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams Telefonie)
- Verwaltung von Endgeräten inkl. Device Enrollment, Intune-Policies und Lizenzmanagement
- Konfiguration und Pflege von Domains, DNS-, SPF- und Zertifikatsstrukturen (z. B. sichere LDAP-Zertifikate, Mail-Deliverability)
- Hardware-Beschaffung & -Verwaltung (Client/Server)
- Gelegentlicher Vor-Ort-Support für Shops, inkl. Reisetätigkeit bei Neueinrichtungen

IT-Sicherheit & Compliance

- Sicherstellung der IT-Sicherheit durch Patch-Management, Zero-Trust-Ansätze, MFA und Endpoint Protection
- Incident Response bei Sicherheitsvorfällen (z. B. Phishing, kompromittierte Accounts) inkl. interner Kommunikation
- Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender in Sicherheitstools wie Bitwarden (Passwortmanagement)
- Unterstützung bei ISO 9001 Audits und Umsetzung von Compliance-Vorgaben

Monitoring, Support & Systempflege

- Monitoring, Troubleshooting und 2nd-Level-Support für Netzwerk, Systeme und User Requests
- Bearbeitung und Priorisierung von IT-Tickets und Weiterentwicklung des Ticket-Prozesses
- Planung und Durchführung von Systemupdates, Rollouts und Migrationen mit minimaler Downtime
- Dokumentation von Prozessen, Konfigurationen und Wissensdatenbank-Artikeln

KI-Integration & Automatisierung

- Integration von KI in bestehende Prozesse und Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, Kundenservice und Marketing
- Design, Erstellung und Optimierung von Prompts für generative KI-Modelle (z. B. für Übersetzungen, Kundenservice, Content-Erstellung)
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von Workflows in n8n und Anbindung an Systeme wie Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Synthflow und weitere APIs
- Betrieb und Optimierung von KI-Agenten (z. B. Gorgias AI Agent, Synthflow Telefonie, Copilot-Anwendungen)
- Qualitätssicherung und Monitoring KI-generierter Inhalte – inkl. Fehlerdiagnose, Fallback-Logik und Reporting
- Evaluation neuer KI-Tools und Modelle sowie Ableitung von Business-Use-Cases
- Schulung und Enablement interner Teams im Umgang mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gorgias AI)

Stellenanforderungen

Ausbildung & Erfahrung

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Informatik, Systemtechnik, Netzwerktechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Administration, idealerweise in einem KMU- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld
- Erste praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, Prompt Engineering und/oder Automatisierungsplattformen (n8n, Zapier, Make o. ä.)

Fachliche Kompetenzen

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Firewalls, WLAN-Controller)
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Microsoft-365-Welt: Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint
- Erfahrung mit PowerShell-Skripting oder anderen Automatisierungssprachen
- Verständnis für IT-Security-Prinzipien (MFA, Zero Trust, Endpoint Protection, Backup-Strategien)
- Grundverständnis für APIs, Webhooks und JSON zur Integration von Systemen
- Erfahrung mit oder starkes Interesse an Generativer KI, LLMs, RAG-Konzepten und Prompt-Optimierung
- Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Adyen oder vergleichbaren SaaS-Plattformen

Persönliche Stärken

- Analytisches Denken und strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Zuverlässigkeit
- Neugier und Innovationsfreude, insbesondere im Bereich KI und Digitalisierung
- Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten – Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären
- Teamplayer mit Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen zwischen den Standorten Roggwil und Konstanz

Sprachen

- Deutsch verhandlungssicher (C2)
- Englisch gute Kenntnisse (B2) für Dokumentation und internationale Tools/Partner

jobs.title: Ehitus- ja remonditööline
jobs.description:
Osalise koormusega

Tööülesanded: Otsime remondi- ja hooldustöölist (osaline töökoormus)
RevalHome haldab Tallinnas ligi 30 lühiajalise majutuse üksust mitmel objektil ja portfell kasvab jõudsalt. Otsime oma meeskonda remonditöölist, kes hoiaks meie korterid ja majutusüksused töökorras. Tööülesanded Pisiremonditööd objektidel: santehnika (segistid, WC-potid, sifoonid), elektri väiketööd (pistikud, lülitid, valgustid), uksed ja lukud, silikoonimine, värvimine, seinte ja põrandate parandus. Mööbli ja sisustuse kokkupanek, paigaldus ja parandus. Külaliste ja majutusmeeskonna teavitatud probleemide operatiivne lahendamine. Seadmete kontroll ja hooldus: pesumasinad, boilerid, konditsioneerid, ventilatsioon. Vajalike materjalide ja varuosade ostmine. Objektide üldine tehniline korrashoid ja väiksemad ennetavad tööd.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pikaajaline ja stabiilne koostöö kasvavas ettevõttes: objektide arv suureneb lähiajal oluliselt.
Selged ülesanded ja kiire suhtlus – ei pea ise kliente otsima ega hinnapakkumisi tegema.

Muud nõuded: Oskus iseseisvalt probleemile lahendus leida ja töö lõpuni viia.
Oma põhilised käsi- ja elektritööriistad. Telefoni teel hea kättesaadavus ja paindlikkus kiireloomuliste olukordade puhul.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: Olenevalt vajadusest 0,1 - 1

jobs.title: Farmimehaanik
jobs.description:
Otsime oma meeskonda farmimehaanikut, kes aitaks hoida töös meie suure piimafarmi tehnika ja seadmed.

Tööülesanded: Oleme edukas ja arenev põllumajandusettevõte, kus väärtustame kaasaegseid lahendusi, tugevat meeskonda ja inimesi, kes tahavad oma tööga päriselt midagi ära teha.
Farmis on ligikaudu 1000 looma, mistõttu on tehniliste süsteemide sujuv toimimine meie igapäevatöös väga olulisel kohal. See on hea võimalus inimesele, kes soovib teha praktilist ja mitmekesist tööd ning olla osa ettevõttest, mis areneb, investeerib ja kasvab. Sinu tööks saab olema: - farmi masinate ja seadmete hooldus ning remont; - lüpsi- ja muude farmiseadmete rikete tuvastamine ning kõrvaldamine; - tehnosüsteemide korrasoleku jälgimine; - ennetavate hooldustööde tegemine; - erinevate tehniliste probleemide lahendamine; - koostöö farmi meeskonna ja teiste tehnikutega.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Olla osa professionaalsest ja toetavast meeskonnast;
- teha mitmekesist tööd kaasaegses piimafarmis; - arendada oma tehnilisi teadmisi ja oskusi; - töötada erinevate seadmete ja tehnosüsteemidega; - kaasa rääkida ja oma teadmistega ettevõtte arengusse panustada; - kindlat ja pikaajalist töökohta; - töötasu suurus sõltub oskustest ning panusest; - vajalikud töövahendid ja tööriided; - ametiauto.

Muud nõuded: Meie ootused:
Sul on hea tehniline taip ja praktiline mõtlemine; oskad või soovid õppida masinaid ja seadmeid remontima; oled iseseisev, kohusetundlik ja lahendustele orienteeritud; hindad vaheldusrikast tööd ja soovid oma töö tulemust päriselt näha. Varasem kogemus piimafarmis ei ole tingimata vajalik. Olulisem on huvi tehnika vastu, õppimisvõime ja soov areneda.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Tugiisik
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Kas tunned, et soovid teha tööd, millel on päriselt tähendus? Kas lastega suhtlemine toob sulle rõõmu ning soovid olla kellelegi toeks tema igapäevases kasvamises ja arengus?
Meie meeskond ootab endaga liituma tugiisikut, kes soovib panustada laste heaolusse, turvatundesse ja enesekindluse kasvamisse. Sinu roll tugiisikuna: olla lapsele igapäevane toetaja ja julgustaja; aidata kaasa lapse arengule ja iseseisvuse kujunemisele; luua turvaline ja hooliv keskkond; teha koostööd pere ja spetsialistidega.

Omalt poolt pakume: Püsivat tööd;
Toetavat meeskonda ja sisekoolitusi; Tähendusrikast ja südantsoojendavat tööd; Toetavat meeskonda ja juhendamist; Võimalust päriselt midagi muuta ühe lapse elus.

Muud nõuded: Otsime tugiisikuid, kes sobivad hästi lastega, on kohusetundlikud ja peavad kinni kokkulepetest ning on soovitavalt läbinud tugiisiku koolituse või valmis seda läbima.
Ootame sind, kui: hoolid lastest ja soovid nendega töötada; oled kannatlik, empaatiline ja usaldusväärne; suudad märgata lapse vajadusi ja pakkuda tuge; oled valmis õppima ja arenema. See ei ole lihtsalt töö – see on võimalus olla kellelegi oluline tugi ja turvatunne.

Tööülesanded: Turva- ja nõrkvoolusüsteemide paigaldus, hooldus ja remont.
Peamised tööülesanded: - valvesüsteemide paigaldus, hooldus ja rikete kõrvaldamine; - videovalvesüsteemide ja salvestusseadmete paigaldus ning seadistamine; - läbipääsusüsteemide ja fonolukkude paigaldus, hooldus ja remont; - värava- ja ukseautomaatika seadistamine ning rikete lahendamine; - kaabeldustööd, seadmete ühendamine ja kontroll; - kliendiga suhtlemine objektil; - tehtud tööde dokumenteerimine ja hooldusaktide täitmine.

- tööd peamiselt Tallinnas ja Harjumaal; - vajalikke tööriistu, tööriideid ja tehnilisi vahendeid; - vajadusel ametiauto kasutamise võimalust töösõitudeks; - väljaõpet ja täiendkoolitusi; - võimalust taotleda Turvasüsteemide tehnik, tase 4 kutset; - töötasu vastavalt kogemusele ja oskustele.

jobs.title: Senior IT Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst for the European Institutions in Brussels, Belgium. As Senior Business Analyst, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our customers in the public sector and you will be responsible for developing new business by identifying profitable opportunities, maintaining your client portfolio by building strong, long-lasting relationships, and monitoring the progress of the projects, with the aim to provide excellent client service and added value services.

EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be willing to relocate when not based in Brussels. A work permit is not provided. This position is open for employees and contractors. Candidates need to be fluent in English.

Travel is not required for the interviews.

Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Preparation of business requirements and approval of specifications;
  • Management of changes requests;
  • Coordination and review of acceptance testing and planning of deliveries;
  • Reporting of status of IT module to stakeholders;
  • Assistance with preparation of guidelines and training material;
  • Assistance and/or participation in business requirements documents and other relevant documents;
  • Interaction with the business analysts, customer, users, project leaders and the developers;
  • Participation in working groups, progress meetings and meetings with the users;
  • +5/+7/+9 years relevant experience in IT business analysis;
  • Good knowledge of analysis/modelling tools and techniques (use case diagram, state diagram, entity relationship model, interaction diagrams etc.);
  • Good knowledge of BPMN or UML or other with equivalent value;
  • Knowledge of Enterprise Architect is an advantage;
  • Strong capacity in preparing and writing business analysis;
  • Good knowledge of large organisation administrative business processes;
  • Ability to give business and technical presentations;
  • Very good communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences;
  • Analysis and problem solving skills;
  • Capability to write clear and structured business requirements documents;
  • Certificate in Agile methodology would be a plus;
  • Fluent in English

jobs.title: Technical Director
jobs.description:
CCP Games is seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of Core Technology and CARBON — CCP's shared game development platform spanning engine runtime, rendering, graphics, tools, pipelines, and developer experience.

In this role, you will set the technical direction for CARBON, ensuring it evolves as a high-leverage, modern platform that creates meaningful value for game teams across CCP. The ideal candidate brings deep game engine expertise across both runtime and tooling, experience in rendering and graphics, a practical belief in AI-assisted development, and a view of open source as both a near-term execution priority and a long-term strategic advantage.

Reporting to the Senior Development Director of Core Technology, you will translate product vision and organizational priorities into clear technical direction and execution. You will directly manage technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, maintaining visibility into the health and opportunities across the department while keeping teams aligned on a coherent engineering direction.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will contribute through architecture, technical guidance, and code review, while focusing primarily on raising the effectiveness and goals of the engineers and leaders around you.

The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.

Your Tasks:

Define and drive the technical direction for CARBON across runtime, graphics, rendering, tools, pipelines, and shared developer technology.

Collaborate closely with the Senior Development Director of Core Technology to translate product vision and priorities into clear technical strategy and execution.

Lead and develop technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, strengthening quality, alignment, and team growth.

Provide architectural guidance across CARBON, ensuring great decisions around performance, scalability, maintainability, and developer experience.

Guide the department in adopting AI-assisted development in practical, high-value ways that improve speed, iteration, and engineering effectiveness.

Shape CARBON's open-source direction to increase platform leverage, accessibility, and long-term relevance.

Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities across the organization.





Your Profile:

Significant senior technical leadership experience in game development.

Deep game engine expertise across runtime systems, rendering or graphics, and developer tooling.

Proven ability to define technical direction and align multiple teams around a coherent engineering vision.

People leadership experience across senior engineers, technical leads, or engineering managers.

Conviction in the value of AI-assisted and open-source development, with the judgment to apply both strategically and practically.

A pragmatic, growth-oriented leadership style with a bias toward learning, experimentation, and solution-finding within real-world constraints.

Experienced enough as an engineer to lead with credibility through technical judgment, architecture, and code review.

Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Are you a talented Senior Data Engineer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • We'll manually find the best project for you according to your skills and preferences.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Most of them have technical backgrounds. Sounds good, yeah?
  • We will support you from the time you submit the application throughout all cooperation stages.
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.
  • Through our community, we will connect you with the best developers from more than 75 countries.

We have several different roles for Data Engineers — please check the details if you're interested.

 

Requirements — Data Engineers:

  • 5+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer
  • 2+ years of commercial experience with Azure DevOps is a must
  • 2+ years of commercial experience with Databricks
  • 2+ years of experience with DBT is required
  • Experience with Airflow is a plus

 

Requirements — Data Engineers:

  • 4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer

  • 3+ years of experience with Apache Airflow and 2+ years of experience with Snowflake

  • 3+ years of experience with Python and 1+ year with SQL

  • Strong technical skills: as a Senior Data Engineer, you are expected to be able to create projects from scratch and have a deep understanding of application architecture.

  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.

  • Strong self-organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision.

  • Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us and the client down.

  • Adaptability and Flexibility — the ability to onboard the project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

 

Sounds good for you? Apply now and join the Lemon.io community!

We have a variety of projects, so if you have 4+ years of commercial software development experience and are proficient in AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Dart, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Data Annotation, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering, we would be happy to connect with you and match you with a project that fits your experience.

jobs.title: Senior Structural Lead – Naval Ship Construction; DK - Esbjerg, DK - Frederikshavn
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced structural or marine engineer who knows how to turn complex vessel or larger steel structure designs into safe, buildable solutions? This is a rare opportunity to take technical ownership of structural construction for modern naval vessels and help strengthen the future of the Danish naval industry.

Your position
Join Semco Maritime as Senior Structural Lead and take a central role in the construction of modern naval vessels for the Royal Danish Navy. Working at the interface between engineering, procurement, planning, suppliers, and shipyard production, you will translate structural designs and class requirements into practical construction strategies that support safe and efficient execution.

As the senior technical focal point for structural construction, you will influence key decisions from design maturity and production engineering through fabrication, assembly, and delivery. You will coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces, anticipate constructability and schedule risks, and help ensure that structural work is completed to the required quality, safety, and regulatory standards.

This is a visible, hands-on leadership role with close proximity to production and real influence on how the vessels are built. Your primary workplace will be in Frederikshavn or alternatively Esbjerg. The position is full-time, permanent, and occasional travel may be required.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As the Senior Structural Lead for structural construction, you will lead and coordinate the structural construction activities throughout the naval vessel production lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include:
  • Defining and planning the structural construction route from design to production.
  • Leading the production engineering process and providing technical support to procurement.
  • Serving as the technical point of contact for structural construction matters across departments and with suppliers.
  • Managing resources, supervising assembly, and ensuring adherence to quality, schedule, and HSE standards.
  • Supporting production planning to develop efficient and buildable solutions.

Your profile & qualifications
We are seeking a proactive and technically adept engineer who excels in a multidisciplinary environment and has a passion for shipbuilding and naval defence.

Ideal qualifications:
  • BSc or MSc in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Welding Engineering, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience in shipbuilding / ship construction. Alternative could be experience from large scale off-shore construction and / or infrastructure sites or process facilities. 
  • Familiarity with international classification rules (e.g., DNV, ABS); knowledge of naval or defence standards is highly beneficial.
  • Proficient in interpreting technical drawings and 3D models.
  • Fluency in English is required; Danish language skills are a significant advantage.
  • You should have a structured, quality-focused approach with excellent coordination and communication skills.
  • High personal integrity and a strong commitment to health, safety, and environmental standards.
  • Able to obtain a FE security clearance

Welcome to Semco Maritime

jobs.title: Cheflæge til Plastik- og Brystkirurgi, Aarhus Universitetshospital
jobs.description:
Høje faglige ambitioner. Samarbejde på tværs. Sammen om patienterne.

Plastik- og Brystkirurgi på Aarhus Universitetshospital er en højt specialiseret afdeling med stærke faglige miljøer, komplekse patientforløb og høje ambitioner for patientbehandling, uddannelse, forskning og udvikling. Afdelingen spiller en vigtig rolle i en lang række patientforløb på tværs af AUH og har mange samarbejdsflader til andre specialer og fagligheder.

Afdelingen har gennem de senere år været igennem forandringer og er i gang med en ambitiøs kapacitets- og kompetenceopbygning. Vi søger nu både en ny cheflæge og chefsygeplejerske, som sammen får en central rolle i den fortsatte udvikling af afdelingen. De to rekrutteringer gennemføres parallelt, og som ny cheflæge får du derfor mulighed for sammen med din kommende ledelsesmakker at sætte retning for den næste fase.

Opgaven er at bygge videre på afdelingens stærke faglighed og gode samarbejde og samtidig skabe tydelige rammer for den fortsatte udvikling. Sammen med chefsygeplejersken skal du stå i spidsen for en afdeling, hvor høj faglig kvalitet, bæredygtig drift, forskning, uddannelse og udvikling går hånd i hånd – og hvor et respektfuldt og åbent samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder og patientforløb er en central ambition.

Jobbeskrivelse

Som cheflæge har du sammen med chefsygeplejersken ansvar for afdelingens samlede drift og udvikling. Du får samtidig et særligt ansvar for den lægefaglige retning og for at skabe rammerne for fortsat høj kvalitet, faglig udvikling og attraktive lægefaglige miljøer.

En væsentlig del af opgaven bliver at positionere og udvikle afdelingens specialer i en tid, hvor rammerne for sundhedsvæsenet er under forandring. Du skal være med til at omsætte specialeplanen og sundhedsreformen til konkrete faglige og organisatoriske prioriteringer og sikre, at afdelingen er en aktiv medspiller i udviklingen af sammenhængende patientforløb på tværs af hospitaler, sektorer og geografi.

Som cheflæge har du særligt fokus på at:

  • Sikre sammenhæng mellem drift, kvalitet, uddannelse, forskning og innovation.
  • Sætte retning for den lægefaglige udvikling og sikre høj kvalitet i afdelingens patientforløb.
  • Arbejde strategisk med specialeplanen og sikre fortsat udvikling og positionering af afdelingens specialiserede funktioner.
  • Omsætte sundhedsreformen til relevante faglige og organisatoriske løsninger og styrke samarbejdet på tværs af AUH, regionen og det øvrige sundhedsvæsen.
  • Skabe tydelige rammer for prioritering, ansvar og beslutninger i den lægefaglige organisation.
  • Udvikle attraktive faglige miljøer, hvor specialister og øvrige medarbejdere har mulighed for at tage ansvar, udvikle deres kompetencer og bidrage til afdelingens udvikling.
  • Bidrage til et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv og et godt arbejdsmiljø præget af høj faglighed, trivsel og psykologisk tryghed.
  • Bidrage til bæredygtig drift og balancerede prioriteringer i en hverdag med høje faglige ambitioner og begrænsede ressourcer.

Afdelingen arbejder med en relativt flad struktur, hvor ansvar delegeres, og medarbejdere og ledere forventes at bidrage aktivt til løsningen af kerneopgaven. Som cheflæge skal du derfor kunne sætte en tydelig retning uden at have behov for at stå med alle beslutninger selv. Du skal skabe rammer for involvering og fagligt råderum og samtidig være tydelig, når der er behov for prioritering og beslutning.

Sammen med chefsygeplejersken får du en central rolle i at videreudvikle afdelingens ledelseskapacitet. Jeres samarbejde bygger på fælles ansvar for helheden og på, at forskellige faglige og ledelsesmæssige perspektiver skal styrke de beslutninger, der træffes.

Kvalifikationer

Du er speciallæge i plastikkirurgi eller brystkirurgi og har en stærk faglig profil og forståelse for arbejdet i en højt specialiseret kirurgisk afdeling.

Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med personaleledelse og økonomistyring. Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med organisationsudvikling og forandringsledelse og har erfaring med at skabe udvikling i en kompleks organisation med mange fagligheder og samarbejdsrelationer.

Du har blik for de større sammenhænge i sundhedsvæsenet og kan omsætte strategiske og politiske rammer til meningsfulde prioriteringer i den kliniske hverdag. Du kan navigere i et sundhedsvæsen under forandring og bidrage aktivt til afdelingens position og udvikling i relation til blandt andet specialeplanen og sundhedsreformen.

Som leder er du:

  • Lyttende, nysgerrig og relationelt stærk.
  • I stand til at skabe følgeskab gennem tillid, faglig respekt og inddragelse.
  • Tydelig, konsistent og transparent i din ledelse.
  • Optaget af læring og ser fejl som en del af udviklingen.
  • Motiveret for at bygge videre på det, der allerede fungerer godt.

Du formår at kombinere en stærk lægefaglig identitet med blik for afdelingens samlede opgave. Du kan engagere dig i den faglige udvikling og samtidig træde tydeligt ind i de prioriteringer og ledelsesbeslutninger, der følger med ansvaret for en stor og kompleks afdeling.

En formel lederuddannelse er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du ikke allerede en relevant lederuddannelse, tilrettelægger vi sammen et relevant udviklingsforløb med udgangspunkt i din erfaring, dine udviklingsområder og afdelingens behov.

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central ledelsesrolle i en fagligt stærk og højt specialiseret afdeling med engagerede medarbejdere og høje ambitioner for patientbehandling, uddannelse, forskning og udvikling.

Hos os får du mulighed for at præge både afdelingens lægefaglige udvikling og den bredere udvikling på Aarhus Universitetshospital. Du bliver en del af et miljø med tæt samarbejde på tværs af specialer og faggrupper og med aktive nationale og internationale forsknings- og uddannelsesrelationer.

Som leder på AUH får du adgang til ledelsesudvikling, sparring og faglige netværk. Når du starter som afdelingsleder på AUH, får du et tilpasset onboardingforløb med udgangspunkt i dine erfaringer, dine behov og den ledelsesopgave, du træder ind i.

Om Plastik- og Brystkirurgi og AUH

Plastik- og Brystkirurgi er en højt specialiseret afdeling med ca. 140 medarbejdere og en vigtig rolle i komplekse patientforløb på tværs af Aarhus Universitetshospital. Afdelingens plastikkirurgiske og rekonstruktive kompetencer indgår blandt andet i patientforløb inden for kræftbehandling, traumatologi og medfødte misdannelser, og afdelingen har derfor mange samarbejdsflader på tværs af hospitalets specialer.

Afdelingen varetager plastikkirurgiske og brystkirurgiske patientforløb primært for patienter fra Region Midtjylland og har et aktivt forsknings- og uddannelsesmiljø med nationale og internationale samarbejdspartnere. I 2025 behandlede afdelingen ca. 9.200 unikke patienter og gennemførte knap 7.600 operationer.

Hos os møder du ledere og medarbejdere, der er dedikerede til opgaven og drevet af at sikre høj kvalitet i komplekse kirurgiske patientforløb. Vi har høje faglige ambitioner og ønsker fortsat at udvikle vores faglighed og vores samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper, specialer og patientforløb.

Aarhus Universitetshospital er et internationalt anerkendt og højt specialiseret universitetshospital med stærke faglige miljøer og et tæt samarbejde med Aarhus Universitet og internationale partnere. Mere end 12.000 medarbejdere arbejder hver dag sammen om at udvikle og levere sundhedsvæsen af høj kvalitet.

Ansættelsesvilkår, ansøgning og tiltrædelse

Som afdelingsleder på AUH refererer du til sundheds- og hospitalsledelsen og indgår i hospitalets samlede ledelsesstruktur. Du kan læse mere om dit formelle ansvar, opgaver og beføjelser i AUH's ledelsesmodel og stillingsbeskrivelsen for ledere i Region Midtjylland.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag stiles til hospitalsledelsen på AUH. Ansættelsen er betinget af tilfredsstillende autorisation og børneattest.

Forud for ansættelse gennemføres en skriftlig lægefaglig bedømmelse af ansøgernes kompetencer inden for de syv lægeroller.

Tiltrædelse er [1/12]. Ansøgningsfristen er [21/9].

Første samtalerunde afholdes [19/10], og anden samtalerunde afholdes [26/10]. Mellem første og anden samtalerunde gennemføres assessment som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen.

Har du spørgsmål eller er du nysgerrig på ledelsesopgaven, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Thomas Balle Kristensen Sundheds-og Hospitalsdirektør, tlf. +4530387193/tbk@auh.rm.dk eller Charlotte Rosenkrantz Josefsen tlf.+45 29177035/chajos@rm.dk  for en uformel samtale.

Hvis du er nysgerrig på hverdagen og ledelsesopgaven i afdelingen, tager konstitueret cheflæge Gorm von Oettingen tlf.+4529724089/ dr.gorm@aarhus.rm.dk også gerne en snak med dig.

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.title: 3-year Postdoctoral Position in Sustainable Pig Nutrition and Methane Mitigation
jobs.employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a 3-year postdoctoral position in pig nutrition with focus on climate and environmental mitigation strategies. The position is available from 1 November 2026 or soon thereafter. The position is within the research section Monogastric Nutrition.

The position
We seek a highly qualified candidate with a strong background in animal science, veterinary science, or biology. The overall aim of the research is to evaluate feedstuffs and develop nutritional strategies and climate mitigation tools aimed at reducing enteric methane emissions from pigs. In addition, the research aims at generating fundamental knowledge on baseline methane production across different physiological stages of pigs, including growing pigs, gestating sows, lactating sows, and organically raised pigs.

The successful candidate will:
  • Participate in ongoing research projects and contribute to the development of new projects focused on climate mitigation strategies for pig production.
  • Quantify and document enteric methane emissions, nutrient digestion and retention from gestating and lactating sows and growing pigs.
  • Evaluate the nutritional value of fermented rapeseed meal and seaweed products and assess their effects on nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) excretion, methane emissions, and pig health.
  • Evaluate enteric methane emissions associated with feedstuffs, feed additives, and roughages used in organic pig production.
  • Participate in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contribute to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.

Qualifications for the postdoctoral position
  • Academic qualifications at PhD level in animal or veterinary sciences.
  • Research experience in pig nutrition.
  • Experience in conducting different types of animal experiments.
  • Skills in the analysis of experimental data and the scientific communication of research results.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, an effort to learn to read, write, and speak Danish is a requirement.

Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Jan Værum Nørgaard, phone: +4550718795, email: janvnoergaard@anivet.au.dk

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor, master and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Your work will be pivotal to building a world-class tax function and making a lasting impact on Notion’s success and growth.

 - Support IPO-readiness tax work streams, including SEC reporting requirements, audit coordination, and effective tax rate modeling.

 - Mentor a high-performing tax team through day-to-day guidance and coaching, fostering a culture of continuous learning, professional growth, and accountability.

 - BA/BS in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA and/or Master of Taxation is preferred.

 - 8+ years of progressive tax experience across public accounting and/or in-house at a multinational, high-growth company.

 - Hands-on experience with preparing quarterly and annual tax provisions.

 - Experience reviewing tax due diligence materials or supporting M&A transactions from a tax perspective.

 - Extensive experience in financial reporting, internal controls, tax compliance, and audits.

 - Experience partnering effectively across Accounting, Finance, Legal, Treasury, and business stakeholders to solve complex tax and operational problems.

jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege 80-100% für die Region Grabs gesucht
jobs.description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Grabs sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Grabs

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Grabs

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Grabs liegt im Rheintal des Kantons St. Gallen und bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung an. Die Region ist durch die Bahnlinie und das Autobahnnetz gut erreichbar. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Grabs Sie mit einer starken Industrie- und Gewerbebase, günstigen Bodenpreisen und einer hohen Lebensqualität in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Bodensee und Liechtenstein.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege rund um Grabs ist derzeit sehr hoch, da Altersheime und Betreuungseinrichtungen konstant unter Fachkräftemangel leiden. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und können zwischen verschiedenen attraktiven Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum wählen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, passgenauen Stellenvorschlägen und dem Netzwerk zu etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, was Ihnen einen reibungslosen Einstieg garantiert.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Grabs

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Tipp: Laufend neue [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.
- Bewerben Sie sich deshalb jetzt als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Grabs. Wir vermitteln schnell und persönlich, denn gute Fachkräfte verdienen ebenso gute Partner.

jobs.title: Marketing & Business Support LATAM (100%)
jobs.description:

For our client UBS Switzerland AG, supporting their LATAM segment across the booking centers in Switzerland and Hamburg, we are currently looking for a

Marketing & Business Support LATAM (100%)

Your role
•    Support the planning, coordination and execution of marketing activities and client events for LATAM markets across booking centers Switzerland and Hamburg.
•    Manage end-to-end event ticketing processes, including requests, allocations, nominations, tool updates, reporting and follow-up activities.
•    Coordinate closely with Market Business Coordinators and stakeholders to ensure accurate guest management, invitation handling and timely execution.

•    Support international and flagship events by consolidating nominations, monitoring confirmations, managing deadlines and coordinating with central event teams.
•    Handle operational event administration, including supplier coordination, invoices, contracts, documentation and post-event follow-up.
•    Ensure accurate event tracking and timely reporting for LATAM markets, contributing to KPI dashboards and management reporting.
•    Provide back-up support for digital lead management activities, maintaining data quality, monitoring follow-ups and coordinating with Client Advisors.
•    Contribute to process improvements and help ensure a consistently high-quality client experience across all marketing and event activities.
•    Place of work will be Zurich.

Your profile
•    Commercial apprenticeship, degree in Marketing, Events Management or a comparable qualification.
•    Professional experience in marketing, event management, hospitality, client service or a similar coordination role.
•    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines simultaneously.
•    High level of client and service orientation with a proactive, hands-on approach.
•    Excellent attention to detail and strong operational execution skills.
•    Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and handling ad hoc requests and last-minute changes.
•    Strong communication skills and confidence interacting with internal and external stakeholders.
•    Advanced user of Microsoft Office applications; experience with reporting tools and dashboards is an advantage.
•    Fluency in English is essential; Spanish and/or Portuguese are highly desirable. German would be an advantage.

Are you an upbeat person used to working independently within a team?
Are you a highly organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys creating outstanding client experiences? Do you thrive in a dynamic international environment and enjoy coordinating events, managing operational processes and working with a variety of stakeholders? Then we look forward to meeting you.

jobs.title: Team Leader Process Technology New AI (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Syngenta

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.

Job Description
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, Syngenta’s Hiring Team is seeking a Onsite, Team Leader Process Technology New AI (m/f/d) in Münchwilen, Schweiz.

Role purpose:

The role involves leading a team of 1-3 lab technicians in a chemistry lab while being responsible for developing and scaling-up chemical reactions towards manufacturing, including preparation and support of pilot campaigns. The position requires maintaining comprehensive process know-how for all assigned chemical steps. It also demands digital curiosity and confidence, working at the interface of chemistry, data and technology.

Accountabilities:

Ensuring the required HSE standards and good laboratory practices are applied/respected.
Overseeing and defining the experimental program to deliver safe and sustainable chemical processes that are fit for the current development lifecycle stage under guidance of the project lead.
Designing lab experiments and pilot campaigns to generate process understanding and know-how
Maintaining documentation to capture lab results and project requirements as defined by guidance.
Supporting process know-how transfers in agreement with the project lead.
Ensuring close collaboration with project stakeholders.
Supporting the department in specialist roles.
Preparing inputs for cost estimates.
Proposing, supporting, and implementing improvement projects.
Ensuring efficient use of provided resources.
Qualifications
PhD in organic chemistry or chemical engineering, typically with a Post Doc. (or equivalent experience)
Practical experience in organic chemistry.
Fluent English. German and French advantageous.
Good communication skills coupled with the ability to see trends and simplify complex information.
Track record in working within project timelines in a dynamic environment.
Experience in the fields of data science, statistics, modelling, automation or process analytical techniques or in collaborating with experts in these fields.
Basic knowledge of Python, MATLAB, or R or a willingness to learn, is advantageous.
Additional Information
What We Offer

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

We offer a position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
The opportunity to make a difference to process safety, both within Syngenta’s global operations, and in shaping safety legislation and culture worldwide
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance…)
Please send your complete application with CV, diploma and work certificates (if applicable).

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Avionics Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Position: Avionics Systems Engineer
Location: Zurich, Switzerland
Contract: Permanent contract, full-time position
Salary: It will be discussed during the recruiting process, taking into consideration seniority and responsibilities within the activity.

AYES is a Switzerland-based Engineering and Technology consulting company headquartered in Baden. Our core business spans several industrial sectors including Automotive, Aerospace, Space & Defense, Railway, Energy, and Life Sciences.
With a strong commitment to innovation and engineering excellence, AYES supports clients across Switzerland, Europe, and the United States through advanced technology development and engineering services.
Our teams work on complex and cutting-edge programs where technical expertise, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential drivers of success.

Key Responsibilities
Capture and analyze system requirements, assessing feasibility and contributing to early system architecture and concept definition
Coordinate the design, development, integration, verification, and certification of complex avionics systems
Support system integration activities and ensure compliance with applicable aviation regulations
Prepare and review system requirements documentation and certification engineering reports
Perform and review System Safety Assessments, including Functional Hazard Analysis (FHA) and related safety studies
Interface with external suppliers, customers, procurement teams, and certification authorities on technical matters
Contribute to technology development and innovation initiatives within avionics programs
Provide engineering support to production, integration, and customer support teams when required

Our Ideal Candidate Should Have
University Degree in Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline
Minimum 10 years of experience in aerospace or other safety-critical industries working in systems engineering and avionics development
Proven experience in the design and development of integrated avionics systems
Experience in military aviation environments is considered an advantage
Knowledge of tactical communication systems, datalink technologies (e.g., Link 16), and radar systems is a strong plus
Familiarity with avionics systems such as EFIS, FMS, or Flight Control Systems (FCS)
Exposure to Electronic Warfare (EW), Electronic Countermeasure (ECM), or weapon system integration is beneficial

Fluent English (C1) is required, German language skills are considered an advantage

SAY YES AND GROW WITH AYES!

jobs.description:

At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German

jobs.title: Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval
jobs.description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.
